io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.access.title: Microsoft Access
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.access.description: Tasks that connect to Microsoft Access databases via UCanAccess JDBC to run queries and loads.
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.access.body: Provide the UCanAccess JDBC URL pointing to an .mdb or .accdb file and SQL statements (query, batch, trigger) to read or write data; configure fetch type and output options to return rows or files from workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.f5.poolmember.title: F5 BIG-IP Pool Member
io.kestra.plugin.ee.f5.poolmember.description: Manage F5 BIG-IP LTM pool members (node and port attachments to pools).

io.kestra.plugin.core.kv.title: KV
io.kestra.plugin.core.kv.description: Tasks that manage key-value pairs in Kestra's KV store.
io.kestra.plugin.core.kv.body: Set, get, list, version, and delete namespaced keys to share state across flows; specify the key path, value for writes, and optional namespace or TTL to control how data is stored, retrieved, and purged.

io.kestra.plugin.serdes.excel.title: Excel
io.kestra.plugin.serdes.excel.description: Tasks that convert between Excel and ION.
io.kestra.plugin.serdes.excel.body: Supply Excel workbooks to convert sheets into ION data, or take ION data to generate Excel files with configurable column rendering and date/time handling.

io.kestra.plugin.kestra.ee.tests.title: Kestra Tests
io.kestra.plugin.kestra.ee.tests.description: Tasks that run Kestra Enterprise test suites.
io.kestra.plugin.kestra.ee.tests.body: Provide the Kestra EE API endpoint, namespace, and auth token to execute flow tests (single or batch), returning results and failures to gate promotions.

io.kestra.plugin.kestra.flows.title: Kestra Flows
io.kestra.plugin.kestra.flows.description: Tasks that list and export Kestra flows.
io.kestra.plugin.kestra.flows.body: Set the Kestra API URL, namespace filters, and auth token to retrieve flow definitions or export them (by namespace or ID) for backup, promotion, or analysis.

io.kestra.plugin.miro.boards.title: Miro Boards
io.kestra.plugin.miro.boards.description: Tasks for managing Miro boards: list, get, create, update, delete, and copy, plus a polling trigger for new boards.
io.kestra.plugin.miro.boards.body: Use these tasks to automate Miro board lifecycle management: provision boards for new projects, archive completed ones, and audit board membership from a Kestra flow.

io.kestra.plugin.github.topics.title: GitHub Topics
io.kestra.plugin.github.topics.body: Provide a GitHub token and topic query to retrieve topic metadata and related repositories for categorization or discovery workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.scripts.php.title: PHP
io.kestra.plugin.scripts.php.body: Provide PHP code inline or files with dependencies and arguments to execute via PHP in Kestra, capturing stdout/stderr and any generated files.

io.kestra.plugin.aws.title: AWS
io.kestra.plugin.aws.description: Tasks and triggers that integrate Amazon Web Services with Kestra workflows, spanning storage (S3, DynamoDB), analytics (Athena, EMR, Glue), messaging and streaming (SNS, SQS, Kinesis, MSK, EventBridge), compute (Lambda, CLI), infrastructure (CloudFormation, ECR), monitoring (CloudWatch), authentication (EKS tokens), AI (Bedrock), and healthcare data (HealthLake).
io.kestra.plugin.aws.body: Authenticate every task and trigger with static credentials (`accessKeyId` and `secretKeyId`, optionally a `sessionToken`), by assuming an IAM role through `stsRoleArn`, or by relying on the default AWS credentials provider chain when none are set. Set `region` for the target service, and override `endpointOverride` with `compatibilityMode` enabled to reach S3-compatible storage backends.

io.kestra.plugin.digitalocean.domain.title: DigitalOcean Domain
io.kestra.plugin.digitalocean.domain.description: Tasks for managing DigitalOcean domain zones.
io.kestra.plugin.digitalocean.domain.body: List, read, create, and delete domain zones. DNS records within a zone are managed by the io.kestra.plugin.digitalocean.domain.record sub-package.

io.kestra.plugin.klaviyo.jobs.title: Klaviyo Campaign Jobs
io.kestra.plugin.klaviyo.jobs.description: Tasks that check Klaviyo campaign job status and recipients.
io.kestra.plugin.klaviyo.jobs.body: Set your `apiKey` with job or recipient IDs to poll campaign send jobs and fetch recipient batches, returning job states, errors, and payloads so you can monitor delivery pipelines.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.huawei.runner.title: Huawei Cloud CCI Task Runner
io.kestra.plugin.ee.huawei.runner.description: Task runner that executes Kestra workloads as Pods on Huawei Cloud Cloud Container Instance (CCI).
io.kestra.plugin.ee.huawei.runner.body: Requires `region`, `namespace` (an existing CCI namespace bound to a VPC Network), and Huawei Cloud credentials — `accessKeyId`/`secretAccessKey` (AK/SK signing, recommended), `temporaryCredentials`, or a pre-obtained IAM token via `securityToken`; the same AK/SK also covers the `bucket` used by `inputFiles`, `outputFiles`, or working directory sync, ensure the task defines a `containerImage`, and tune `resources`, polling, and resume/cleanup options to fit your CCI environment.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.apps.title: App
io.kestra.plugin.ee.apps.description: Tasks that define Kestra Enterprise Apps for interacting with flows and executions through custom layouts.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.apps.body: The Execution App renders bespoke pages for a flow using blocks, dispatchers, and streamers; provide `flowId` (and optional revision or `executionId`) plus a `layout` describing the components. Apps run with EE access control, can auto-load or create executions, and let teams expose curated interactions without giving full UI access.

io.kestra.plugin.mqtt.title: MQTT
io.kestra.plugin.mqtt.description: Tasks that publish, subscribe, and trigger workflows with MQTT.
io.kestra.plugin.mqtt.body: Set the broker URI, client ID, topics, QoS, and credentials to send or receive MQTT messages, with triggers that start flows when subscribed messages arrive.

io.kestra.plugin.serdes.parquet.title: Parquet
io.kestra.plugin.serdes.parquet.description: Tasks that convert between Parquet and ION.
io.kestra.plugin.serdes.parquet.body: Provide Parquet files and optional schemas to convert to ION, or supply ION data to write Parquet with compression and schema controls for analytics pipelines.

io.kestra.plugin.redis.cli.title: Redis CLI
io.kestra.plugin.redis.cli.description: Execute Redis CLI commands directly using the official Redis Docker image.
io.kestra.plugin.redis.cli.body: Run any redis-cli command in a Docker container. Supports authentication, TLS, database selection, and JSON output format (Redis 7+). Commands are executed sequentially and the task fails if any command fails.

io.kestra.plugin.proxmox.template.title: Proxmox VE Templates
io.kestra.plugin.proxmox.template.description: Tasks that convert a stopped VM or container into a template and list available templates on a Proxmox VE node.
io.kestra.plugin.proxmox.template.body: Specify node, resource type, and VMID to convert a stopped machine to a reusable template. List returns all templates available for cloning on a given node.

io.kestra.plugin.dataform.title: Dataform
io.kestra.plugin.dataform.description: Tasks that run Dataform data transformations through the Dataform CLI.
io.kestra.plugin.dataform.body: Run the Dataform CLI in Kestra to compile, validate, and execute Dataform projects against your data warehouse. Provide the CLI `commands` to run and optional `beforeCommands` for setup, and pass credentials and project configuration via `env` and `inputFiles`; the task runs in a container (default `dataformco/dataform:latest`) or any configured task runner.

io.kestra.plugin.shopify.title: Shopify
io.kestra.plugin.shopify.description: Tasks that call the Shopify Admin API to manage products, orders, and customers.
io.kestra.plugin.shopify.body: Set your store domain and Admin API access token (with API version and optional rate-limit delay) to list, create, update, or delete Shopify resources, and wire the responses into downstream fulfillment or analytics flows.

io.kestra.plugin.huawei.iam.title: Huawei IAM
io.kestra.plugin.huawei.iam.description: Huawei Cloud Identity and Access Management (IAM) authentication tasks.

io.kestra.plugin.airtable.title: Airtable
io.kestra.plugin.airtable.description: Tasks that connect to Airtable bases and tables over the REST API for workflow automation.
io.kestra.plugin.airtable.body: Provides record CRUD operations with formula filtering, view-aware pagination, batch handling, typecasting, and outputs suited to AI Agent workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.amqp.title: AMQP
io.kestra.plugin.amqp.description: Tasks that connect to RabbitMQ brokers to declare exchanges and queues, bind routing keys, publish messages, and consume them via tasks or triggers (batch or real time).
io.kestra.plugin.amqp.body: Provide host/port/credentials/virtual host values for each connection, and set stop conditions such as maxDuration or maxRecords when consuming.

io.kestra.plugin.graalvm.title: GraalVM
io.kestra.plugin.graalvm.description: Tasks that run JS, Python, or Ruby code via the GraalVM engine.
io.kestra.plugin.graalvm.body: Provide inline scripts or file paths with language selection, optional bindings/variables, and output handling to execute GraalVM code inside workflows while capturing logs and results.

io.kestra.plugin.github.issues.title: GitHub Issues
io.kestra.plugin.github.issues.description: Tasks that search, create, and comment on GitHub issues.
io.kestra.plugin.github.issues.body: Authenticate with a GitHub token, set repository owner/name, and supply search terms or issue payloads (title, body, labels, assignees) to file issues, add comments, or retrieve issue metadata for triage.

io.kestra.plugin.figma.variables.title: Variables
io.kestra.plugin.figma.variables.description: Read and write Figma variables and variable collections. Requires a Figma Enterprise organization plan.
io.kestra.plugin.figma.variables.body: Get a file's local or published variables, or bulk create/update/delete variables, variable collections, modes, and mode values. All three tasks require a Figma Enterprise organization plan with variables enabled.

io.kestra.plugin.scripts.deno.title: Deno
io.kestra.plugin.scripts.deno.body: Provide TypeScript/JavaScript code inline or files with permissions, imports, and arguments to execute via Deno, capturing stdout/stderr and output files from workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.resend.title: Resend
io.kestra.plugin.resend.description: Tasks that manage domains and send email via the Resend API.
io.kestra.plugin.resend.body: Provide your Resend API key to verify domains and send emails with from/to, subject, HTML/text bodies, and optional tags or attachments, returning API responses for deliverability tracking.

io.kestra.plugin.github.projects.title: GitHub Projects
io.kestra.plugin.github.projects.description: Tasks for listing and managing GitHub Projects v2 boards.
io.kestra.plugin.github.projects.body: Authenticate with a GitHub token that has the read:project scope and supply an organization login and project number to fetch all items from a GitHub Projects v2 board, with optional filtering by owner, status, and labels.

io.kestra.plugin.notifications.pagerduty.title: Pagerduty
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.pagerduty.description: Tasks that send events to PagerDuty.
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.pagerduty.body: Provide a PagerDuty routing/integration key with summary, source, severity, and optional custom details to trigger incidents or alerts from Kestra workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.fs.ftps.title: FTPS (File Transfer Protocol Secure)
io.kestra.plugin.fs.ftps.description: Tasks that transfer and manage files over FTPS with TLS.
io.kestra.plugin.fs.ftps.body: Configure FTPS host/port, credentials, and security mode (implicit or explicit) with certificate settings to list, upload, download, move, or delete files and trigger flows on new arrivals using the provided paths.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.runmyjobs.process.title: RunMyJobs Process
io.kestra.plugin.ee.runmyjobs.process.description: Submit and monitor Redwood RunMyJobs Process Definitions.

io.kestra.plugin.googleworkspace.sheets.title: Google Sheets
io.kestra.plugin.googleworkspace.sheets.description: Tasks that read, write, create, delete, and watch Google Sheets.
io.kestra.plugin.googleworkspace.sheets.body: Provide Sheets/Drive scopes, spreadsheet IDs, ranges, and optional value/input options to read or load data, create or delete spreadsheets, and use the sheet modification trigger to launch flows on updates.

io.kestra.plugin.gcp.vertexai.title: Google Cloud Vertex AI
io.kestra.plugin.gcp.vertexai.description: Integrate machine learning models into your workflows. Train, deploy, and invoke ML models with Vertex AI.

io.kestra.plugin.aws.athena.title: AWS Athena
io.kestra.plugin.aws.athena.description: Tasks that run Amazon Athena SQL queries against data in S3 or federated sources, writing results to an S3 output location and optionally fetching rows.
io.kestra.plugin.aws.athena.body: Queries can wait for completion or be submitted asynchronously and emit execution metrics such as data scanned to help monitor cost.

io.kestra.plugin.scripts.node.title: Node
io.kestra.plugin.scripts.node.body: Provide JavaScript/TypeScript code inline or files with npm packages and arguments to run via Node.js, capturing stdout/stderr and output files for downstream steps.

io.kestra.plugin.gcp.firestore.title: Google Cloud Firestore
io.kestra.plugin.gcp.firestore.description: Access and manage Firestore databases directly from your workflows. Store and retrieve structured data with serverless simplicity.

io.kestra.plugin.airbyte.connections.title: Airbyte Connections
io.kestra.plugin.airbyte.connections.description: Tasks that start and monitor sync jobs on a self-hosted Airbyte instance
io.kestra.plugin.airbyte.connections.body: Use these tasks to trigger a connection sync and optionally wait for the Airbyte job to finish. Set `url` and the required connection or job ID, then configure one supported authentication method such as basic auth, a bearer token, or application credentials.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.gcp.operationalsuite.title: Cloud Operations Suite Log Exporter
io.kestra.plugin.ee.gcp.operationalsuite.description: Tasks that send Kestra logs to Google Cloud Operations (Logging) for centralized observability.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.gcp.operationalsuite.body: Use the log exporter to push workflow logs with severity and labels into Cloud Logging so they can feed dashboards, alerts, and audits. Configure projectId along with a service account or impersonated identity, and adjust the chunk size to balance throughput with rate limits.

io.kestra.plugin.azure.storage.adls.title: ADLS
io.kestra.plugin.azure.storage.adls.description: Tasks that work with Azure Data Lake Storage for large-scale file operations and analytics workloads.
io.kestra.plugin.azure.storage.adls.body: Upload, read, list, and delete ADLS Gen2 files, generate shared access links, or trigger workflows on storage events. Provide an endpoint with either a connection string, shared key, or SAS token plus the target fileSystem and filePath; optional leasing can prevent concurrent writes.

io.kestra.plugin.sqlmesh.cli.title: SQLMesh CLI
io.kestra.plugin.sqlmesh.cli.description: Tasks that execute SQLMesh CLI commands.
io.kestra.plugin.sqlmesh.cli.body: Set working directory and SQLMesh configuration, then run CLI commands (plan, run, apply, etc.) with arguments, capturing stdout/stderr and artifacts for orchestration.

io.kestra.plugin.gcp.gcs.title: Google Cloud Storage (GCS)
io.kestra.plugin.gcp.gcs.description: Store, manage, and access files in Google Cloud Storage. Move data reliably between systems with simple file operations.

io.kestra.plugin.stripe.payment.title: Stripe Payment
io.kestra.plugin.stripe.payment.description: Tasks that create and manage Stripe payments or charges.
io.kestra.plugin.stripe.payment.body: Set your Stripe API key with amounts, currency, customer/payment method IDs, and optional metadata to create charges or payment intents and retrieve their status for order workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.gcp.runner.title: Google Cloud Task Runner
io.kestra.plugin.ee.gcp.runner.description: Tasks that run and orchestrate Kestra workloads on Google Cloud Run, Batch, and Compute Engine.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.gcp.runner.body: Use these runners when you need managed container execution or a Compute Engine VM with log streaming and file staging. Set a containerImage on the task for Cloud Run/Batch (or instanceConfig/instanceName for Compute Engine), provide projectId and region/zone plus a service account or impersonated identity, and configure a Cloud Storage bucket when passing inputFiles/namespaceFiles or collecting outputFiles.

io.kestra.plugin.clevercloud.deployments.title: Clever Cloud Deployments
io.kestra.plugin.clevercloud.deployments.description: Tasks and triggers for managing Clever Cloud application deployments.

io.kestra.plugin.notion.page.title: Notion Pages
io.kestra.plugin.notion.page.description: Tasks that create, read, update, and archive Notion pages.
io.kestra.plugin.notion.page.body: Use a Notion integration token with parent page or database IDs to render markdown into Notion blocks, retrieve page content, update properties, or archive pages, returning the updated Notion payloads.

io.kestra.plugin.azure.cli.title: Azure CLI
io.kestra.plugin.azure.cli.description: Tasks that run Azure CLI commands within Kestra.
io.kestra.plugin.azure.cli.body: Provide one or more commands with optional service principal login (tenant, username/clientId, password/secret); runs in the Azure CLI container or chosen task runner and supports environment variables plus file inputs/outputs.

io.kestra.plugin.fs.ftp.title: FTP (File Transfer Protocol)
io.kestra.plugin.fs.ftp.description: Tasks that list, transfer, move, delete, and watch files over FTP.
io.kestra.plugin.fs.ftp.body: Provide FTP host/port, username/password (and passive/binary options) with remote and local paths to upload or download single or multiple files, move or delete them, and use the trigger to start flows when new files arrive.

io.kestra.plugin.github.repositories.title: GitHub Repositories
io.kestra.plugin.github.repositories.description: Tasks that search and inspect GitHub repositories.
io.kestra.plugin.github.repositories.body: Authenticate with a GitHub token and supply search queries, topics, owners, or visibility filters to list repositories and return metadata such as stars, forks, and languages for inventory or compliance checks.

io.kestra.plugin.slack.title: Slack
io.kestra.plugin.slack.description: Slack notification webhooks and full Slack App automations across chat, files, canvases, channels, reactions, users, and events.
io.kestra.plugin.slack.body: Use either an incoming webhook `url` (https://hooks.slack.com/...) for lightweight notifications or a Slack App `token` (xoxb) plus optional `signingSecret` to run chat, conversations, files, canvases, reactions, and user tasks or trigger flows from the Event API. Supports threaded updates, streaming message sessions, channel lifecycle management, file uploads/cleanup, canvas authoring, reaction-based approvals, user lookups, and reusable output models for downstream steps.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.canonical.title: Canonical (EE)
io.kestra.plugin.ee.canonical.description: Tasks to interact with Canonical services, enabling automation and infrastructure management through API-driven workflows.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.canonical.body: Automate Canonical MAAS (Metal as a Service) bare-metal provisioning from Kestra — enlist, commission, deploy, power-control, and list machines through the MAAS API, authenticating with a MAAS `url` and OAuth `apiKey`.

io.kestra.plugin.nats.title: NATS
io.kestra.plugin.nats.description: Tasks that publish, subscribe, and work with NATS messaging.
io.kestra.plugin.nats.body: Provide NATS server URLs and credentials/creds files to publish messages, consume subjects with triggers, and manage KV stores for lightweight state inside Kestra workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.apify.actor.title: Apify Actor
io.kestra.plugin.apify.actor.description: Tasks that run Apify Actors with configurable inputs, limits, and webhooks.
io.kestra.plugin.apify.actor.body: Provide `actorId` and `apiToken` to start an Apify Actor from a workflow and receive the resulting run payload. Optional parameters like `input`, `maxItems`, `maxTotalChargeUsd`, `build`, and `waitForFinish` let you cap spend, pick builds, and wait for completion while staying notified via webhooks.

io.kestra.plugin.azure.title: Azure
io.kestra.plugin.azure.description: Leverage Microsoft Azure services within Kestra data workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.aws.bedrock.title: AWS Bedrock
io.kestra.plugin.aws.bedrock.description: Tasks that invoke foundation models on Amazon Bedrock, run structured multi-turn conversations via the unified Converse API, stream responses, and list available models — all using the same AWS credentials as the rest of your plugin-aws stack.

io.kestra.plugin.kestra.title: Kestra Plugin
io.kestra.plugin.kestra.description: Tasks that interact with Kestra itself to manage flows, executions, namespaces, dashboards, and tests.
io.kestra.plugin.kestra.body: Point to a Kestra server URL with API token and namespace to query or kill executions, export or list flows, enumerate namespaces, export dashboard chart data, and run EE test suites directly from orchestrated workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.salesforce.title: Salesforce (EE)
io.kestra.plugin.ee.salesforce.description: Tasks that connect to Salesforce in Kestra to query data, manage records, and trigger flows from CRM events.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.salesforce.body: Use the Partner API with a `connection` (username, password, authEndpoint) to run SOQL queries, create, update, or delete objects, and trigger flows from query results. Provide object API names, record IDs, or SOQL statements along with fetch options when you need to return or store rows for downstream tasks.

io.kestra.plugin.airbyte.cloud.jobs.title: Airbyte Cloud Jobs
io.kestra.plugin.airbyte.cloud.jobs.description: Tasks that create and monitor Airbyte Cloud jobs for a connection
io.kestra.plugin.airbyte.cloud.jobs.body: Use these tasks to run sync or reset jobs in Airbyte Cloud and, by default, wait for completion. Provide the `connectionId` and one supported authentication method such as a bearer token, client credentials, or basic auth.

io.kestra.plugin.perplexity.title: Perplexity
io.kestra.plugin.perplexity.description: Tasks that request chat completions from Perplexity models.
io.kestra.plugin.perplexity.body: Set your Perplexity API key, choose the target model, and pass in messages or prompts to generate responses with usage details you can log or feed into downstream steps.

io.kestra.plugin.matrix.title: Matrix
io.kestra.plugin.matrix.description: Tasks that send notifications to Matrix rooms via a bot account.
io.kestra.plugin.matrix.body: Set your Matrix homeserver URL, bot access token, and target room ID to send messages from Kestra workflows to a Matrix room, or notify a room about a flow execution's result.

io.kestra.plugin.monday.items.title: Monday Items
io.kestra.plugin.monday.items.description: Full lifecycle for items on a Monday board.
io.kestra.plugin.monday.items.body: Full lifecycle for items on a Monday board: create, update, archive, delete, move, duplicate, and read. The polling trigger fires on new or updated items.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.csp.ipam.ad.title: Infoblox Universal DDI Address Blocks
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.csp.ipam.ad.description: Tasks to manage address blocks (ipam/address_block) in Infoblox Universal DDI (Cloud Services Portal).
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.csp.ipam.ad.body: List, create, update, and delete address block objects, the Universal DDI equivalent of a NIOS container network.

io.kestra.plugin.azure.servicebus.title: Azure Service Bus
io.kestra.plugin.azure.servicebus.description: Tasks that interact with Azure Service Bus.
io.kestra.plugin.azure.servicebus.body: Consume, Publish, Trigger, and RealTimeTrigger tasks from Azure Service Bus using a connection string or SAS/shared key and endpoint.

io.kestra.plugin.tencent.qq.title: Tencent QQ / IM
io.kestra.plugin.tencent.qq.description: Tasks for sending execution-based notifications to Tencent Cloud IM / QQ.
io.kestra.plugin.tencent.qq.body: Send execution-triggered alerts from Kestra to Tencent Cloud IM / QQ using the Tencent IM REST API. These tasks are intended for flow-trigger notifications and include execution metadata such as execution ID, namespace, flow name, status, duration, and failed task details when applicable.

io.kestra.plugin.scripts.python.title: Python
io.kestra.plugin.scripts.python.description: Tasks that run Python scripts with optional dependencies.
io.kestra.plugin.scripts.python.body: Provide Python code inline or files, pip requirements, interpreter options, and arguments to execute via Python in Kestra, capturing stdout/stderr and output files for downstream tasks.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.opensearch.title: OpenSearch (EE)
io.kestra.plugin.ee.opensearch.description: Tasks that connect to OpenSearch over HTTP for indexing and log export.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.opensearch.body: Use these tasks to push execution logs or other documents into OpenSearch indices via bulk REST calls. Provide one or more host URLs (with scheme and port) and the target index name; optional basic auth, custom headers, path prefix, and TLS trust-all assist with secured or proxied clusters.

io.kestra.plugin.prometheus.title: Prometheus
io.kestra.plugin.prometheus.description: Tasks that query Prometheus and push custom metrics.
io.kestra.plugin.prometheus.body: Provide the Prometheus server URL and PromQL queries to fetch time-series data or use the pushgateway settings to publish metrics; triggers can poll PromQL results and start flows when conditions match.

io.kestra.plugin.serdes.json.title: JSON
io.kestra.plugin.serdes.json.description: Tasks that convert JSON and JSONL to/from ION.
io.kestra.plugin.serdes.json.body: Provide JSON or JSONL inputs to convert into ION or other formats, or take ION to emit JSON/JSONL, with options for pretty-printing and schema validation.

io.kestra.plugin.grafana.loki.title: Grafana-loki
io.kestra.plugin.grafana.loki.description: Tasks that execute LogQL against Grafana Loki and trigger workflows from log patterns.
io.kestra.plugin.grafana.loki.body: Set the Loki `url`, auth token or basic credentials, and LogQL `query` along with time range, direction, and limits to fetch logs or metrics, or use the polling trigger to start flows when new matching entries arrive.

io.kestra.plugin.fivetran.connectors.title: Fivetran Connectors
io.kestra.plugin.fivetran.connectors.description: Tasks that trigger and manage Fivetran connector syncs.
io.kestra.plugin.fivetran.connectors.body: Start a connector sync through the Fivetran API and optionally wait for completion or failure, including a force-restart option. Requires API key/secret credentials and a `connectorId`; you can override the API base URL, HTTP options, and tune `force`, `wait`, and `maxDuration` to match your run policies.

io.kestra.plugin.fs.smb.title: SMB (Server Message Block)
io.kestra.plugin.fs.smb.description: Tasks that exchange files over SMB/CIFS shares.
io.kestra.plugin.fs.smb.body: Set the SMB share URL, domain/user credentials, and remote/local paths to list, upload, download, move, or delete files; supports NTLM auth options so workflows can interact with Samba or Windows shares.

io.kestra.plugin.stripe.webhook.title: Stripe Webhook
io.kestra.plugin.stripe.webhook.description: Tasks that process Stripe webhook events.
io.kestra.plugin.stripe.webhook.body: Configure the webhook signing secret to validate incoming Stripe events, parse payloads, and trigger workflows with event data such as payment updates or subscription changes.

io.kestra.plugin.gcp.title: Google Cloud
io.kestra.plugin.gcp.description: Execute tasks and orchestrate workflows across Google Cloud Platform services. Centralize authentication and resource management for seamless GCP integration.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.purestorage.arrays.title: Pure Storage FlashArray Arrays
io.kestra.plugin.ee.purestorage.arrays.description: Tasks and triggers for monitoring Pure Storage FlashArray array status and alerts.

io.kestra.plugin.documentdb.title: DocumentDB
io.kestra.plugin.documentdb.description: Tasks that manage DocumentDB collections with MongoDB-compatible insert, query, update, and delete operations.
io.kestra.plugin.documentdb.body: Connect to DocumentDB's HTTP API to insert, read, update, and delete collection data. io.kestra.plugin.gcp.dataproc.clusters.title: Google Cloud Dataproc Clusters
io.kestra.plugin.gcp.dataproc.clusters.description: Create and manage Dataproc clusters for distributed data processing. Orchestrate complex analytics workloads at scale.

io.kestra.plugin.microsoft365.dynamics36.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central
io.kestra.plugin.microsoft365.dynamics36.description: Tasks that interact with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central for finance and operations.
io.kestra.plugin.microsoft365.dynamics36.body: Configure the `environment`, tenant ID, and Azure authentication properties to manage companies, customers, sales invoices, and items via the Business Central API v2.0.

io.kestra.plugin.digitalocean.kubernetes.title: DigitalOcean Kubernetes
io.kestra.plugin.digitalocean.kubernetes.description: Tasks for managing DigitalOcean Kubernetes (DOKS) clusters.
io.kestra.plugin.digitalocean.kubernetes.body: List, read, create, and delete Kubernetes clusters, and download a cluster's kubeconfig to internal storage.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.dash0.title: Dash0 (EE)
io.kestra.plugin.ee.dash0.description: Tasks that ship Kestra workflow logs to Dash0 via OTLP/HTTP for centralized observability.

io.kestra.plugin.ceph.cluster.title: Ceph Cluster Health
io.kestra.plugin.ceph.cluster.description: Tasks and triggers that report on overall Ceph cluster health.
io.kestra.plugin.ceph.cluster.body: Fetch the full or minimal Ceph health report, and trigger a flow the moment the cluster transitions into a degraded (HEALTH_WARN or HEALTH_ERR) state.

io.kestra.plugin.hex.title: Hex
io.kestra.plugin.hex.description: Run Hex (hex.tech) notebook and app projects from Kestra and react when a run completes.
io.kestra.plugin.hex.body: Use the `projects.Run` task to start the latest published version of a Hex project and optionally wait for it to finish, or the `projects.Trigger` to fire a flow when a project's most recent run reaches COMPLETED. Requires a Hex `apiToken` and a `projectId`; override `baseUrl` only for a self-hosted Hex region.

io.kestra.plugin.core.title: Core Plugins and tasks
io.kestra.plugin.core.description: Tasks that provide Kestra's built-in orchestration, I/O, and observability capabilities.
io.kestra.plugin.core.body: Core plugins cover control-flow, execution management, triggers, storage, HTTP, metrics, logging, templating, and dashboard widgets; combine these foundational tasks to build reliable workflows without adding external dependencies.

io.kestra.plugin.notifications.opsgenie.title: Opsgenie
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.opsgenie.description: Tasks that create alerts in Opsgenie.
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.opsgenie.body: Provide the Opsgenie API endpoint and integration key, along with message, priority, responders, and tags to open alerts from Kestra flows and receive response payloads.

io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.sqlserver.title: Microsoft SQL Server
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.sqlserver.description: Tasks that connect to SQL Server via JDBC to run queries and loads.
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.sqlserver.body: Provide the SQL Server JDBC URL, credentials, and SQL statements (query, batch, load, trigger) to read or write data; configure fetch type, fetch size, and output options to return rows or files from workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.servicenow.title: ServiceNow
io.kestra.plugin.servicenow.description: Tasks that create, update, read, and delete ServiceNow records via REST.
io.kestra.plugin.servicenow.body: Set the ServiceNow instance URL with credentials or basic auth, choose the table, and provide request bodies or sys_ids to post, update, fetch, or delete records; responses include the JSON payloads for downstream handling.

io.kestra.plugin.debezium.mongodb.title: Debezium MongoDB
io.kestra.plugin.debezium.mongodb.description: Tasks that stream MongoDB change events into Kestra through Debezium connectors.

Provide a replica set or sharded `connectionString` with credentials, choose snapshotMode, and optionally include or exclude collections; use Trigger to poll in batches or RealtimeTrigger to fire one execution per change.

io.kestra.plugin.transform.title: Transform
io.kestra.plugin.transform.description: Transform typed records, variables, and Ion data.
io.kestra.plugin.transform.body: Provide records, variables, or Ion files to filter, map, select, aggregate, unnest, or zip structured data with typed expressions, outputting transformed records or Ion data for downstream tasks.

io.kestra.plugin.clevercloud.organisatio.title: Clever Cloud Organisations
io.kestra.plugin.clevercloud.organisatio.description: Tasks and triggers for managing Clever Cloud organisations and their members.

io.kestra.plugin.phpipam.ipam.vlan.title: phpIPAM VLANs
io.kestra.plugin.phpipam.ipam.vlan.description: Tasks for managing phpIPAM VLANs (802.1Q VLAN records).

io.kestra.plugin.kafka.title: Apache Kafka
io.kestra.plugin.kafka.description: Tasks that produce, consume, and trigger workflows from Apache Kafka topics, including share-group queue semantics.
io.kestra.plugin.kafka.body: Set bootstrap servers, topic names, and serializers along with security settings (SASL/SSL) to publish messages, poll or stream consumes, and use triggers to start flows on new records. Consume and trigger tasks support both classic consumer groups and share groups for queue-style processing.

io.kestra.plugin.pipedrive.persons.title: Pipedrive Persons
io.kestra.plugin.pipedrive.persons.description: Tasks that create, retrieve, update, list, and delete persons in Pipedrive.
io.kestra.plugin.pipedrive.persons.body: Use your `apiToken` to add, retrieve, update, filter, or remove person records with properties like `name`, `email`, `phone`, and organization IDs, returning the contact data for enrichment or downstream syncing.

io.kestra.plugin.discord.title: Discord
io.kestra.plugin.discord.description: Tasks that send notifications to Discord via webhooks.
io.kestra.plugin.discord.body: Provide the Discord webhook URL and message content (optionally embeds/username/avatar) to post alerts from workflows into Discord channels.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.purestorage.volumes.title: Pure Storage FlashArray Volumes
io.kestra.plugin.ee.purestorage.volumes.description: Tasks for managing Pure Storage FlashArray volumes: list, get, create, resize, and delete.

io.kestra.plugin.aws.healthlake.title: AWS HealthLake
io.kestra.plugin.aws.healthlake.description: Tasks to manage Amazon HealthLake FHIR R4 data stores and orchestrate bulk import and export jobs as part of healthcare data pipelines.

io.kestra.plugin.kestra.dashboards.title: Kestra Dashboards
io.kestra.plugin.kestra.dashboards.description: Tasks that export Kestra dashboard chart data.
io.kestra.plugin.kestra.dashboards.body: Set the Kestra API URL, dashboard and chart identifiers, and auth token to export chart data as CSV or ION files, ready to attach to a scheduled report.

io.kestra.plugin.linear.issues.title: Linear Issues
io.kestra.plugin.linear.issues.description: Tasks that file, update, and retrieve Linear issues.
io.kestra.plugin.linear.issues.body: Provide a Linear API key with team/workspace context to create issues with required fields, update existing issues, or fetch issue data for synchronization and reporting.

io.kestra.plugin.minio.title: MinIO
io.kestra.plugin.minio.description: Tasks that interact with MinIO S3-compatible object storage.
io.kestra.plugin.minio.body: Configure endpoint, access/secret keys, bucket, and region or path-style settings to upload/download objects, list prefixes, and integrate MinIO data with workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.dropbox.title: Dropbox
io.kestra.plugin.dropbox.description: Tasks that connect Kestra workflows to Dropbox.
io.kestra.plugin.dropbox.body: Authenticate with a Dropbox access token to orchestrate file operations such as upload, download, listing, search, copy, move, delete, folder creation, and metadata retrieval; Dropbox paths should start with '/' and tasks can read or write via Kestra internal storage URIs.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.git.title: Git (EE)
io.kestra.plugin.ee.git.description: Enterprise Git tasks: clone, sync, commit, and push Kestra Apps, Blueprints, Unit Tests, and Dashboards with Git repositories.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.git.body: Use these tasks to fetch resources from a branch, reconcile them with Kestra (or preview changes with `dryRun`), and push updates back to Git. Provide the repository `url`, credentials, target `branch`, and Git subdirectories.

io.kestra.plugin.monday.webhooks.title: Monday Webhooks
io.kestra.plugin.monday.webhooks.description: Push Monday board events to an external endpoint.
io.kestra.plugin.monday.webhooks.body: Register and remove webhooks on a Monday board so external endpoints get pushed events. Use them to wire Monday board activity into a Kestra webhook trigger or another HTTP listener.

io.kestra.plugin.aws.glue.title: AWS Glue
io.kestra.plugin.aws.glue.description: Tasks that control AWS Glue jobs: start runs with arguments, monitor their status, stop executions, and fetch job metadata to orchestrate serverless Spark ETL pipelines.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.aws.cloudwatch.title: Amazon CloudWatch Log Exporter
io.kestra.plugin.ee.aws.cloudwatch.description: Tasks that send Kestra logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs for centralized monitoring.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.aws.cloudwatch.body: Configure `region`, `logGroupName`, and `logStreamName` along with AWS credentials or an assumed role to push execution logs in batches; adjust `chunk` to balance throughput and CloudWatch API usage while emitting request and log counters.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.f5.pool.title: F5 BIG-IP Pool
io.kestra.plugin.ee.f5.pool.description: Manage F5 BIG-IP LTM pools (load-balancing server groups).

io.kestra.plugin.ee.vmware.vcenter.title: VMware vCenter VMs and Templates
io.kestra.plugin.ee.vmware.vcenter.description: Tasks that manage VM lifecycle, cloning, template conversion, snapshots, and event triggers through vCenter.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.vmware.vcenter.body: Use these tasks with a vCenter server (port 443 by default), credentials, and optional trust store. Supply datacenter/host/network/datastore/ISO details as required to clone or create VMs, convert templates, control power state, and manage snapshots across clusters.

io.kestra.plugin.proxmox.container.title: Proxmox VE Containers
io.kestra.plugin.proxmox.container.description: Tasks that create, start, stop, reboot, clone, migrate, update, delete, and list LXC containers on a Proxmox VE node.
io.kestra.plugin.proxmox.container.body: Provide the node name, VMID, and connection details. Most write operations return a UPID for async tracking, which can be polled with the task.WaitForTask step.

io.kestra.plugin.monday.boards.title: Monday Boards
io.kestra.plugin.monday.boards.description: Manage Monday boards from a flow.
io.kestra.plugin.monday.boards.body: Create, get, query, update, delete, archive, and duplicate Monday boards. Useful for provisioning new boards or tearing down boards as part of an automated workflow.

io.kestra.plugin.serdes.avro.title: Avro

io.kestra.plugin.fs.nfs.title: NFS
io.kestra.plugin.fs.nfs.description: Tasks that read and write files on Network File System (NFS) mounts.

io.kestra.plugin.hubspot.companies.title: HubSpot Companies
io.kestra.plugin.hubspot.companies.description: Tasks that create, update, search, and delete HubSpot companies.
io.kestra.plugin.hubspot.companies.body: Set your HubSpot token and company properties to create or update records, search with filters, or delete by ID, returning company payloads for CRM workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.shopify.products.title: Shopify Products
io.kestra.plugin.shopify.products.description: Tasks that list or update Shopify products.
io.kestra.plugin.shopify.products.body: Authenticate with your store domain and Admin API token to list products with filters (status, publication) or update product fields, using the API version and delay settings to stay within Shopify limits.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.graylog.title: Graylog (EE)
io.kestra.plugin.ee.graylog.description: Tasks that ship Kestra execution logs to Graylog through GELF HTTP inputs.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.graylog.body: Use these tasks to centralize Flow logs in Graylog or downstream SIEMs; configure the required `endpoint` to the GELF HTTP input, optionally adjust `chunk` for batch size (default 1000) and `graylogHost` for the GELF host field (default Kestra), and supply HTTP client options if custom timeouts or authentication are needed.

io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.duckdb.title: Duckdb
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.duckdb.description: Tasks that connect to DuckDB via JDBC to run queries and loads.
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.duckdb.body: Provide the DuckDB JDBC URL, credentials (if any), and SQL statements (query, batch, load, trigger) to read or write data; configure fetch type, fetch size, and output options to return rows or files from workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.hubspot.tickets.title: HubSpot Tickets
io.kestra.plugin.hubspot.tickets.description: Tasks that create, update, search, and delete HubSpot tickets.

io.kestra.plugin.aikido.clouds.title: Aikido Clouds
io.kestra.plugin.aikido.clouds.description: Tasks for listing Aikido's connected cloud environments and their discovered cloud assets.

io.kestra.plugin.opentofu.cli.title: OpenToFu CLI
io.kestra.plugin.opentofu.cli.description: Tasks that run OpenTofu CLI commands to init, plan, apply, and destroy infrastructure.
io.kestra.plugin.opentofu.cli.body: Run OpenTofu commands inside a container with support for input files, output files, environment variables, and remote state backends such as S3, GCS, or Terraform Cloud.

io.kestra.plugin.core.output.title: Output
io.kestra.plugin.core.output.description: Tasks that expose outputs from a flow.
io.kestra.plugin.core.output.body: Use OutputValues to publish key-value outputs for downstream tasks or subflows; declare the output map and data types that consuming tasks should read.

io.kestra.plugin.kestra.namespaces.title: Kestra Namespaces

io.kestra.plugin.prefect.title: Prefect
io.kestra.plugin.prefect.description: Tasks that trigger Prefect deployments and monitor flow runs.

io.kestra.plugin.graalvm.js.title: JS - GraalVM
io.kestra.plugin.graalvm.js.description: Tasks that execute JavaScript with GraalVM.

io.kestra.plugin.resend.email.title: Resend Email

io.kestra.plugin.ai.completion.title: Completion
io.kestra.plugin.ai.completion.description: Tasks that call LLMs for chat, classification, image generation, and JSON-structured extraction, with optional tools, memory, and provider flexibility.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.f5.virtualserver.title: F5 BIG-IP Virtual Server

io.kestra.plugin.cloudflare.zones.body: Retrieve and list Cloudflare zones and inspect domain-level configuration securely using Cloudflare API tokens.

io.kestra.plugin.aws.emr.title: AWS EMR
io.kestra.plugin.aws.emr.description: Tasks that orchestrate Amazon EMR and EMR Serverless workloads: create or delete clusters, submit steps, start job runs, and optionally wait for completion so Spark or Hadoop pipelines can be managed from Kestra.

io.kestra.plugin.phpipam.title: phpIPAM

io.kestra.plugin.gcp.dataproc.batches.title: Google Cloud Dataproc Batches
io.kestra.plugin.gcp.dataproc.batches.description: Run Spark and Hadoop jobs on-demand without managing clusters. Process large-scale data with Dataproc Batches.

io.kestra.plugin.aikido.domains.title: Aikido Domains
io.kestra.plugin.aikido.domains.description: Tasks for listing and scanning domains connected to Aikido's surface/DAST monitoring.

io.kestra.plugin.gcp.monitoring.title: Google Cloud Monitoring (Observability)

io.kestra.plugin.zendesk.tickets.title: Zendesk Tickets

io.kestra.plugin.huawei.functiongraph.title: Huawei FunctionGraph
io.kestra.plugin.huawei.functiongraph.description: Tasks for Huawei Cloud FunctionGraph: synchronously invoke serverless functions and capture their responses.

io.kestra.plugin.shopify.customers.title: Shopify Customers

io.kestra.plugin.ee.azure.title: Azure (EE)
io.kestra.plugin.ee.azure.description: Tasks that integrate Microsoft Azure services into Kestra enterprise workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.newrelic.title: New Relic (EE)

io.kestra.plugin.ee.dellemc.powerstore.a.title: Dell EMC PowerStore Arrays

io.kestra.plugin.trivy.cli.title: Trivy
io.kestra.plugin.trivy.cli.description: Tasks that execute arbitrary Trivy CLI commands.

io.kestra.plugin.monday.query.title: Monday Query
io.kestra.plugin.monday.query.body: Run an arbitrary Monday GraphQL query or mutation. Use this as an escape hatch when no dedicated task covers the operation.

io.kestra.plugin.typesense.title: Typesense
io.kestra.plugin.typesense.description: Tasks that load data into and query Typesense collections.

io.kestra.plugin.sifflet.title: Sifflet

io.kestra.plugin.datagen.title: Datagen
io.kestra.plugin.datagen.description: Tasks that produce synthetic data payloads for triggering and exercising Kestra workflows.
io.kestra.plugin.datagen.body: Use Datagen to simulate events without external sources by pairing core tasks or triggers with JSON, string, or byte generators. io.kestra.plugin.modal.title: Modal
io.kestra.plugin.modal.description: Tasks that run Modal workflows via the Modal CLI.
io.kestra.plugin.modal.body: Use your Modal token and profile to execute Modal CLI commands from Kestra, letting you launch functions, manage deployments, or run images with captured output.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.gcp.cloudrun.title: Google Cloud Run
io.kestra.plugin.ee.gcp.cloudrun.description: Tasks that orchestrate existing Google Cloud Run Jobs from a Kestra flow.

io.kestra.plugin.aws.cli.title: AWS CLI
io.kestra.plugin.aws.cli.description: Tasks that run AWS CLI commands (inside a container by default), reuse Kestra credentials and environment variables, and capture stdout or files produced by the CLI.

io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.sqlite.title: SQLite

io.kestra.plugin.graalvm.python.title: Python - GraalVM

io.kestra.plugin.kestra.ee.iam.groups.title: Kestra IAM Groups

io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.csp.dhcp.fi.title: Infoblox Universal DDI DHCP Fixed Addresses

io.kestra.plugin.ceph.rbd.images.title: Ceph RBD Images

io.kestra.plugin.core.log.title: Log

io.kestra.plugin.scripts.ruby.title: Ruby

io.kestra.plugin.pipedrive.title: Pipedrive
io.kestra.plugin.pipedrive.description: Tasks that manage Pipedrive deals and persons.
io.kestra.plugin.pipedrive.body: Authenticate with your Pipedrive `apiToken` (and optional `apiUrl`) to create or update deals and create or fetch people records, returning the API payloads for routing to CRM or reporting steps.

io.kestra.plugin.digitalocean.loadbalanc.title: DigitalOcean Load Balancer
io.kestra.plugin.digitalocean.loadbalanc.description: Tasks for managing DigitalOcean load balancers.
io.kestra.plugin.digitalocean.loadbalanc.body: List, read, create, update, and delete load balancers, including their forwarding rules and attached droplets.

io.kestra.plugin.twilio.notify.sms.title: Twilio SMS
io.kestra.plugin.twilio.notify.sms.description: Tasks that send SMS messages via the Twilio Programmable Messaging API.
io.kestra.plugin.twilio.notify.sms.body: Provide Twilio account SID, auth token, and from/to phone numbers to send SMS messages from Kestra workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.crowdstrike.spotligh.title: CrowdStrike Spotlight
io.kestra.plugin.ee.crowdstrike.spotligh.description: Tasks and triggers for searching vulnerabilities detected by CrowdStrike Falcon Spotlight.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.crowdstrike.spotligh.body: Search Spotlight vulnerabilities with FQL, with FetchType support for large result sets, and trigger a flow on new vulnerabilities.

io.kestra.plugin.docker.cli.title: Docker CLI
io.kestra.plugin.docker.cli.description: Docker tasks for building images, running containers, and managing artifacts from Kestra workflows.
io.kestra.plugin.docker.cli.body: Requires access to a Docker daemon via host socket or TCP endpoint; the caller inherits daemon permissions, so scope access carefully. Tasks cover build, image listing, push/pull, tagging, Compose execution, container lifecycle, and pruning. Registry auth is optional and set per task; pass tags, compose files, and run options explicitly.

io.kestra.plugin.fs.sftp.title: SFTP (SSH File Transfer Protocol)
io.kestra.plugin.fs.sftp.description: Tasks that manage files over SFTP with SSH authentication.
io.kestra.plugin.fs.sftp.body: Provide host/port plus username and password or private key, then list, upload, download, move, or delete files and enable triggers for new remote files using remote/local paths and optional host key settings.

io.kestra.plugin.cloudflare.d1.title: Cloudflare D1
io.kestra.plugin.cloudflare.d1.description: Tasks that manage Cloudflare D1 serverless SQLite databases and run SQL against them.
io.kestra.plugin.cloudflare.d1.body: Create, retrieve, list, and delete D1 databases. Execute parameterized SQL queries with configurable fetch modes (FETCH_ONE, FETCH, STORE, NONE), run raw column-oriented queries, export full SQL dumps to Kestra internal storage, and import SQL files back into a database.

io.kestra.plugin.kestra.triggers.title: Kestra Triggers
io.kestra.plugin.kestra.triggers.description: Triggers that react to or monitor resources within a Kestra instance.
io.kestra.plugin.kestra.triggers.body: Use the Kestra API URL, authentication, and optional filters to monitor schedules, flows, namespaces, or other triggerable conditions and produce executions based on system state.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.dns.pt.title: Infoblox DNS PTR Records
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.dns.pt.description: Tasks to manage DNS PTR records in Infoblox via the WAPI REST API.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.dns.pt.body: List, create, update, and delete DNS PTR record objects in Infoblox.

io.kestra.plugin.debezium.mysql.title: Debezium MySQL
io.kestra.plugin.debezium.mysql.description: Tasks that ingest MySQL change data capture streams in Kestra using Debezium.
io.kestra.plugin.debezium.mysql.body: Capture, Trigger, and RealtimeTrigger rely on the Debezium MySQL connector to write CDC records to Kestra storage and start flows. Configure hostname/port, credentials, a unique `serverId`, snapshotMode, and any include/exclude filters; use Trigger to batch events with maxRecords/duration controls or RealtimeTrigger for one execution per row.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.aws.runner.title: AWS Task Runners
io.kestra.plugin.ee.aws.runner.description: Task runners that run Kestra workloads on AWS Batch (ECS Fargate/EC2 or EKS compute environments) or natively on a plain EC2 instance.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.aws.runner.body: `Batch` requires `computeEnvironmentArn` (and typically `jobQueueArn`) plus AWS credentials or an assumed role. Set a `bucket` when using `inputFiles`, `outputFiles`, or working directory sync, and ensure the task defines a `containerImage`. On ECS, tune `executionRoleArn` and `taskRoleArn` as needed. On EKS those roles are ignored and IAM access is granted through `serviceAccountName` with IRSA. Resources, polling, and resume/cleanup options can be tuned to fit your Batch environment. `Ec2` ignores `containerImage`: it launches a plain instance from `amiId` and runs task commands natively via AWS Systems Manager Run Command, requiring an `iamInstanceProfile` granting SSM access and an AMI with the SSM Agent installed.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.range.title: Infoblox DHCP Ranges
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.range.description: Tasks to manage IPv4 DHCP ranges in Infoblox via the WAPI REST API.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.range.body: List, create, update, and delete IPv4 DHCP range objects in Infoblox.

io.kestra.plugin.gemini.title: Gemini
io.kestra.plugin.gemini.description: Tasks that call Google Gemini models for text, chat, structured outputs, multimodal prompts, and video generation.
io.kestra.plugin.gemini.body: Provide your Gemini `apiKey` and target `model` to send prompts for text, chat, or video creation, including structured and multimodal requests, and receive predictions with usage metrics you can route through flows.

io.kestra.plugin.openai.title: OpenAI
io.kestra.plugin.openai.description: Tasks that call OpenAI for chat completions, images, and file uploads.
io.kestra.plugin.openai.body: Set your OpenAI API key (and optional base URL/org) plus model names to generate chat responses, create images, or upload files for fine-tuning, returning results and usage details for downstream steps.

io.kestra.plugin.dagger.title: Dagger
io.kestra.plugin.dagger.description: Tasks that run Dagger pipelines, commands, and scripts from Kestra.
io.kestra.plugin.dagger.body: Run Dagger CLI pipelines from Kestra using `Commands` for one or more inline pipeline expressions or `Script` for an inline multi-step script. Both run through a script task runner (Process or Docker) and auto-install a pinned, checksum-verified Dagger CLI when it is not already available.

io.kestra.plugin.linkedin.title: LinkedIn
io.kestra.plugin.linkedin.description: Tasks that authenticate with LinkedIn and fetch post analytics or comment triggers.
io.kestra.plugin.linkedin.body: Use OAuth2 credentials to obtain LinkedIn access tokens, poll for new comments, and retrieve analytics for organization posts; configure organization URNs, post IDs, and auth secrets to drive social reporting workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.cloudflare.waf.accessru.title: Cloudflare IP Access Rules
io.kestra.plugin.cloudflare.waf.accessru.description: Tasks that manage Cloudflare IP Access Rules.
io.kestra.plugin.cloudflare.waf.accessru.body: Create, delete, and list IP Access Rules at the account or zone level. Control traffic by blocking, challenging, or allowing IP addresses, IP ranges, ASNs, and countries to automate security and threat response workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.ai.embeddings.title: Embeddings
io.kestra.plugin.ai.embeddings.description: Tasks that provision embeddings stores (Chroma, PGVector, Pinecone, Redis, Qdrant, etc.) for chunk storage and similarity search powering RAG flows.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.elasticsearch.title: Elasticsearch (EE)
io.kestra.plugin.ee.elasticsearch.description: Tasks that push Kestra data to Elasticsearch clusters for search and analytics.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.elasticsearch.body: Use these tasks to bulk-export execution logs into a target index via Elasticsearch’s REST API. Configure hosts (with scheme/port), optional basic auth and headers, and tune bulk chunk size to balance throughput and memory.

io.kestra.plugin.spark.title: Apache Spark
io.kestra.plugin.spark.description: Tasks that submit Apache Spark jobs and run Spark CLI commands.
io.kestra.plugin.spark.body: Provide the Spark master/cluster config, application artifact (JAR, Python file, or R script), main class or entry point, and args to launch jobs with optional driver/executor settings; SparkCLI lets you run ad-hoc spark-submit commands and capture logs for orchestration.

io.kestra.plugin.proxmox.title: Proxmox VE
io.kestra.plugin.proxmox.description: Tasks that manage the full lifecycle of QEMU VMs and LXC containers on Proxmox VE, including backups, snapshots, cluster introspection, and network inspection.
io.kestra.plugin.proxmox.body: Provide host, port, node, and either a username/password pair or an API token to authenticate. Covers VM and container lifecycle (create, start, stop, clone, migrate, delete), backup and snapshot management, cluster and pool introspection, network interface and firewall inspection, template management, and async task polling via UPID.

io.kestra.plugin.scripts.bun.title: Bun
io.kestra.plugin.scripts.bun.body: Provide inline Bun/JavaScript code or script files with optional packages and arguments to execute via Bun, capturing stdout/stderr and output files for downstream steps.

io.kestra.plugin.opentofu.title: OpenTofu
io.kestra.plugin.opentofu.description: Tasks that run OpenTofu CLI commands to init, plan, apply, and destroy infrastructure.
io.kestra.plugin.opentofu.body: Run OpenTofu commands inside a container with support for input files, output files, environment variables, and remote state backends such as S3, GCS, or Terraform Cloud.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.netapp.ontap.replica.title: NetApp ONTAP SnapMirror Replication
io.kestra.plugin.ee.netapp.ontap.replica.description: Tasks for managing NetApp ONTAP SnapMirror replication relationships.

io.kestra.plugin.pagerduty.title: PagerDuty
io.kestra.plugin.pagerduty.description: Tasks that send events to PagerDuty.
io.kestra.plugin.pagerduty.body: Provide a PagerDuty routing/integration key with summary, source, severity, and optional custom details to trigger incidents or alerts from Kestra workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.kestra.ee.iam.tenantAcc.title: Kestra IAM Tenant Access
io.kestra.plugin.kestra.ee.iam.tenantAcc.description: Tasks that grant or revoke tenant-level access for users.
io.kestra.plugin.kestra.ee.iam.tenantAcc.body: Set the Kestra API URL and auth token to assign or remove a user's access to the current tenant, enabling automated tenant membership management from orchestrated workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.azure.eventhubs.title: Azure Event Hubs
io.kestra.plugin.azure.eventhubs.description: Tasks that publish, consume, and trigger on Azure Event Hubs streams.
io.kestra.plugin.azure.eventhubs.body: Supply the namespace, eventHubName, and connectionString; consumers set a consumerGroup and blob checkpoint store (container name and connection string) with starting positions, while producers support multiple body serializers for sending events.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.aws.s3.title: Amazon S3 Log Exporter
io.kestra.plugin.ee.aws.s3.description: Tasks that export Kestra logs to Amazon S3 for durable storage and downstream analysis.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.aws.s3.body: Provide `region` and a target `bucket` with AWS credentials or an assumed role; choose JSON or ION format, control file naming with `logFilePrefix`, and tune `chunk`/`maxLinesPerFile` to manage upload batches and file sizes while capturing upload metrics.

io.kestra.plugin.netskope.title: Netskope
io.kestra.plugin.netskope.description: Netskope Security Cloud plugin for Kestra

io.kestra.plugin.x.title: X
io.kestra.plugin.x.description: Tasks that post messages to X (formerly Twitter).
io.kestra.plugin.x.body: Provide X API credentials and post content to publish tweets from Kestra workflows, handling auth and response payloads.

io.kestra.plugin.slack.app.reactions.title: Slack Reactions
io.kestra.plugin.slack.app.reactions.description: Tasks that add, remove, or fetch reactions on Slack messages.
io.kestra.plugin.slack.app.reactions.body: Provide a bot `token` with reactions scopes plus the target `channel`, message `timestamp`, and emoji `name`; retrieval can return all users on a message for auditing or routing. Useful for lightweight approvals, acknowledgments, or counting engagement.

io.kestra.plugin.phpipam.ipam.subnet.title: phpIPAM Subnets
io.kestra.plugin.phpipam.ipam.subnet.description: Tasks for managing phpIPAM subnets, including search and first-free lookup.

io.kestra.plugin.netskope.remediation.title: Netskope Remediation
io.kestra.plugin.netskope.remediation.description: Action-oriented tasks for automated security response in Netskope Security Cloud, suitable for SOAR workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.microsoft.fabric.onelak.title: Microsoft Fabric OneLake
io.kestra.plugin.microsoft.fabric.onelak.description: Tasks to upload, download, and delete files in Microsoft Fabric OneLake using the ADLS Gen2 API.

io.kestra.plugin.terraform.title: Terraform
io.kestra.plugin.terraform.description: Tasks that run Terraform commands from Kestra.
io.kestra.plugin.terraform.body: Provide Terraform configuration paths, backend/env variables, and CLI arguments to init, plan, apply, or destroy infrastructure, capturing outputs and state paths for deployment pipelines.

io.kestra.plugin.git.title: Git
io.kestra.plugin.git.description: Tasks that clone, fetch, and interact with Git repositories.
io.kestra.plugin.git.body: Provide a repository URL with branch/tag/ref, optional credentials or SSH keys, and working directory settings to clone or update repositories, handle submodules, and make source available to downstream tasks.

io.kestra.plugin.surrealdb.title: SurrealDB
io.kestra.plugin.surrealdb.description: Tasks that run SurrealQL queries against SurrealDB.
io.kestra.plugin.surrealdb.body: Provide SurrealDB endpoint details (namespace, database, username/password or token) and SurrealQL statements to query or mutate data, returning results and metrics for downstream workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.azure.datafactory.title: Azure Data Factory
io.kestra.plugin.azure.datafactory.description: Tasks that start and monitor Azure Data Factory pipelines for ETL and integration.
io.kestra.plugin.azure.datafactory.body: Provide Azure AD credentials plus subscriptionId, resourceGroupName, factoryName, and pipelineName; pass pipeline parameters as needed and choose to wait for completion to collect activity counts and run duration metrics.

io.kestra.plugin.sqlmesh.title: SQLMesh
io.kestra.plugin.sqlmesh.body: Provide SQLMesh project paths/configs and CLI options to plan, run, or apply SQLMesh workflows from Kestra, capturing outputs for deployment pipelines.

io.kestra.plugin.aws.auth.title: AWS Authentication
io.kestra.plugin.aws.auth.description: Tasks that generate authentication material for AWS services, such as short-lived tokens to access Amazon EKS clusters.

io.kestra.plugin.gcp.gke.title: Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)
io.kestra.plugin.gcp.gke.description: Deploy and manage containerized applications on GKE. Orchestrate Kubernetes workloads alongside your data pipelines.

io.kestra.plugin.linear.title: Linear
io.kestra.plugin.linear.description: Tasks that create, update, and search Linear issues.
io.kestra.plugin.linear.body: Set a Linear API key and workspace/team details to file issues with titles/descriptions, update statuses or labels, and query issues for planning workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.kestra.ee.locks.title: Kestra Asset Locks
io.kestra.plugin.kestra.ee.locks.description: Tasks to acquire and release execution-owned locks on Kestra EE data assets.
io.kestra.plugin.kestra.ee.locks.body: Set the Kestra API URL and auth token to acquire a time-bounded lock on an asset for the current execution, or release a lock this execution owns.

io.kestra.plugin.notifications.sendgrid.title: Sendgrid
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.sendgrid.description: Tasks that send email via SendGrid.
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.sendgrid.body: Set the SendGrid API key, from/to addresses, subject, and content (plus optional templates and attachments) to deliver emails through SendGrid from Kestra workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.sybase.title: Sybase
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.sybase.description: Tasks that connect to Sybase via JDBC to run queries and loads.
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.sybase.body: Provide the Sybase JDBC URL, credentials, and SQL statements (query, batch, load, trigger) to read or write data; configure fetch type, fetch size, and output options to return rows or files from workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.digitalocean.droplet.title: DigitalOcean Droplet
io.kestra.plugin.digitalocean.droplet.description: Tasks and a trigger for managing DigitalOcean droplets (virtual machines).
io.kestra.plugin.digitalocean.droplet.body: List, read, create, resize or run power actions on, and delete droplets. A polling trigger fires when a new droplet appears on the account.

io.kestra.plugin.core.namespace.title: Namespace
io.kestra.plugin.core.namespace.description: Tasks that manage namespace files and versions.
io.kestra.plugin.core.namespace.body: Upload, download, delete, purge, or version files stored in a namespace—useful for shipping assets or configs with flows; set the target namespace, paths or glob patterns, and purge behavior to control stored artifacts.

io.kestra.plugin.core.dashboard.data.title: Data
io.kestra.plugin.core.dashboard.data.description: Tasks that fetch Kestra executions, flows, logs, metrics, and triggers as datasets for dashboards.
io.kestra.plugin.core.dashboard.data.body: These data providers query Kestra repositories with filters and aggregations to feed dashboard charts; configure columns and fields (such as namespace, state, timestamp, or labels) plus any filters to shape the returned dataset for visualization.

io.kestra.plugin.ai.provider.title: Provider
io.kestra.plugin.ai.provider.description: Tasks that configure Large Language Model providers (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, Mistral, Bedrock, etc.) to supply chat/completion models used across the AI plugins.

io.kestra.plugin.hex.projects.title: Hex Projects
io.kestra.plugin.hex.projects.description: Run a Hex project and react when a run completes.
io.kestra.plugin.hex.projects.body: Start the latest published version of a Hex project and optionally wait for completion, or trigger a flow when a project's most recent run reaches COMPLETED. Requires an `apiToken` (Hex API key) and a `projectId`; override `baseUrl` only for a self-hosted Hex region.

io.kestra.plugin.meta.whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
io.kestra.plugin.meta.whatsapp.description: Tasks that send WhatsApp messages (via Twilio API).
io.kestra.plugin.meta.whatsapp.body: Use Twilio WhatsApp credentials with from/to numbers and message content to push WhatsApp notifications from Kestra workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.splunk.events.title: Splunk Events
io.kestra.plugin.ee.splunk.events.description: Tasks for sending and querying Splunk events.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.splunk.events.body: Use Send to ingest event data via the HTTP Event Collector (HEC) and Search to run SPL queries against the Splunk management API.

io.kestra.plugin.gcp.auth.title: Google Cloud Auth
io.kestra.plugin.gcp.auth.description: Fetch Google Cloud OAuth access tokens for use by downstream tasks or external systems.

io.kestra.plugin.aws.s3.files.title: AWS S3 Files
io.kestra.plugin.aws.s3.files.description: Tasks for managing Amazon S3 Files file systems and mount targets (S3 buckets mountable as NFS v4.1+ file systems).

io.kestra.plugin.notion.database.title: Notion Databases
io.kestra.plugin.notion.database.description: Tasks that query and manage items in Notion databases.
io.kestra.plugin.notion.database.body: Use a Notion integration token and database IDs to query database rows, create new items with typed properties, and update or archive existing items.

io.kestra.plugin.odoo.title: Odoo
io.kestra.plugin.odoo.description: Tasks that call the Odoo XML-RPC API for ERP automation.
io.kestra.plugin.odoo.body: Provide the Odoo server URL, database, username, and password to authenticate, then run create, read, update, or search operations on models; include model name, fields, and filters to orchestrate ERP data from Kestra flows.

io.kestra.plugin.azure.function.title: Azure Function
io.kestra.plugin.azure.function.description: Tasks that invoke Azure Functions over HTTP and return responses to flows.
io.kestra.plugin.azure.function.body: Trigger Azure Functions over HTTP and capture their responses for downstream steps. Provide the function URL (including function key), choose the HTTP method, and pass an optional JSON body; configurable timeouts help avoid long-running calls, and responses are returned as parsed JSON when possible.

io.kestra.plugin.github.pulls.title: GitHub Pull Requests
io.kestra.plugin.github.pulls.description: Tasks that search and open GitHub pull requests.
io.kestra.plugin.github.pulls.body: Use a GitHub token with owner/repo, base/head branches, and PR metadata (title, body, reviewers) to create pull requests or search existing ones, returning PR details for review flows.

io.kestra.plugin.cloudflare.workers.scri.title: Cloudflare Worker Scripts
io.kestra.plugin.cloudflare.workers.scri.description: Tasks that manage Cloudflare Worker scripts as resources via the Workers Scripts REST API.
io.kestra.plugin.cloudflare.workers.scri.body: Deploy, list, get, and delete Cloudflare Worker scripts on an account. Companion to `io.kestra.plugin.cloudflare.workers.dynamic.Run`, which invokes inline code through a gateway Worker.

io.kestra.plugin.cassandra.standard.title: Apache Cassandra
io.kestra.plugin.cassandra.standard.description: Tasks that run CQL queries or polling triggers against self-managed Apache Cassandra clusters.
io.kestra.plugin.cassandra.standard.body: Use these tasks to execute queries or fire triggers with a Cassandra session built from contact endpoints, optional local datacenter, credentials, and SSL truststore/keystore details. Use `fetchType` (FETCH, FETCH_ONE, STORE, or NONE) so downstream steps can consume result rows while reusing the same connection schema across query and trigger tasks.

io.kestra.plugin.jira.issues.title: Jira Issues
io.kestra.plugin.jira.issues.description: Tasks that file, update, comment on, and search Jira issues.
io.kestra.plugin.jira.issues.body: Set Jira connection details and credentials, provide project keys, issue types/fields, and JQL to create or update issues, add comments, or retrieve issue details for workflow automation.

io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.arrowflight.title: Arrow Flight
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.arrowflight.description: Tasks that connect to Apache Arrow Flight SQL via JDBC to run queries and loads.
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.arrowflight.body: Provide the Arrow Flight JDBC URL, credentials, and SQL statements (query, batch, load, trigger) to read or write data; configure fetch type, fetch size, and output options to return rows or files from workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.aws.ecr.title: AWS ECR
io.kestra.plugin.aws.ecr.description: Tasks that fetch an Amazon ECR authorization token for Docker or OCI registry logins, useful before building or pulling images in workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.googleworkspace.calenda.title: Google Calendar
io.kestra.plugin.googleworkspace.calenda.description: Tasks that create, update, delete, and watch Google Calendar events.
io.kestra.plugin.googleworkspace.calenda.body: Provide OAuth or service-account credentials with Calendar scopes plus calendar IDs to insert, update, list, or delete events, and enable the event trigger to launch flows when new events are created.

io.kestra.plugin.ai.memory.title: Memory
io.kestra.plugin.ai.memory.description: Tasks that supply conversational memory backends (Kestra KV Store, Redis, PostgreSQL) to persist recent messages for agents and chat completions.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.solarwinds.ipam.dhcp.title: SolarWinds IPAM DHCP Scopes
io.kestra.plugin.ee.solarwinds.ipam.dhcp.description: List and get DHCP scopes tracked in SolarWinds Orion IPAM.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.solarwinds.ipam.dhcp.body: Inspect DHCP scopes tracked in SolarWinds Orion IPAM: list all scopes or filter by subnet ID, and retrieve individual scope details including address range and DHCP server association.

io.kestra.plugin.camunda.title: Camunda
io.kestra.plugin.camunda.description: Interact with a Camunda 8 cluster from Kestra flows.
io.kestra.plugin.camunda.body:
Camunda 8 is a process orchestrator built around BPMN. This plugin talks to a Camunda 8 cluster
with the official `camunda-client-java` client, so Kestra flows can drive Camunda process
instances and Camunda service tasks can be implemented as Kestra flows.

It covers deploying BPMN, DMN and form resources, starting and cancelling process instances,
publishing correlation messages, holding a job worker open as a realtime trigger, and completing
the activated job from the flow.

Authentication supports no credentials (development clusters), Basic auth, OAuth2 against a
self-managed identity provider, and Camunda SaaS client credentials.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.azure.runner.title: Azure Runner
io.kestra.plugin.ee.azure.runner.description: Tasks that run Kestra workloads on Azure Batch pools or Azure Virtual Machines, with live log streaming.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.azure.runner.body: Use the Batch task runner to execute containerized tasks on an existing Batch pool, resume jobs when possible, and stream stdout/stderr; requires `endpoint`, `account`, `accessKey`, `poolId`, and a `containerImage`, plus `blobStorage` when exchanging input, output, or namespace files. Use the VirtualMachine task runner to execute tasks natively (no container) on a launched or reused Azure VM via the Run Command API. It requires `subscriptionId` and `resourceGroupName`, plus `region`/`vmSize`/`subnetId` (an already existing subnet) when provisioning a new VM, or `vmName` to target an already existing VM instead, and `blobStorage` when exchanging input, output, or namespace files. A VM targeted through `vmName` is never stopped or deleted by this runner.

io.kestra.plugin.huggingface.title: Huggingface
io.kestra.plugin.huggingface.description: Tasks that call Hugging Face Inference APIs.
io.kestra.plugin.huggingface.body: Set your Hugging Face token, model endpoint, and payload (text, image, or other inputs) to run hosted models via the Inference API and return predictions for downstream tasks.

io.kestra.plugin.xquik.tweets.title: Xquik Tweets
io.kestra.plugin.xquik.tweets.description: Tasks that search and retrieve public X/Twitter posts with Xquik.
io.kestra.plugin.xquik.tweets.body: Use these tasks to search public posts, fetch one post by ID, and store larger responses in Kestra internal storage. Set `apiKey` with `{{ secret('XQUIK_API_KEY') }}`.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.solarwinds.ipam.ipno.title: SolarWinds IPAM IP Nodes
io.kestra.plugin.ee.solarwinds.ipam.ipno.description: List, get, allocate, release, and update individual IP node records in SolarWinds Orion IPAM.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.solarwinds.ipam.ipno.body: Manage IP node records in SolarWinds Orion IPAM: list nodes by subnet or status, retrieve individual nodes by ID, allocate new IP addresses via two-phase reservation, release addresses back to available, and update DNS names or status.

io.kestra.plugin.monday.title: Monday
io.kestra.plugin.monday.description: Drive Monday from a Kestra flow via its GraphQL API.
io.kestra.plugin.monday.body: Plugin for Monday's GraphQL API, covering boards, groups, columns, items, subitems, comments, users, workspaces, webhooks, folders, teams, and notifications. Includes a generic query task as an escape hatch and a polling trigger that reacts to new or updated items.

io.kestra.plugin.n8n.title: n8n
io.kestra.plugin.n8n.description: Tasks that trigger n8n workflows from Kestra.
io.kestra.plugin.n8n.body: Configure n8n webhook URLs and optional auth headers to start n8n workflows and pass payloads from Kestra executions, enabling cross-orchestration between the two platforms.

io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.actianvector.title: Actian Vector
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.actianvector.description: Tasks that connect to Actian Vector via JDBC to run queries and loads.
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.actianvector.body: Provide the Actian Vector JDBC URL, credentials, and SQL statements (query, batch, load, trigger) to read or write data; configure fetch type, fetch size, and output options to return rows or files from workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.microsoft365.oneshare.title: MicrosoftOneShare
io.kestra.plugin.microsoft365.oneshare.description: Tasks that manage OneDrive/SharePoint files with a unified interface and trigger on file changes.
io.kestra.plugin.microsoft365.oneshare.body: Use Graph credentials with drive or site identifiers to list, upload, export, download, or delete files and enable the polling trigger to react to create/update events; ensure `driveId`/`itemPath` and permissions are set for the target library.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.csp.ipam.su.title: Infoblox Universal DDI Subnets
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.csp.ipam.su.description: Tasks to manage subnets (ipam/subnet) in Infoblox Universal DDI (Cloud Services Portal).
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.csp.ipam.su.body: List, get, create, update, and delete subnet objects, the Universal DDI equivalent of a NIOS leaf network.

io.kestra.plugin.dagster.title: Dagster
io.kestra.plugin.dagster.description: Tasks that trigger Dagster jobs via the GraphQL API and optionally wait for results so Kestra flows can orchestrate runs.
io.kestra.plugin.dagster.body: Launch Dagster jobs from Kestra while passing run configuration and tags. Requires baseUrl, location, repository, and jobName; provide headers for authentication and tune wait, maxDuration, and pollFrequency when monitoring until completion.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.solarwinds.ipam.supe.title: SolarWinds IPAM Supernets
io.kestra.plugin.ee.solarwinds.ipam.supe.description: List, get, create, update, and delete IPAM supernet aggregations in SolarWinds Orion.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.solarwinds.ipam.supe.body: Manage IPAM supernet aggregations in SolarWinds Orion: list all supernets, retrieve individual supernets by ID, create new aggregation blocks, update existing supernets, and delete them when they are no longer needed.

io.kestra.plugin.notifications.sentry.title: Sentry
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.sentry.description: Tasks that send events to Sentry.
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.sentry.body: Provide the Sentry DSN and event payload (message, level, tags, extras) to capture errors or alerts in Sentry from Kestra flows.

io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.postgresql.title: PostgreSQL
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.postgresql.description: Tasks that connect to PostgreSQL via JDBC to run queries and loads.
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.postgresql.body: Provide the PostgreSQL JDBC URL, credentials, and SQL statements (query, batch, load, trigger) to read or write data; configure fetch type, fetch size, and output options to return rows or files from workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.gitlab.mergerequests.title: GitLab Merge Requests
io.kestra.plugin.gitlab.mergerequests.description: Tasks that create, update, and fetch GitLab Merge Requests.
io.kestra.plugin.gitlab.mergerequests.body: Set the GitLab host name, project ID, and access token to handle Merge Requests.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.gcp.gcs.title: Cloud Storage Log Exporter
io.kestra.plugin.ee.gcp.gcs.description: Tasks that export Kestra logs to Google Cloud Storage for durable archiving.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.gcp.gcs.body: Leverage the log exporter to stream workflow logs into a GCS bucket as JSON or ION with configurable file prefixes, chunking, and max lines per file. Provide projectId and bucket, optionally set service account or impersonation, and tune format, logFilePrefix, maxLinesPerFile, and chunk to match your retention or downstream analytics needs.

io.kestra.plugin.mistral.title: Mistral
io.kestra.plugin.mistral.description: Tasks and triggers for Mistral AI: chat completions and workflow orchestration.
io.kestra.plugin.mistral.body: Provide your Mistral API key to generate chat completions, run Mistral Workflow executions, or react to Mistral workflow events — all from within orchestrated Kestra flows.
