io.kestra.plugin.redis.pubsub.title: Redis PubSub
io.kestra.plugin.redis.pubsub.description: Tasks that publish and subscribe to Redis channels.
io.kestra.plugin.redis.pubsub.body: Configure Redis connection, channel names, and payloads to publish messages or subscribe with triggers that start flows when messages are received.

io.kestra.plugin.deepseek.title: DeepSeek
io.kestra.plugin.deepseek.description: Tasks that call DeepSeek chat models for conversational or schema-guided JSON responses.
io.kestra.plugin.deepseek.body: Use DeepSeek ChatCompletion to orchestrate role-based conversations or JSON-only replies within Kestra Flows. Requires `apiKey`, `modelName`, and `messages`; defaults `baseUrl` to `https://api.deepseek.com/v1` for OpenAI-compatible routing. Add `jsonResponseSchema` to enable JSON Mode with a prepended schema reminder; DeepSeek treats the schema as guidance rather than server-side validation.

io.kestra.plugin.telegram.title: Telegram
io.kestra.plugin.telegram.description: Tasks that send notifications via Telegram bots.
io.kestra.plugin.telegram.body: Set your Telegram bot token and chat ID to send messages (text or markdown) from Kestra workflows to chats or channels.

io.kestra.plugin.crypto.title: Cryptography
io.kestra.plugin.crypto.description: Tasks that secure files in Kestra pipelines using OpenPGP encryption, decryption, and signature validation.
io.kestra.plugin.crypto.body: Use this plugin when you need to protect files end-to-end with OpenPGP: provide internal storage URIs as inputs, public keys and recipient lists for encryption, and private keys with optional signer keys for decryption and verification. Tasks write the processed file back to Kestra storage and return its URI for downstream steps.

io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.db2.title: DB2
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.db2.description: Tasks that connect to IBM DB2 via JDBC to run queries and loads.
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.db2.body: Provide the DB2 JDBC URL, credentials, and SQL statements (query, batch, load, trigger) to read or write data; configure fetch type, fetch size, and output options to return rows or files from workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.proxmox.vm.title: Proxmox VE VM
io.kestra.plugin.proxmox.vm.description: Tasks that create, start, stop, reboot, reset, clone, migrate, update, delete, and list QEMU virtual machines on a Proxmox VE node.
io.kestra.plugin.proxmox.vm.body: Provide the node name, VMID, and connection details. Most write operations return a UPID for async tracking, which can be polled with the task.WaitForTask step. Includes a polling trigger that fires when a VM reaches a target status.

io.kestra.plugin.aws.msk.title: AWS MSK
io.kestra.plugin.aws.msk.description: Tasks to manage Amazon MSK (Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka) cluster lifecycle and retrieve bootstrap broker connection strings for use with plugin-kafka.

io.kestra.plugin.notifications.discord.title: Discord
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.discord.description: Tasks that send notifications to Discord via webhooks.
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.discord.body: Provide the Discord webhook URL and message content (optionally embeds/username/avatar) to post alerts from workflows into Discord channels.

io.kestra.plugin.digitalocean.firewall.title: DigitalOcean Firewall
io.kestra.plugin.digitalocean.firewall.description: Tasks for managing DigitalOcean cloud firewalls.
io.kestra.plugin.digitalocean.firewall.body: List, read, create, and delete cloud firewalls, including their inbound and outbound rules.

io.kestra.plugin.tika.title: Apache Tika
io.kestra.plugin.tika.description: Tasks that extract text and metadata from files using Apache Tika.
io.kestra.plugin.tika.body: Provide input files to detect content type and extract text or metadata across many formats (PDF, Office, images, etc.), returning parsed content for further processing in workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.microsoft.fabric.wareho.title: Microsoft Fabric Warehouse
io.kestra.plugin.microsoft.fabric.wareho.description: Tasks to query Microsoft Fabric Warehouse using SQL over JDBC.

io.kestra.plugin.pinecone.title: Pinecone
io.kestra.plugin.pinecone.description: Interact with Pinecone, a managed vector database, from your Kestra workflows. Create serverless indexes, upsert vectors, query by similarity, fetch or delete vectors by ID, and inspect index statistics.

io.kestra.plugin.hubspot.title: HubSpot
io.kestra.plugin.hubspot.description: Tasks that create, update, search, and delete HubSpot CRM objects.
io.kestra.plugin.hubspot.body: Provide a HubSpot private app token and object details to manage contacts, companies, deals, and tickets, using search filters or property payloads and receiving the API responses for downstream automation.

io.kestra.plugin.microsoft365.teams.title: Microsoft Teams
io.kestra.plugin.microsoft365.teams.description: Tasks that send notifications to Microsoft Teams.
io.kestra.plugin.microsoft365.teams.body: Provide the Teams incoming webhook URL and message payload (text or cards) to post alerts from Kestra flows into Teams channels. For sending rich Adaptive Cards to a specific channel or user via the Microsoft Graph API instead of a webhook, see the `teams.adaptivecards` sub-package.

io.kestra.plugin.terraform.cli.title: Terraform CLI
io.kestra.plugin.terraform.cli.description: Tasks that execute Terraform CLI operations.
io.kestra.plugin.terraform.cli.body: Set working directory, env vars, backend config, and command arguments to run Terraform init/plan/apply/destroy from Kestra, capturing stdout/stderr and plan outputs.

io.kestra.plugin.meta.facebook.posts.title: Facebook
io.kestra.plugin.meta.facebook.posts.description: Tasks that create, schedule, list, and manage Facebook Page posts.
io.kestra.plugin.meta.facebook.posts.body: Provide the Page ID and long-lived access token to publish or delete posts, fetch existing content with insights, or schedule posts for later, using options such as `scheduledPublishTime`, `attachedMedia`, and `pageId` to control delivery.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.nutanix.ahv.title: Nutanix AHV
io.kestra.plugin.ee.nutanix.ahv.description: Tasks that manage AHV VM lifecycle in Nutanix.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.nutanix.ahv.body: Use these tasks to create, update, power, and convert AHV VMs via Prism Central.

io.kestra.plugin.gcp.rcs.title: Google Cloud RCS
io.kestra.plugin.gcp.rcs.description: Send Rich Communication Services (RCS) messages using Google RCS Business Messaging (RBM).
io.kestra.plugin.gcp.rcs.body: Use these tasks to send plain text, rich cards, carousels, and file attachments directly to recipient phone numbers. Authentication is integrated with GCP service accounts (CredentialService).

io.kestra.plugin.scripts.dotnet.title: .NET (C#)
io.kestra.plugin.scripts.dotnet.description: Tasks that run .NET C# scripts using dotnet-script.
io.kestra.plugin.scripts.dotnet.body: Provide C# code inline as .csx scripts or run arbitrary dotnet CLI commands inside a .NET SDK container, capturing stdout/stderr and any output files for subsequent steps.

io.kestra.plugin.kubernetes.title: Kubernetes
io.kestra.plugin.kubernetes.description: Tasks that run workloads and kubectl operations against Kubernetes clusters.
io.kestra.plugin.kubernetes.body: Provide cluster connection details (in-cluster, kubeconfig, or explicit server/token/certs) to create pods and stream logs or wait for completion, and run kubectl-style apply/get/patch/delete/restart commands with namespace, context, and resource selectors.

io.kestra.plugin.email.title: Email
io.kestra.plugin.email.body: Configure SMTP server/port, credentials, from/to addresses, subject, and body/attachments to send emails from workflows; supports TLS/SSL settings for secure delivery.

io.kestra.plugin.resend.domain.title: Resend Domain
io.kestra.plugin.resend.domain.description: Tasks that manage and verify domains with the Resend API.
io.kestra.plugin.resend.domain.body: Use your Resend API key to add domains, retrieve verification records, and check domain status so you can enable sending from trusted domains.

io.kestra.plugin.mongodb.title: MongoDB
io.kestra.plugin.mongodb.description: Tasks that query and manipulate MongoDB collections.
io.kestra.plugin.mongodb.body: Provide connection URI/credentials and database/collection names to run find, aggregate, insert, update, delete operations, returning JSON results for downstream processing.

io.kestra.plugin.trello.title: Atlassian Trello
io.kestra.plugin.trello.description: Integration plugin for Atlassian Trello to manage boards, lists, cards, and workflow automation.
io.kestra.plugin.trello.body: Trello is a visual collaboration platform that organizes projects into boards. This plugin provides comprehensive integration with Trello's REST API, enabling you to automate board management, list operations, and card workflows. Use it to streamline project tracking, synchronize data between Trello and other systems, and build event-driven automation based on Trello activities.

io.kestra.plugin.squadcast.title: Squadcast
io.kestra.plugin.squadcast.description: Tasks that create incidents in Squadcast.
io.kestra.plugin.squadcast.body: Use the Squadcast event endpoint and routing key plus incident details (message, severity, source) to raise alerts from Kestra workflows and capture the response.

io.kestra.plugin.azure.horizondb.title: Azure HorizonDB
io.kestra.plugin.azure.horizondb.description: Tasks and triggers to run SQL queries and manage pg_durable durable workflows on Azure HorizonDB.
io.kestra.plugin.azure.horizondb.body: Connect with password or Azure Entra ID authentication; run single or multi-statement SQL queries with FETCH, FETCH_ONE, or STORE result handling, and submit, cancel, signal, inspect, list, and react to pg_durable durable function instances directly from a Kestra flow.

io.kestra.plugin.microsoft365.dynamics36.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Dataverse
io.kestra.plugin.microsoft365.dynamics36.description: Tasks that interact with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Dataverse for OData entity operations.
io.kestra.plugin.microsoft365.dynamics36.body: Configure the `orgUrl` and Azure authentication properties to query, upsert, and delete Dataverse entity records using the OData v9.2 API.

io.kestra.plugin.huawei.dataarts.title: Huawei DataArts Studio
io.kestra.plugin.huawei.dataarts.description: Tasks for Huawei Cloud DataArts Studio (DataArts Factory / DLF): start, monitor, and stop batch job runs.

io.kestra.plugin.terragrunt.title: Terragrunt
io.kestra.plugin.terragrunt.description: Tasks that run Terragrunt CLI commands to init, plan, apply, and destroy infrastructure.
io.kestra.plugin.terragrunt.body: Run Terragrunt commands inside a container with support for input files, output files, environment variables, and remote state backends such as S3, GCS, or Terraform Cloud.

io.kestra.plugin.notifications.title: Notifications
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.description: Tasks that send notifications from Kestra via email, chat, paging, and alert channels.
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.body: Choose a channel task (Slack, Teams, Discord, email, SMS, Opsgenie, PagerDuty, etc.), provide the required token/URL/credentials and destination (channel, user, service key), and send templated messages or incident payloads from workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.xquik.title: Xquik
io.kestra.plugin.xquik.description: Xquik X/Twitter public data plugin for Kestra
io.kestra.plugin.xquik.body:
Xquik tasks let Kestra flows retrieve public X/Twitter data for scheduled research, monitoring, and reporting workflows.

The plugin includes read-only tasks for:
- Searching public posts.
- Fetching one public post by ID.
- Searching public users.
- Fetching one public user by username or ID.
- Fetching recent public posts from a user.
- Listing regional trends.

Use `{{ secret('XQUIK_API_KEY') }}` for the `apiKey` property. Search and list tasks support `fetchType` so larger responses can be stored in Kestra internal storage.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.solarwinds.ipam.grou.title: SolarWinds IPAM Groups
io.kestra.plugin.ee.solarwinds.ipam.grou.description: List, get, create, update, and delete IPAM group hierarchy nodes in SolarWinds Orion.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.solarwinds.ipam.grou.body: Manage the IPAM group hierarchy in SolarWinds Orion: list all groups or filter by parent, retrieve individual groups by ID, create new hierarchy nodes, update existing groups, and delete them when they are no longer needed.

io.kestra.plugin.azure.monitoring.title: Azure Monitoring
io.kestra.plugin.azure.monitoring.description: Tasks that query or ingest metrics with Azure Monitor.
io.kestra.plugin.azure.monitoring.body: Configure the regional metrics endpoint plus Azure AD credentials; metric queries accept resourceIds, metricNames, namespace, time window, aggregations, filters, and intervals, while ingestion posts custom metrics using managed bearer-token acquisition.

io.kestra.plugin.notifications.line.title: Line
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.line.description: Tasks that send notifications to LINE messaging.
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.line.body: Provide the LINE channel access token and target user/group to push messages from Kestra, supporting text content and optional attributes.

io.kestra.plugin.airtable.records.title: Airtable Records
io.kestra.plugin.airtable.records.description: Tasks that read and write Airtable records: list rows with filters, views, and pagination, fetch a record by ID, create single or batched records with optional typecasting, patch updates, and deletes.
io.kestra.plugin.airtable.records.body: Use API key authentication and choose fetch/store outputs depending on whether you want data in-flow or stored.

io.kestra.plugin.jenkins.title: Jenkins
io.kestra.plugin.jenkins.description: Tasks that trigger Jenkins jobs and retrieve build or job metadata.
io.kestra.plugin.jenkins.body: Provide the Jenkins `serverUrl` with a username and API token to start parameterized builds and query job or build details; the tasks handle crumb headers via the HTTP configuration and surface queue, status, and artifact information for orchestration.

io.kestra.plugin.scripts.shell.title: Shell
io.kestra.plugin.scripts.shell.description: Tasks that run shell commands or scripts.
io.kestra.plugin.scripts.shell.body: Provide shell commands or script files with interpreter options and environment settings to execute on the worker, capturing stdout/stderr and output files for downstream tasks.

io.kestra.plugin.compress.title: Compression
io.kestra.plugin.compress.description: Tasks that compress and decompress files and archives for Kestra flows.
io.kestra.plugin.compress.body: Use ArchiveCompress, ArchiveDecompress, FileCompress, and FileDecompress to package or extract files stored in Kestra, providing the `from` internal storage URI plus an `algorithm` for archives and a `compression` format for both archive and single-file operations. Use FileEncrypt and FileDecrypt to encrypt and decrypt files: the default mode (PBKDF2_SHA256) uses AES-256-CBC and is compatible with `openssl enc -aes-256-cbc -pbkdf2`; the PBKDF2_SHA512, ARGON2ID, and SCRYPT modes use AES-256-GCM with a self-describing KESTRAENC file format that embeds all derivation parameters so FileDecrypt needs only the password. Outputs return new storage URIs (archives also expose an entry map and size/count metrics), making it easy to pass compressed or encrypted artifacts to uploads or downstream tasks.

io.kestra.plugin.apify.task.title: Apify Task
io.kestra.plugin.apify.task.description: Tasks that run a saved Apify Task and return its run payload.
io.kestra.plugin.apify.task.body: Provide `taskId` and `apiToken` to start a saved Apify Task from a workflow. Optional input overrides and a synchronous wait let you tune each run and block until it finishes while receiving the resulting run payload.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.purestorage.snapshot.title: Pure Storage FlashArray Snapshots
io.kestra.plugin.ee.purestorage.snapshot.description: Tasks for managing Pure Storage FlashArray volume snapshots: create, list, delete, and restore.

io.kestra.plugin.proxmox.task.title: Proxmox VE Tasks
io.kestra.plugin.proxmox.task.description: Tasks that poll and wait for async Proxmox VE operations identified by a UPID.
io.kestra.plugin.proxmox.task.body: Pass a UPID returned by any write operation to GetTaskStatus for a single status check, or to WaitForTask to block until the operation completes or a timeout is reached.

io.kestra.plugin.ceph.title: Ceph
io.kestra.plugin.ceph.description: Manage Ceph clusters through the Ceph Dashboard REST API: cluster health, pools, RBD images and snapshots, and the Object Gateway (RGW).
io.kestra.plugin.ceph.body: Authenticate against the Ceph Dashboard, monitor cluster health (including a trigger for degraded state), and manage storage pools, RBD block images and snapshots, and RGW buckets and users.

io.kestra.plugin.apify.title: Apify
io.kestra.plugin.apify.description: Tasks that orchestrate Apify Actors and datasets from Kestra.
io.kestra.plugin.apify.body: Trigger Apify Actors and collect their datasets without hand-rolling API calls. All tasks require an Apify API token via `apiToken`, and expose controls for actor inputs, cost/time limits, and dataset retrieval or export options.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.lease.title: Infoblox DHCP Leases
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.lease.description: Tasks to list DHCP leases in Infoblox via the WAPI REST API.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.lease.body: List DHCP lease objects in Infoblox. Leases are read-only in WAPI.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.netapp.ontap.snapsho.title: NetApp ONTAP Snapshots
io.kestra.plugin.ee.netapp.ontap.snapsho.description: Tasks for managing NetApp ONTAP volume snapshots: create, list, delete, and restore.

io.kestra.plugin.monday.updates.title: Monday Updates
io.kestra.plugin.monday.updates.description: Comment threads attached to Monday items.
io.kestra.plugin.monday.updates.body: Post, delete, and like the comment threads (updates) attached to a Monday item. Useful for narrating flow activity directly on the item that triggered it.

io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.oracle.title: Oracle
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.oracle.description: Tasks that connect to Oracle via JDBC to run queries and loads.
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.oracle.body: Provide the Oracle JDBC URL, credentials, and SQL statements (query, batch, load, trigger) to read or write data; configure fetch type, fetch size, and output options to return rows or files from workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.dbt.title: dbt
io.kestra.plugin.dbt.description: Integrate dbt data transformations into Kestra orchestration pipelines.
io.kestra.plugin.dbt.body: Provides dbt integrations for both CLI-driven projects and dbt Cloud jobs so you can orchestrate runs alongside other Kestra tasks. Supply your dbt profiles or Cloud API credentials to execute, monitor, and collect manifests and run results for downstream automation.

io.kestra.plugin.twilio.notify.rcs.title: Twilio RCS
io.kestra.plugin.twilio.notify.rcs.description: Tasks that send RCS messages via the Twilio Messages API.
io.kestra.plugin.twilio.notify.rcs.body: Provide Twilio account SID, auth token, an RCS-enabled sender, and message text or a content template SID to send RCS messages from Kestra workflows. Twilio falls back to SMS when the recipient cannot receive RCS.

io.kestra.plugin.datagen.generators.title: Generators
io.kestra.plugin.datagen.generators.description: Reusable generators for JSON objects, strings, or random byte payloads that can be referenced across Datagen tasks.
io.kestra.plugin.datagen.generators.body: Generators plug into Datagen tasks and triggers to emit structured or raw data. Use templates for `JsonObjectGenerator` or `StringValueGenerator` (Pebble + Datafaker expressions, optional locale list using Faker defaults when empty) or set the `size` for random byte arrays, then reference the generator in a core task.

io.kestra.plugin.scripts.perl.title: Perl
io.kestra.plugin.scripts.perl.body: Provide Perl code inline or script files with arguments to execute via Perl in Kestra, capturing stdout/stderr and output files.

io.kestra.plugin.azure.horizondb.durable.title: Azure HorizonDB Durable Workflows
io.kestra.plugin.azure.horizondb.durable.description: Submit, cancel, signal, inspect, list, and react to pg_durable durable function instances on Azure HorizonDB.
io.kestra.plugin.azure.horizondb.durable.body: Start durable function instances from a pg_durable SQL DSL body, cancel or signal running instances, poll status and results, list instances filtered by status, and trigger a flow when an instance reaches a target status.

io.kestra.plugin.serdes.markdown.title: Markdown
io.kestra.plugin.serdes.markdown.description: Tasks that convert Markdown to text or HTML.
io.kestra.plugin.serdes.markdown.body: Provide Markdown content to render as plain text or HTML using the built-in converters, useful for generating notifications or documents from workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.gcp.bigquery.title: Google Cloud BigQuery
io.kestra.plugin.gcp.bigquery.description: Build high-performance data pipelines with BigQuery. Query, transform, and load data at scale without infrastructure management.

io.kestra.plugin.notifications.slack.title: Slack
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.slack.description: Tasks that send messages to Slack.
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.slack.body: Provide the Slack webhook URL or bot token with channel/user targets and message text or blocks to post notifications or alerts from Kestra workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.adanos.title: Adanos
io.kestra.plugin.adanos.description: Stock and crypto market sentiment data from Reddit, X / FinTwit, financial news, and Polymarket
io.kestra.plugin.adanos.body:
Adanos tasks add read-only market sentiment and attention data to Kestra workflows.

The plugin can retrieve one asset, list trending assets, compare assets, and return aggregate market sentiment. Stock data is available from Reddit, X / FinTwit, financial news, and Polymarket; crypto data currently uses Reddit.

Use `{{ secret('ADANOS_API_KEY') }}` for the `apiKey` property. Every task supports Kestra fetch and internal-storage result handling.

io.kestra.plugin.skopeo.cli.title: Skopeo CLI
io.kestra.plugin.skopeo.cli.description: Run Skopeo CLI commands to inspect, copy, and manage container images and registries.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.veeam.title: Veeam (EE)
io.kestra.plugin.ee.veeam.description: Enterprise Veeam Backup & Replication tasks and triggers to manage jobs, monitor sessions, and trigger restores over the VBR REST API.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.veeam.body: Automate Veeam Backup & Replication: list, inspect, start, and stop jobs, poll job sessions until completion, retrieve session logs, trigger instant VM recovery or file-level restore, and react to job completions with a polling trigger.

io.kestra.plugin.cloudflare.dns.records.title: Cloudflare DNS Records
io.kestra.plugin.cloudflare.dns.records.description: Tasks that manage Cloudflare DNS records.
io.kestra.plugin.cloudflare.dns.records.body: Create, retrieve, update, delete, list, batch, and upsert DNS records within Cloudflare zones. Supports common record types such as A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT, MX, and more for full DNS automation.

io.kestra.plugin.aws.lambda.title: AWS Lambda
io.kestra.plugin.aws.lambda.description: Tasks that invoke AWS Lambda functions with optional JSON payloads, capture response bodies or logs, and emit metrics about execution time and payload size for serverless workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.aikido.containers.title: Aikido Containers
io.kestra.plugin.aikido.containers.description: Tasks for listing, scanning, and exporting the SBOM of Aikido container repositories.
io.kestra.plugin.aikido.containers.body: List connected container repositories, trigger a rescan with optional wait-for-completion, and export a container's SBOM or license report.

io.kestra.plugin.proxmox.network.title: Proxmox VE Network
io.kestra.plugin.proxmox.network.description: Tasks that list network interfaces and fetch firewall rules for a Proxmox VE node.
io.kestra.plugin.proxmox.network.body: Provide the node name to list host-level network interfaces, or provide a VMID and resource type to fetch per-machine firewall rule sets.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.solarwinds.title: SolarWinds Orion (EE)
io.kestra.plugin.ee.solarwinds.description: Manage SolarWinds Orion IPAM resources — subnets, IP nodes, groups, DHCP scopes, and supernets — via the SolarWinds Information Service (SWIS) REST API.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.solarwinds.body: Automate SolarWinds IPAM workflows: list and allocate IP addresses, create subnets and groups, query the network with SWQL, and trigger executions on utilization breaches or IP status changes.

io.kestra.plugin.slack.app.chats.title: Slack Chats
io.kestra.plugin.slack.app.chats.description: Tasks that post, update, schedule, or stream Slack chat messages.
io.kestra.plugin.slack.app.chats.body: Use a bot `token` with `chat:write` to send JSON `payload` or `messageText` to a `channel`; updates/deletes/scheduling rely on the message `timestamp`, and streaming tasks share the `streamId` and `threadTs` outputs across Start/Append/Stop. Ideal for alerts, threaded updates, or long-running progress feeds.

io.kestra.plugin.airbyte.title: Airbyte
io.kestra.plugin.airbyte.description: Tasks that trigger and monitor Airbyte sync and reset jobs in self-hosted Airbyte and Airbyte Cloud
io.kestra.plugin.airbyte.body: Use this plugin to orchestrate Airbyte connection jobs from Kestra, including starting syncs, running resets, and waiting for job completion. Choose the self-hosted connection tasks or the Airbyte Cloud job tasks based on your Airbyte deployment and authentication model.

io.kestra.plugin.googleworkspace.title: Google Workspace
io.kestra.plugin.googleworkspace.description: Tasks that work with Google Workspace services (Chat, Drive, Calendar, Mail, Sheets).
io.kestra.plugin.googleworkspace.body: Configure OAuth or service-account credentials with required scopes to send and receive Gmail, manage Drive files and exports, create or list Calendar events, and read/write Sheets data with triggers for new mail, files, or sheet changes.

io.kestra.plugin.tencent.title: Tencent
io.kestra.plugin.tencent.body: This plugin provides integrations with Tencent services. It includes tasks for sending execution-based notifications and alerts using Tencent Cloud communication platforms.

io.kestra.plugin.kubernetes.kubectl.title: Kubernetes API (kubectl)
io.kestra.plugin.kubernetes.kubectl.description: Tasks that perform kubectl-style apply, get, delete, patch, and restart operations.
io.kestra.plugin.kubernetes.kubectl.body: Supply connection info plus manifests or resource identifiers to apply YAML, fetch resources, delete them, patch with merge/strategic/JSON patches, or restart deployments/statefulsets; supports namespace, context, label selectors, and dry-run flags.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.f5.monitor.title: F5 BIG-IP Monitor
io.kestra.plugin.ee.f5.monitor.description: Manage F5 BIG-IP LTM health monitors (http, tcp, icmp).

io.kestra.plugin.redis.vector.title: Redis Vector
io.kestra.plugin.redis.vector.description: Tasks that store and query embeddings in Redis vector sets.
io.kestra.plugin.redis.vector.body: Configure Redis connection info and use VADD/VSIM/VREM to add embeddings to a vector set, run KNN similarity search, and remove elements, enabling similarity search and RAG pipelines directly against Redis.

io.kestra.plugin.databricks.job.title: Databricks Job
io.kestra.plugin.databricks.job.description: Tasks that configure and run Databricks jobs with one or more tasks.
io.kestra.plugin.databricks.job.body: Create a job or submit an ad-hoc run on Databricks using your workspace host and token, defining task blocks (notebook, dbt, Spark submit/JAR/Python, SQL, pipeline, or run-job) that target an existing cluster. Set `taskKey` and `dependsOn` when chaining multiple tasks, and optionally block until completion with `waitForCompletion` to align with downstream steps.

io.kestra.plugin.jms.title: JMS
io.kestra.plugin.jms.description: Tasks that produce, consume, and trigger workflows from JMS queues or topics.
io.kestra.plugin.jms.body: Configure the JMS connection factory (broker URL, credentials, client ID) and destination name to publish messages, consume with polling or real-time triggers, and control serialization and acknowledgement so Kestra can coordinate with ActiveMQ, Artemis, or any JMS-compliant broker.

io.kestra.plugin.grafana.title: Grafana
io.kestra.plugin.grafana.description: Tasks that query Grafana Loki and react to log and metric results with LogQL.
io.kestra.plugin.grafana.body: Configure the Loki base `url`, authentication token or tenant, and LogQL `query` to run instant or range queries or emit triggers on matching log streams, returning timestamps, labels, and counts you can use downstream.

io.kestra.plugin.debezium.db2.title: Debezium DB2
io.kestra.plugin.debezium.db2.description: Tasks that ingest IBM Db2 change data through Debezium connectors in Kestra.
io.kestra.plugin.debezium.db2.body: Includes Capture plus batch and real-time triggers that stream Db2 CDC events into Kestra via Debezium. Configure hostname/port, credentials, target `database`, snapshotMode, and include/exclude filters; Trigger polls and batches records up to maxRecords/duration settings while RealtimeTrigger emits an execution per change.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.ipv6ra.title: Infoblox IPv6 DHCP Ranges
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.ipv6ra.description: Tasks to manage IPv6 DHCP ranges in Infoblox via the WAPI REST API.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.ipv6ra.body: List, create, and delete IPv6 DHCP range objects in Infoblox.

io.kestra.plugin.huawei.swr.title: Huawei SWR
io.kestra.plugin.huawei.swr.description: Tasks for Huawei Cloud SWR: obtain short-lived Docker/OCI registry auth tokens.

io.kestra.plugin.airflow.title: Airflow
io.kestra.plugin.airflow.description: Tasks that let Kestra workflows interact with Apache Airflow.
io.kestra.plugin.airflow.body: Use these plugins to call into existing Airflow deployments from Kestra, bridging workflows without migrating DAGs. Configure the Airflow REST API baseUrl, provide auth via custom headers or HTTP options, and reuse Airflow DAGs while coordinating upstream and downstream steps.

io.kestra.plugin.scrapy.title: Scrapy CLI
io.kestra.plugin.scrapy.description: Tasks that run Scrapy spiders and CLI commands to scrape data from websites.
io.kestra.plugin.scrapy.body: Use the `CLI` task to execute `scrapy crawl`, `scrapy runspider`, and other Scrapy commands inside the pre-built `ghcr.io/kestra-io/scrapy` image.

io.kestra.plugin.azure.storage.blob.title: Azure Blob Storage
io.kestra.plugin.azure.storage.blob.description: Tasks that manage data in Azure Blob Storage for object and file workflows.
io.kestra.plugin.azure.storage.blob.body: Upload or download single files and collections, copy between locations, list and delete blobs, create SAS links, or trigger workflows on container events. Provide an endpoint with a connection string, shared key, or SAS token plus the container name and blob path.

io.kestra.plugin.klaviyo.title: Klaviyo
io.kestra.plugin.klaviyo.description: Tasks that interact with Klaviyo campaign APIs.
io.kestra.plugin.klaviyo.body: Use your Klaviyo `apiKey` and base URL to retrieve campaigns, their jobs, and message assets, applying fetch strategies to return single items, lists, or stored files for further segmentation or reporting.

io.kestra.plugin.meta.title: Meta
io.kestra.plugin.meta.description: Tasks that automate Meta (Facebook and Instagram) publishing with the Graph API.
io.kestra.plugin.meta.body: Provide a Meta access token and the relevant Page or Instagram Business IDs to create, schedule, list, or delete posts and media while retrieving insights for reporting across Facebook Pages and Instagram accounts.

io.kestra.plugin.monday.notifications.title: Monday Notifications
io.kestra.plugin.monday.notifications.body: Send an in-app Monday notification to a user, tied to a target board, item, or project. Useful for alerting an owner from a flow without leaving the Monday inbox.

io.kestra.plugin.ollama.title: Ollama
io.kestra.plugin.ollama.description: Tasks that work with Ollama models and runtime features.
io.kestra.plugin.ollama.body: Use these tasks to run Ollama models locally or on a remote host, supplying the model name, prompt, and optional server host so completions or model management commands can be orchestrated inside Kestra.

io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.hana.title: SAP HANA
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.hana.description: Tasks that query SAP HANA using the official SAP HANA JDBC driver (ngdbc.jar).
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.hana.body: Use these tasks to run single or multiple SQL statements or trigger flows based on query results in SAP HANA with the bundled ngdbc driver. Provide a SAP HANA JDBC URL (jdbc:sap://...), credentials, and your SQL along with fetch options (fetchType/fetchSize/store) to control how result sets are returned and persisted.

io.kestra.plugin.googleworkspace.drive.title: Google Drive
io.kestra.plugin.googleworkspace.drive.description: Tasks that upload, download, export, list, and watch files in Google Drive.
io.kestra.plugin.googleworkspace.drive.body: Use OAuth or service-account credentials with Drive scopes and a parent folder or file ID to upload or create files, export Google Docs formats, download content, list files, delete items, and trigger flows when new files appear.

io.kestra.plugin.serdes.csv.title: CSV
io.kestra.plugin.serdes.csv.description: Tasks that convert between CSV and ION.
io.kestra.plugin.serdes.csv.body: Provide CSV input with delimiter/quote/header options to convert to ION, or supply ION data to emit CSV, handling bad lines and encoding settings as needed.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.apps.core.blocks.title: Core App Block
io.kestra.plugin.ee.apps.core.blocks.description: Tasks that render general-purpose UI blocks used inside Kestra Apps.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.apps.core.blocks.body: These building blocks supply markdown, tables, forms, images, alerts, log/stream viewers, redirects, and interactive buttons; configure content properties such as `text`, `columns`, `actions`, or `source` depending on the block. Use them to compose App layouts, with data binding and navigation handled by the surrounding app context.

io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.pinot.title: Apache Pinot
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.pinot.description: Tasks that connect to Apache Pinot via JDBC to run queries and loads.
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.pinot.body: Provide the Pinot JDBC URL, credentials, and SQL statements (query, batch, load, trigger) to read or write data; configure fetch type, fetch size, and output options to return rows or files from workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.notifications.whatsapp.title: Whatsapp
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.whatsapp.description: Tasks that send WhatsApp messages (via Twilio API).
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.whatsapp.body: Use Twilio WhatsApp credentials with from/to numbers and message content to push WhatsApp notifications from Kestra workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.ai.rag.title: RAG
io.kestra.plugin.ai.rag.description: Tasks that ingest, chunk, and embed documents, search vectors, and run retrieval-augmented chat so LLM answers stay grounded in indexed content.

io.kestra.plugin.notifications.zenduty.title: Zenduty
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.zenduty.description: Tasks that create incidents in Zenduty.
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.zenduty.body: Use Zenduty routing keys and incident payloads (message, severity, entity) to trigger alerts from Kestra workflows and collect the API response.

io.kestra.plugin.modal.cli.title: Modal CLI
io.kestra.plugin.modal.cli.description: Tasks that execute Modal CLI commands.
io.kestra.plugin.modal.cli.body: Provide Modal auth (token/profile) and the CLI command list to run functions or manage deployments from Kestra, capturing stdout/stderr and exit codes for orchestration.

io.kestra.plugin.microsoft365.sharepoint.title: Microsoft SharePoint
io.kestra.plugin.microsoft365.sharepoint.description: Tasks that interact with SharePoint document libraries for file operations.
io.kestra.plugin.microsoft365.sharepoint.body: Set the SharePoint `siteId` and drive or item paths along with Graph authentication to list, upload, export, download, or delete files, reusing the shared Microsoft 365 connection for consistent permissions and auditability.

io.kestra.plugin.aikido.repositories.title: Aikido Repositories
io.kestra.plugin.aikido.repositories.description: Tasks for listing, scanning, and exporting the SBOM of Aikido code repositories.
io.kestra.plugin.aikido.repositories.body: List connected code repositories, trigger SAST/IaC/secrets scans with optional wait-for-completion, and export a repository's SBOM or license report.

io.kestra.plugin.couchbase.title: Couchbase
io.kestra.plugin.couchbase.description: Tasks that execute Couchbase N1QL queries and trigger Kestra flows from query results.
io.kestra.plugin.couchbase.body: Run Couchbase operations from Kestra with the Query task for on-demand N1QL execution and the Trigger to poll queries on a schedule. Supply the database connection string, username, password, and query; optional parameters and fetchType control whether rows are returned, a single row is provided, or results are stored for downstream tasks.

io.kestra.plugin.snmp.title: SNMP
io.kestra.plugin.snmp.description: Tasks that send SNMP traps or informs for network monitoring.
io.kestra.plugin.snmp.body: Specify the SNMP version, target host/port, community or security params, and payload OIDs to emit traps or informs to your NMS, enabling Kestra flows to notify external monitoring systems.

io.kestra.plugin.graphql.title: GraphQL
io.kestra.plugin.graphql.description: Tasks that send GraphQL queries and mutations over HTTP endpoints.
io.kestra.plugin.graphql.body: Define the GraphQL `url`, `query`, and optional `variables` or custom headers to call APIs, with responses returned as JSON you can store, filter, or pass to downstream tasks.

io.kestra.plugin.redis.string.title: Redis String
io.kestra.plugin.redis.string.description: Tasks that read and write Redis string keys.
io.kestra.plugin.redis.string.body: Provide Redis connection info and keys/values to SET/GET or increment/decrement strings, enabling simple cache or counter patterns in workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.kestra.ee.cases.title: Kestra Cases
io.kestra.plugin.kestra.ee.cases.description: Task to open or attach to Kestra EE incident-management Cases.
io.kestra.plugin.kestra.ee.cases.body: Use CreateCase from an errors: block to open an incident whenever a flow fails, or attach the triggering execution to an existing case.

io.kestra.plugin.debezium.sqlserver.title: Debezium Microsoft SQL Server
io.kestra.plugin.debezium.sqlserver.description: Tasks that stream Microsoft SQL Server change data capture events into Kestra with Debezium.
io.kestra.plugin.debezium.sqlserver.body: Capture plus batch and real-time triggers use the Debezium SQL Server connector to feed CDC rows into Kestra. Provide hostname/port, credentials, target `database`, snapshotMode, and include/exclude filters; Trigger batches results with maxRecords/duration controls, while RealtimeTrigger fires one execution per change.

io.kestra.plugin.aws.kinesis.title: AWS Kinesis
io.kestra.plugin.aws.kinesis.description: Tasks and triggers for Amazon Kinesis Data Streams: write batches of records with partition keys, consume records, and start flows on new records via polling or realtime triggers.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.netbox.title: NetBox (EE)
io.kestra.plugin.ee.netbox.description: Enterprise NetBox tasks to create, update, and query devices, IP addresses, and sites over the NetBox API.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.netbox.body: Automate NetBox inventory: register or edit devices, allocate or assign IPs, and list sites or devices with filters, field selection, pagination, and internal storage output for bulk results.

io.kestra.plugin.aikido.compliance.title: Aikido Compliance
io.kestra.plugin.aikido.compliance.description: Tasks for retrieving Aikido compliance framework overviews.
io.kestra.plugin.aikido.compliance.body: Fetch the rule-by-rule compliance overview for ISO 27001, NIS2, or SOC 2.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.dellemc.powerstore.v.title: Dell EMC PowerStore Volumes
io.kestra.plugin.ee.dellemc.powerstore.v.description: Tasks for managing Dell EMC PowerStore volumes: list, get, create, resize, and delete.

io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.dremio.title: Dremio
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.dremio.description: Tasks that connect to Dremio via JDBC to run queries and loads.
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.dremio.body: Provide the Dremio JDBC URL, credentials, and SQL statements (query, batch, load, trigger) to read or write data; configure fetch type, fetch size, and output options to return rows or files from workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.powerbi.title: Power BI
io.kestra.plugin.powerbi.description: Tasks that refresh Microsoft Power BI datasets via the API.
io.kestra.plugin.powerbi.body: Provide Azure tenant/client credentials and specify the Power BI group and dataset IDs to trigger refreshes and list refresh history, returning API responses for reporting pipelines.

io.kestra.plugin.dlt.title: dlt
io.kestra.plugin.dlt.description: Tasks that run dlt (data load tool) pipelines and CLI commands to move data into analytics destinations.
io.kestra.plugin.dlt.body: Use these tasks to execute dlt workloads either from inline Python (`Run`) or through non-interactive CLI commands (`CLI`). Provide a Python `script` or list of `commands`, set `beforeCommands` to install dependencies, and adjust the default `ghcr.io/kestra-io/dlt` image when you need custom environments; the CLI task also auto-adds `--non-interactive` and installs `requirements.txt` after `dlt init`.

io.kestra.plugin.scripts.julia.title: Julia
io.kestra.plugin.scripts.julia.body: Provide Julia code inline or files with package requirements and arguments to execute via Julia, capturing stdout/stderr and any generated artifacts from workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.networ.title: Infoblox Networks
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.networ.description: Tasks to manage IPv4 networks in Infoblox via the WAPI REST API.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.networ.body: List, get, create, update, and delete IPv4 network objects in Infoblox.

io.kestra.plugin.databricks.dbfs.title: DBFS
io.kestra.plugin.databricks.dbfs.description: Tasks that move files between Kestra and the Databricks File System (DBFS).
io.kestra.plugin.databricks.dbfs.body: Use these tasks to upload or download artifacts for your pipelines through DBFS using your Databricks host and token. Specify the source file from Kestra storage via `from` and the DBFS destination via `to`; downloads return a Kestra storage URI so the file can be reused downstream.

io.kestra.plugin.huawei.ces.title: Huawei CES
io.kestra.plugin.huawei.ces.description: Tasks for Huawei Cloud CES: push custom metrics, query metric statistics, and trigger flows on metric datapoints.

io.kestra.plugin.monday.assets.title: Monday Assets
io.kestra.plugin.monday.assets.description: Fetch Monday asset metadata and content.
io.kestra.plugin.monday.assets.body: Fetch and download Monday asset (file) metadata and content. Use it to inspect uploads attached to items or to stream binaries into Kestra internal storage for downstream processing.

io.kestra.plugin.todoist.title: Todoist
io.kestra.plugin.todoist.description: Tasks that manage Todoist tasks through the Todoist API.
io.kestra.plugin.todoist.body: Use your Todoist API token to create, update, complete, delete, or list tasks with fields like content, due dates, labels, and project IDs, returning task payloads and URLs for further workflow steps.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.dellemc.title: Dell EMC (EE)
io.kestra.plugin.ee.dellemc.description: Manage Dell EMC storage systems from Kestra, starting with PowerStore: volumes, snapshots, replication, and array/alert monitoring.

io.kestra.plugin.ceph.rgw.title: Ceph Object Gateway (RGW)
io.kestra.plugin.ceph.rgw.description: Tasks that manage RGW buckets and users.
io.kestra.plugin.ceph.rgw.body: List and create Object Gateway buckets and users, and delete buckets.

io.kestra.plugin.microsoft.fabric.data.e.title: Microsoft Fabric Data Engineering
io.kestra.plugin.microsoft.fabric.data.e.description: Tasks to run Pipelines, Notebooks, and Spark Job Definitions in Microsoft Fabric Data Engineering.

io.kestra.plugin.gcp.dataflow.title: Google Cloud Dataflow
io.kestra.plugin.gcp.dataflow.description: Tasks to launch, monitor, and cancel Google Cloud Dataflow Classic and Flex template jobs.
io.kestra.plugin.gcp.dataflow.body: Use these tasks to execute templates, launch jobs, monitor pipelines, cancel executions, and trigger flows when Dataflow pipelines reach completion. Authentication is integrated with GCP service accounts (CredentialService).

io.kestra.plugin.ee.opentelemetry.title: Opentelemetry (EE)
io.kestra.plugin.ee.opentelemetry.description: Tasks that export Kestra logs to an OpenTelemetry collector over OTLP.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.opentelemetry.body: Use these tasks when you need to forward workflow logs to an OTLP endpoint for centralized observability; set `otlpEndpoint` (required), optionally add authorization headers, and tune `chunk` size (default 1000) to control batch throughput while emitting request and log count metrics.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.addres.title: Infoblox IPv4 Addresses
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.addres.description: Tasks to list and allocate IPv4 addresses in Infoblox via the WAPI REST API.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.addres.body: List used IPv4 addresses, allocate the next available IP from a network, and release fixed address assignments.

io.kestra.plugin.proxmox.backup.title: Proxmox VE Backup
io.kestra.plugin.proxmox.backup.description: Tasks that create, restore, and list backups for QEMU VMs and LXC containers on Proxmox VE.
io.kestra.plugin.proxmox.backup.body: Specify node, resource type (vm or container), and VMID to trigger a vzdump backup or restore from a storage path. List returns all backups available on the node for a given storage target.

io.kestra.plugin.weaviate.title: Weaviate
io.kestra.plugin.weaviate.description: Tasks that manage and query vectors in Weaviate.
io.kestra.plugin.weaviate.body: Provide Weaviate endpoint and API key to create schemas, import vectors with properties, run similarity or hybrid searches, and delete objects, enabling vector search inside workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.mysql.title: MySQL
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.mysql.description: Tasks that connect to MySQL via JDBC to run queries and loads.
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.mysql.body: Provide the MySQL JDBC URL, credentials, and SQL statements (query, batch, load, trigger) to read or write data; configure fetch type, fetch size, and output options to return rows or files from workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.monday.users.title: Monday Users
io.kestra.plugin.monday.users.body: List Monday users in the account and resolve the identity tied to the API token in use. Useful for looking up user ids before assigning items or sending notifications.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.hpe.morpheus.title: HPE Morpheus
io.kestra.plugin.ee.hpe.morpheus.description: Plugin for interacting with HPE Morpheus (HPE VM Essentials) cloud management platform

io.kestra.plugin.huawei.geminidb.title: Huawei GeminiDB
io.kestra.plugin.huawei.geminidb.description: Tasks for Huawei Cloud GeminiDB for NoSQL: put, get, delete, query, and scan items via its DynamoDB-Compatible API.

io.kestra.plugin.phpipam.ipam.section.title: phpIPAM Sections
io.kestra.plugin.phpipam.ipam.section.description: Tasks for managing phpIPAM sections (logical groupings of subnets).

io.kestra.plugin.dbt.cli.title: dbt CLI
io.kestra.plugin.dbt.cli.description: Tasks that run dbt via the CLI for building, testing, and managing projects.
io.kestra.plugin.dbt.cli.body: Wraps dbt commands (build, run, test, compile, seed, snapshot, deps, etc.) using container or custom task runners so you can orchestrate dbt projects alongside the rest of your Kestra pipeline—refresh models before downstream loads, validate data, or publish docs. Lets you provide project directories, a dbt binary path, profiles, and environment variables. Supports fail-fast, warn-error, run-result parsing, and storing artifacts for downstream steps.

io.kestra.plugin.terragrunt.cli.title: Terragrunt CLI
io.kestra.plugin.terragrunt.cli.description: Tasks that run Terragrunt CLI commands to init, plan, apply, and destroy infrastructure.
io.kestra.plugin.terragrunt.cli.body: Run Terragrunt commands inside a container with support for input files, output files, environment variables, and remote state backends such as S3, GCS, or Terraform Cloud.

io.kestra.plugin.fastly.purge.title: Fastly Cache Purge
io.kestra.plugin.fastly.purge.description: Tasks that invalidate Fastly cached content by URL, surrogate key, or globally for a service.
io.kestra.plugin.fastly.purge.body: Invalidate cached content on Fastly's edge network. Supports URL purge, surrogate key purge (single and batch), and full service cache flush. Soft purge is available on all endpoints except purge-all.

io.kestra.plugin.datahub.title: DataHub
io.kestra.plugin.datahub.description: Tasks that run DataHub CLI ingestions and interact with DataHub metadata.
io.kestra.plugin.datahub.body: Use this plugin to execute the DataHub ingestion CLI (default image `acryldata/datahub-ingestion:head`) against a provided recipe. Supply `recipe` as a map or Kestra storage URI; optionally set `containerImage`, `env`, and `taskRunner` for execution, plus `namespaceFiles`, `inputFiles`, and `outputFiles` to bundle dependencies and capture generated artifacts.

io.kestra.plugin.dbt.cloud.title: dbt Cloud
io.kestra.plugin.dbt.cloud.description: Tasks that trigger and monitor dbt Cloud jobs through the API.
io.kestra.plugin.dbt.cloud.body: Use these tasks to start jobs, poll run state, and download artifacts like run_results.json and manifest.json. Requires baseUrl, accountId, token, and jobId or runId, with options to override git refs, targets, timeouts, and wait for completion while streaming logs and parsed run results.

io.kestra.plugin.stripe.balance.title: Stripe Balance
io.kestra.plugin.stripe.balance.description: Tasks that fetch Stripe balances and payouts.
io.kestra.plugin.stripe.balance.body: Set your Stripe API key to retrieve current balance and payout details, returning amounts by currency for finance workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.anthropic.title: Anthropic
io.kestra.plugin.anthropic.description: Tasks that call Anthropic Claude models for chat completions and manage the Files API.
io.kestra.plugin.anthropic.body: Configure an Anthropic API key, pick the Claude model to run, tune generation controls like temperature and max tokens, upload and manage files, and capture token usage metrics for your executions.

io.kestra.plugin.cloudflare.workers.dyna.title: Cloudflare Dynamic Workers
io.kestra.plugin.cloudflare.workers.dyna.description: Tasks that run inline code on a gateway Cloudflare Worker using the Dynamic Workers (Worker Loader) binding.
io.kestra.plugin.cloudflare.workers.dyna.body: POST inline JavaScript or TypeScript source to a user-deployed gateway Worker that calls `env.LOADER.load(...)` to execute the code on the edge. The gateway URL is the auth boundary; the task does not require an API token or account ID.

io.kestra.plugin.monday.groups.title: Monday Groups
io.kestra.plugin.monday.groups.description: Manage the labelled sections inside a Monday board.
io.kestra.plugin.monday.groups.body: Create, update, delete, archive, and duplicate the labelled sections (groups) inside a Monday board. Use them when scripting board layout or organising items into logical buckets.

io.kestra.plugin.zendesk.title: Zendesk
io.kestra.plugin.zendesk.description: Tasks that interact with the Zendesk API for ticketing.
io.kestra.plugin.zendesk.body: Provide Zendesk subdomain, email/token credentials, and resource IDs to create, update, list, or delete tickets and related objects, returning API responses for support workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.azure.storage.table.title: Azure Table Storage
io.kestra.plugin.azure.storage.table.description: Tasks that interact with Azure Table Storage entities.
io.kestra.plugin.azure.storage.table.body: List, query, retrieve, insert, or delete rows using a connection string or SAS/shared key and endpoint plus the table name; supply partition/row keys for targeted operations or filter expressions for bulk queries and upserts.

io.kestra.plugin.influxdb.title: InfluxDB
io.kestra.plugin.influxdb.description: Tasks that query and write time series data in InfluxDB.
io.kestra.plugin.influxdb.body: Provide connection details (URL, org, bucket, token, or username/password) to run Flux or InfluxQL queries, write points, load files, or trigger flows on query results, with optional time ranges and precision settings.

io.kestra.plugin.notion.title: Notion
io.kestra.plugin.notion.description: Tasks that create, read, update, and archive Notion pages, and query and manage Notion database items.
io.kestra.plugin.notion.body: Provide a Notion integration token and page/database IDs to create pages from markdown/blocks, read or update content, archive pages, query databases, and create or update database items.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.netbox.ipam.title: NetBox IPAM
io.kestra.plugin.ee.netbox.ipam.description: Tasks for IP address management in NetBox.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.netbox.ipam.body: Assign IP addresses to devices and interfaces in NetBox, with support for allocating from prefixes.

io.kestra.plugin.docker.model.title: Docker Model Runner
io.kestra.plugin.docker.model.description: Tasks for managing AI models via the Docker Model Runner (DMR) REST API.
io.kestra.plugin.docker.model.body: Calls the native DMR REST API at http://localhost:12434 (configurable via the host property). Does not require a Docker daemon or the docker model CLI. Covers pulling, listing, and deleting models.

io.kestra.plugin.trivy.title: Trivy
io.kestra.plugin.trivy.description: Tasks that run Trivy security scans through the CLI.
io.kestra.plugin.trivy.body: Execute Trivy commands against container images, filesystems, or IaC using configurable container images and capture the scan output for reporting or gating deployments.

io.kestra.plugin.core.runner.title: Runner
io.kestra.plugin.core.runner.description: Tasks that execute commands on the Kestra worker.
io.kestra.plugin.core.runner.body: Run shell processes with configurable command, environment, working directory, and input/output handling; ensure commands are idempotent and set expected exit codes or resource needs when invoking external binaries.

io.kestra.plugin.apify.dataset.title: Apify Dataset
io.kestra.plugin.apify.dataset.description: Tasks that retrieve Apify dataset items or export them to storage with filtering.
io.kestra.plugin.apify.dataset.body: Use `datasetId` with your `apiToken` to poll for dataset availability, filter or flatten fields, control sorting and pagination, and skip empty or hidden items. The Save task can output JSON, CSV, and other formats to temp storage with delimiter/BOM controls, while Get returns the ready-to-use item list after retrying until data is available.

io.kestra.plugin.scripts.r.title: R
io.kestra.plugin.scripts.r.body: Provide R code inline or script files with package installs and arguments to execute via R, capturing stdout/stderr and outputs (including plots/files) for workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.huawei.title: Huawei Cloud (EE)
io.kestra.plugin.ee.huawei.description: Enterprise Huawei Cloud plugin for Kestra — integrates Huawei Cloud services into EE workflows.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.huawei.body: Provides log export to Huawei Cloud Log Tank Service (LTS) and a Cloud Container Instance (CCI) task runner; configure the region, project ID, and credentials or inline STS credential exchange to push execution logs in batches to any LTS log stream, or to run Kestra workloads as Pods on a CCI namespace.

io.kestra.plugin.cassandra.astradb.title: Astra DB
io.kestra.plugin.cassandra.astradb.description: Tasks that run CQL queries and triggers on DataStax Astra DB.
io.kestra.plugin.cassandra.astradb.body: Connect with either a base64-encoded secure connect bundle or a proxy address (use only one), plus keyspace, clientId, and clientSecret to build the Astra session for query and trigger tasks. Ideal for serverless Cassandra workloads that need polling or data retrieval within Kestra while keeping authentication and connectivity consistent.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.ipv6ne.title: Infoblox IPv6 Networks
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.ipv6ne.description: Tasks to manage IPv6 networks in Infoblox via the WAPI REST API.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.ipv6ne.body: List, create, update, and delete IPv6 network objects in Infoblox.

io.kestra.plugin.microsoft365.teams.adap.title: Microsoft Teams Adaptive Cards
io.kestra.plugin.microsoft365.teams.adap.description: Tasks that send Microsoft Adaptive Cards to Teams channels and chats via the Microsoft Graph API.
io.kestra.plugin.microsoft365.teams.adap.body: Use the same Azure AD app registration as other Microsoft 365 tasks to post rich, interactive Adaptive Cards to any Teams channel or user chat and get back the message ID, instead of relying on a static incoming webhook URL.

io.kestra.plugin.gcp.function.title: Google Cloud Function
io.kestra.plugin.gcp.function.description: Trigger serverless functions and orchestrate event-driven computing. Execute code without provisioning or managing servers.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.netbox.contactassign.title: NetBox Contact Assignment
io.kestra.plugin.ee.netbox.contactassign.description: Tasks for creating and listing contact assignments in NetBox.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.netbox.contactassign.body: Create and list contact assignments in NetBox, linking contacts and roles to resources such as devices and sites.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.opa.title: OPA (Open Policy Agent)
io.kestra.plugin.ee.opa.description: Tasks to manage Open Policy Agent policies and decisions, including upload, evaluation, and partial evaluation.

io.kestra.plugin.scripts.jython.title: Jython
io.kestra.plugin.scripts.jython.description: Tasks that run Python scripts with the Jython interpreter.
io.kestra.plugin.scripts.jython.body: Provide Python code inline or files to execute on the JVM via Jython with optional dependencies and arguments, capturing outputs for downstream processing.

io.kestra.plugin.monday.columns.title: Monday Columns
io.kestra.plugin.monday.columns.body: Create, rename, and delete the columns that make up a Monday board's schema. Use them when defining or evolving a board's structure programmatically.

io.kestra.plugin.cloudflare.compute.kv.title: Cloudflare Workers KV
io.kestra.plugin.cloudflare.compute.kv.description: Tasks that manage Cloudflare Workers KV key-value storage.
io.kestra.plugin.cloudflare.compute.kv.body: Bulk write and retrieve key-value pairs within Workers KV namespaces for feature flags, edge configuration, distributed state, and application-level automation.

io.kestra.plugin.cloudflare.title: Cloudflare
io.kestra.plugin.cloudflare.description: Tasks that manage Cloudflare zones, DNS records, cache, Workers, and D1 databases.
io.kestra.plugin.cloudflare.body: Create, update, list, and delete Cloudflare zones and DNS records. Purge zone cache, deploy and manage Worker scripts, run inline code on the edge via Dynamic Workers, and manage D1 serverless SQLite databases including SQL queries and exports. Automate Cloudflare infrastructure operations securely using API tokens.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.dellemc.powerstore.s.title: Dell EMC PowerStore Snapshots
io.kestra.plugin.ee.dellemc.powerstore.s.description: Tasks for managing Dell EMC PowerStore volume snapshots: create, list, delete, and restore.

io.kestra.plugin.serdes.yaml.title: YAML
io.kestra.plugin.serdes.yaml.description: Tasks that convert between YAML and ION/JSON.
io.kestra.plugin.serdes.yaml.body: Provide YAML content to convert to ION or JSON, or take ION/JSON and emit YAML, making it easy to translate configs inside workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.solarwinds.ipam.subn.title: SolarWinds IPAM Subnets
io.kestra.plugin.ee.solarwinds.ipam.subn.description: List, get, create, update, and delete IPAM subnets in SolarWinds Orion.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.solarwinds.ipam.subn.body: Manage IPAM subnets in SolarWinds Orion: list with utilization statistics, retrieve individual subnets by ID, create new subnet definitions, update existing ones, and delete subnets when they are no longer needed.

io.kestra.plugin.github.actions.title: GitHub Actions
io.kestra.plugin.github.actions.description: Tasks that dispatch and monitor GitHub Actions workflows.
io.kestra.plugin.github.actions.body: Provide a GitHub token, owner/repo, workflow file or ID, and ref/inputs to trigger workflows and retrieve run details so you can orchestrate CI/CD directly from Kestra.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.veeam.jobs.title: Veeam Jobs
io.kestra.plugin.ee.veeam.jobs.description: Tasks and triggers for listing, inspecting, starting, and stopping Veeam Backup & Replication jobs.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.veeam.jobs.body: List, get, start, and stop Veeam Backup & Replication jobs, and trigger a flow whenever a job session completes.

io.kestra.plugin.klaviyo.campaign.messag.title: Klaviyo Campaign Messages
io.kestra.plugin.klaviyo.campaign.messag.description: Tasks that retrieve Klaviyo campaign messages and their media assets.
io.kestra.plugin.klaviyo.campaign.messag.body: Use the `apiKey` with campaign or message IDs to list messages, fetch message details, and download image assets so you can validate content before sending or archive creative variants.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.new-relic.title: New Relic (EE)
io.kestra.plugin.ee.new-relic.description: Tasks that ship Kestra logs to New Relic's Logs API for centralized monitoring.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.new-relic.body: Use the LogExporter tasks to forward buffered log records over HTTPS to New Relic; set `basePath` to your New Relic log ingest endpoint and provide an `apiKey` (license or ingest key). Tune optional HTTP `options` and the `chunk` size to control batching, retries, and throughput.

io.kestra.plugin.twilio.title: Twilio
io.kestra.plugin.twilio.description: Tasks that integrate with the Twilio ecosystem.
io.kestra.plugin.twilio.body: Configure authentication and service-specific parameters to interact with Twilio-powered communication and data services. These tasks enable workflows to send messages, manage communications, and connect with external customer engagement platforms supported by Twilio, all directly from Kestra.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.huawei.lts.title: Huawei Cloud LTS Log Exporter
io.kestra.plugin.ee.huawei.lts.description: Exports Kestra execution logs to Huawei Cloud Log Tank Service (LTS) streams.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.huawei.lts.body: Configure logGroupId and logStreamId along with region and credentials to push execution logs in batches; adjust chunk to balance throughput and LTS API usage while emitting request and log counters.

io.kestra.plugin.xquik.users.title: Xquik Users
io.kestra.plugin.xquik.users.description: Tasks that search users and retrieve public X/Twitter profile data with Xquik.
io.kestra.plugin.xquik.users.body: Use these tasks to search users, fetch one user by username or ID, and retrieve recent public posts from a user. Set `apiKey` with `{{ secret('XQUIK_API_KEY') }}`.

io.kestra.plugin.twilio.notify.mms.title: Twilio MMS
io.kestra.plugin.twilio.notify.mms.description: Tasks that send MMS messages via the Twilio Programmable Messaging API.
io.kestra.plugin.twilio.notify.mms.body: Provide Twilio account SID, auth token, from/to phone numbers, and media URLs to send MMS messages from Kestra workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.core.http.title: HTTP
io.kestra.plugin.core.http.description: Tasks that interact with HTTP endpoints.
io.kestra.plugin.core.http.body: Perform requests, downloads, or webhook triggers with configurable methods, headers, authentication, and payloads; provide the target URI plus any body or query parameters, and use response handling options to store results for downstream tasks.

io.kestra.plugin.pulsar.title: Apache Pulsar
io.kestra.plugin.pulsar.description: Tasks that publish, consume, and trigger workflows with Apache Pulsar.
io.kestra.plugin.pulsar.body: Provide Pulsar service URLs and auth settings to produce messages, consume topics or subscriptions with ack/receiver options, and use triggers to start flows when new messages arrive.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.netapp.title: NetApp ONTAP (EE)
io.kestra.plugin.ee.netapp.description: Manage NetApp ONTAP clusters from Kestra: volumes, snapshots, SnapMirror replication, and SVMs.

io.kestra.plugin.flink.title: Apache Flink
io.kestra.plugin.flink.description: Tasks that submit, monitor, cancel, and trigger savepoints for Apache Flink jobs over the REST API.
io.kestra.plugin.flink.body: Provide the Flink JobManager REST `restUrl` plus job details such as `jarUri`, `entryClass`, args, parallelism, and optional savepoint paths to upload and run jobs, monitor status, cancel executions, or trigger savepoints directly from Kestra.

io.kestra.plugin.datagen.core.title: Datagen Core
io.kestra.plugin.datagen.core.description: Tasks that generate synthetic records on demand or emit them continuously.
io.kestra.plugin.datagen.core.body: Use `Generate` for inline values or batches stored in internal storage, `Trigger` for interval-based batches, and `RealtimeTrigger` for streaming at a controlled throughput. These generator-based tasks each need a `generator` (JSON, string, or bytes); key controls include `store` (defaults false), `batchSize` (defaults 1), `throughput`, `reportingInterval`, and `maxRecords` for caps. `Pseudonymize` is different: it reads an existing CSV, JSON, or ION file and replaces the listed PII fields with realistic fake values instead of generating new records.

io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.trino.title: Trino
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.trino.description: Tasks that connect to Trino via JDBC to run queries and loads.
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.trino.body: Provide the Trino JDBC URL/catalog/schema, credentials, and SQL statements (query, batch, load, trigger) to read or write data; configure fetch type, fetch size, and output options to return rows or files from workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.figma.projects.title: Projects
io.kestra.plugin.figma.projects.description: List Figma team projects and the files within a project.
io.kestra.plugin.figma.projects.body: List all projects of a team, or all files within a project.

io.kestra.plugin.figma.title: Figma
io.kestra.plugin.figma.description: Tasks and triggers to interact with the Figma REST API.
io.kestra.plugin.figma.body: Read Figma file documents and export node images, manage file comments, list team projects and their files, read and write variables (Enterprise plan required), and trigger a flow whenever a Figma file changes.

io.kestra.plugin.gcp.dataform.title: Google Cloud DataForm
io.kestra.plugin.gcp.dataform.description: Automate data transformation workflows with DataForm. Execute SQL-based ELT pipelines with built-in lineage and testing.

io.kestra.plugin.ansible.cli.title: Ansible CLI
io.kestra.plugin.ansible.cli.description: Tasks that run Ansible CLI commands to execute playbooks and capture results.
io.kestra.plugin.ansible.cli.body: Provide commands (required) and any playbooks or inventories via inputFiles or Namespace Files; tasks run in a container image (default cytopia/ansible:latest-tools) with optional beforeCommands and env to prepare the environment. A default ansible.cfg and callback plugin are injected so playbook outputs, per-task details, and logs (when outputLogFile is true) are returned to Kestra.

io.kestra.plugin.confluence.title: Atlassian Confluence
io.kestra.plugin.confluence.description: Tasks that connect Kestra flows to Atlassian Confluence for creating, updating, and retrieving page content.
io.kestra.plugin.confluence.body: Use this plugin to integrate Kestra flows with Confluence via the REST API. Provide `serverUrl`, `username`, and `apiToken` for authentication; page tasks render Markdown to Confluence storage and return JSON or Markdown for downstream steps.

io.kestra.plugin.cloudquery.title: CloudQuery
io.kestra.plugin.cloudquery.description: Tasks that run CloudQuery commands to sync data through the CLI.
io.kestra.plugin.cloudquery.body: Use these tasks to execute CloudQuery syncs from inline YAML or config files, optionally persisting incremental state in Kestra's KV Store for reliable resumes. CloudQueryCLI runs arbitrary commands with configurable env, container image, and input/output files.

io.kestra.plugin.scripts.lua.title: Lua
io.kestra.plugin.scripts.lua.body: Provide Lua code inline or script files and arguments to execute via the Lua runtime in Kestra, capturing stdout/stderr and outputs.

io.kestra.plugin.kestra.ee.iam.bindings.title: Kestra IAM Bindings
io.kestra.plugin.kestra.ee.iam.bindings.description: Task that manages role bindings for users and service accounts.
io.kestra.plugin.kestra.ee.iam.bindings.body: Provide the Kestra API URL, auth token, and a subject (user or service account) with the desired roles to create or replace IAM role bindings in a namespace.

io.kestra.plugin.debezium.oracle.title: Debezium Oracle
io.kestra.plugin.debezium.oracle.description: Tasks that capture Oracle database change events through Debezium for Kestra flows.
io.kestra.plugin.debezium.oracle.body: Capture, Trigger, and RealtimeTrigger run the Debezium Oracle connector to stream redo log changes into Kestra. Supply hostname/port, credentials, the database `sid` (and optional `pluggableDatabase` for CDB setups), pick snapshotMode, and apply include/exclude filters; use Trigger to batch records by maxRecords/durations or RealtimeTrigger for per-row executions.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.purestorage.title: Pure Storage FlashArray (EE)
io.kestra.plugin.ee.purestorage.description: Manage Pure Storage FlashArray systems from Kestra: volumes, snapshots, ActiveDR pods, and array/alert monitoring.

io.kestra.plugin.kvm.title: KVM / Libvirt
io.kestra.plugin.kvm.description: Manage KVM virtual machines using the Libvirt API.
io.kestra.plugin.kvm.body: Use these tasks to define, start, stop, and delete virtual machines, update configurations, and list active or inactive domains directly from Kestra workflows. They require access to a libvirtd daemon (via local socket, SSH, or TLS) and accept task-specific settings such as XML definitions, power-state flags, and resource cleanup options for persistent storage. The included trigger allows for automated responses to VM lifecycle events, such as state transitions or unexpected shutdowns.

io.kestra.plugin.pipedrive.deals.title: Pipedrive Deals
io.kestra.plugin.pipedrive.deals.description: Tasks that create, retrieve, update, list, and delete deals in Pipedrive.
io.kestra.plugin.pipedrive.deals.body: Provide the Pipedrive `apiToken` along with deal fields such as `title`, `value`, `currency`, and pipeline/stage IDs to insert, fetch, filter, or modify deals and capture the returned deal payload for further automation. Deleting a deal only soft-deletes it in Pipedrive; use `Update` with `status: 'won'` or `status: 'lost'` for the normal close-out workflow instead.

io.kestra.plugin.twilio.sendgrid.title: Sendgrid
io.kestra.plugin.twilio.sendgrid.description: Tasks that send email via SendGrid.
io.kestra.plugin.twilio.sendgrid.body: Set the SendGrid API key, from/to addresses, subject, and content (plus optional templates and attachments) to deliver emails through SendGrid from Kestra workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.huawei.dms.kafka.title: Huawei DMS for Kafka
io.kestra.plugin.huawei.dms.kafka.description: Produce, consume, trigger, and react to messages on Huawei Cloud DMS for Kafka

io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.networ.title: Infoblox Network Views
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.networ.description: Tasks to manage network views in Infoblox via the WAPI REST API.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.networ.body: List, create, and delete network view objects in Infoblox.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.f5.title: F5 BIG-IP (EE)
io.kestra.plugin.ee.f5.description: Manage F5 BIG-IP LTM nodes, pools, pool members, virtual servers, and health monitors via the iControl REST API.

io.kestra.plugin.xquik.trends.title: Xquik Trends
io.kestra.plugin.xquik.trends.description: Tasks that retrieve public X/Twitter trends with Xquik.
io.kestra.plugin.xquik.trends.body: Use these tasks to list regional or worldwide X/Twitter trends for scheduled research and monitoring flows. Set `apiKey` with `{{ secret('XQUIK_API_KEY') }}`.

io.kestra.plugin.fs.local.title: Local
io.kestra.plugin.fs.local.description: Tasks that manipulate files on the local file system.
io.kestra.plugin.fs.local.body: Use local path inputs to upload, download, list, copy, move, or delete files and enable the polling trigger to react to new or modified files in directories.

io.kestra.plugin.microsoft365.title: Microsoft 365
io.kestra.plugin.microsoft365.description: Tasks that integrate Microsoft 365 and Dynamics 365 services.
io.kestra.plugin.microsoft365.body: Authenticate with Microsoft Graph or Azure AD (tenant, client ID/secret or certificate) once and reuse the connection to manage Outlook mail, OneDrive/SharePoint files, Dataverse entities, and Business Central financials directly from Kestra workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.gcp.pubsub.title: Google Cloud Pub/Sub
io.kestra.plugin.gcp.pubsub.description: Process real-time data streams with Google Cloud Pub/Sub. Build event-driven workflows that respond instantly to your data.

io.kestra.plugin.databricks.cluster.title: Databricks Cluster
io.kestra.plugin.databricks.cluster.description: Tasks that create and delete Databricks clusters.
io.kestra.plugin.databricks.cluster.body: Use these tasks to provision or retire Databricks compute directly from a flow with your workspace host and token. Provide the cluster name, Spark version, and either a fixed worker count (`numWorkers`) or autoscaling bounds (`minWorkers`/`maxWorkers`), optionally with an auto-termination timeout.

io.kestra.plugin.clevercloud.logs.title: Clever Cloud Logs
io.kestra.plugin.clevercloud.logs.description: Tasks and triggers for fetching, streaming, and forwarding Clever Cloud application logs.

io.kestra.plugin.fs.udp.title: UDP
io.kestra.plugin.fs.udp.description: Tasks that send and receive datagrams over UDP with optional triggers.
io.kestra.plugin.fs.udp.body: Set target host/port, payload, buffer size, and timeout options to send or listen for UDP packets, and use the trigger mode to start flows when datagrams are received.

io.kestra.plugin.dropbox.files.title: Dropbox Files
io.kestra.plugin.dropbox.files.description: Tasks that manage files and folders in Dropbox.
io.kestra.plugin.dropbox.files.body: Use these tasks to upload from Kestra storage, download back to it, list or search folders, and create, copy, move, or delete items while retrieving metadata when needed. All tasks require a Dropbox accessToken secret; Dropbox paths must begin with '/', and file-oriented steps accept Kestra storage URIs for inputs and outputs.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.csp.ipam.ra.title: Infoblox Universal DDI DHCP Ranges
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.csp.ipam.ra.description: Tasks to manage DHCP ranges (ipam/range) in Infoblox Universal DDI (Cloud Services Portal).
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.csp.ipam.ra.body: List, create, update, and delete DHCP range objects.

io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.as400.title: AS400
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.as400.description: Tasks that connect to AS400 via JDBC to run queries and loads.
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.as400.body: Provide the AS400 JDBC URL, credentials, and SQL statements (query, batch, load, trigger) to read or write data; configure fetch type, fetch size, and output options to return rows or files from workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.notifications.twilio.title: Twilio
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.twilio.description: Tasks that send SMS or voice notifications through Twilio.
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.twilio.body: Provide Twilio account SID/auth token plus from/to numbers and message text (or call URL) to deliver SMS or voice calls from Kestra workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.core.dashboard.chart.title: Chart
io.kestra.plugin.core.dashboard.chart.description: Tasks that render dashboard charts from Kestra data sources.
io.kestra.plugin.core.dashboard.chart.body: Use these chart widgets to visualize metrics, executions, or flow trends in dashboards; pair them with dashboard data queries and configure aggregations, groupings, and chart options for Bar, Pie, Time Series, KPI, or Table outputs.

io.kestra.plugin.solace.title: Solace
io.kestra.plugin.solace.description: Tasks that publish, consume, and trigger workflows with Solace messaging.
io.kestra.plugin.solace.body: Provide Solace connection details (host, VPN, username/password), topics/queues, and serializers to send messages, consume with acknowledgment options, or trigger flows when new messages arrive.

io.kestra.plugin.proxmox.snapshot.title: Proxmox VE Snapshots
io.kestra.plugin.proxmox.snapshot.description: Tasks that create, delete, list, and roll back snapshots for QEMU VMs and LXC containers on Proxmox VE.
io.kestra.plugin.proxmox.snapshot.body: Specify node, resource type, VMID, and snapshot name to manage point-in-time state. Rollback reverts the machine to a named snapshot; List returns all snapshots for a given resource.

io.kestra.plugin.googleworkspace.chat.title: Google Chat
io.kestra.plugin.googleworkspace.chat.description: Tasks that send notifications to Google Chat.
io.kestra.plugin.googleworkspace.chat.body: Provide the Google Chat webhook URL and message text (or cards) to post notifications from Kestra into Chat rooms.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.f5.node.title: F5 BIG-IP Node
io.kestra.plugin.ee.f5.node.description: Manage F5 BIG-IP LTM nodes (backend IP registrations).

io.kestra.plugin.azure.storage.cosmosdb.title: Cosmos DB
io.kestra.plugin.azure.storage.cosmosdb.description: Tasks that interact with Azure Cosmos DB.
io.kestra.plugin.azure.storage.cosmosdb.body: Create, query, batch, and delete Cosmos DB container items using a connection string or SAS/shared key and endpoint.

io.kestra.plugin.miro.title: Miro
io.kestra.plugin.miro.description: Tasks and triggers for managing Miro boards from Kestra flows.
io.kestra.plugin.miro.body: Provide a Miro OAuth 2.0 bearer token to list, get, create, update, delete, and copy Miro boards, and to trigger flows when new boards are created.

io.kestra.plugin.azure.aifoundry.title: Azure AI Foundry
io.kestra.plugin.azure.aifoundry.description: Tasks and triggers to interact with Azure AI Foundry.
io.kestra.plugin.azure.aifoundry.body: Leverage Microsoft's unified platform for building, evaluating, and deploying AI models. Perform chat completions, generate embeddings, run persistent agents, and retrieve deployment information directly within Kestra data pipelines.

io.kestra.plugin.scripts.go.title: Go
io.kestra.plugin.scripts.go.body: Provide Go code inline or files with modules and build/run arguments to compile or execute Go programs within Kestra, capturing logs and outputs.

io.kestra.plugin.netskope.scim.title: Netskope SCIM
