io.kestra.plugin.netskope.scim.description: Tasks to manage user and group identity lifecycle in Netskope Security Cloud via SCIM 2.0.

io.kestra.plugin.digitalocean.domain.rec.title: DigitalOcean Domain Record
io.kestra.plugin.digitalocean.domain.rec.description: Tasks for managing DNS records within a DigitalOcean domain zone.
io.kestra.plugin.digitalocean.domain.rec.body: List, read, create, and delete DNS records under a domain zone already created (see io.kestra.plugin.digitalocean.domain to create the zone itself).

io.kestra.plugin.shopify.orders.title: Shopify Orders
io.kestra.plugin.shopify.orders.description: Tasks that list or delete orders from Shopify.
io.kestra.plugin.shopify.orders.body: Use the store domain and Admin API token to page through orders or remove them by ID, applying filters such as status or fulfillment state while respecting API versioning and rate limits.

io.kestra.plugin.slack.app.canvases.title: Slack Canvases
io.kestra.plugin.slack.app.canvases.description: Tasks that create, edit, and secure Slack canvases.
io.kestra.plugin.slack.app.canvases.body: Run with an app `token` that has canvases scopes; creation needs a `title` plus markdown `documentContent`, while updates/deletes require the target `canvasId` and relevant `sectionId`. Use these to publish documentation, adjust sections, or update access via flows.

io.kestra.plugin.pylon.issue.title: Pylon Issues
io.kestra.plugin.pylon.issue.description: Tasks and a trigger for creating, listing, updating, and replying to Pylon support issues (tickets).
io.kestra.plugin.pylon.issue.body: Create, fetch, list, and update Pylon issues; post customer-facing replies or internal notes; and react to new or updated issues with a polling trigger.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.veeam.sessions.title: Veeam Sessions
io.kestra.plugin.ee.veeam.sessions.description: Tasks for listing, inspecting, and retrieving logs of Veeam Backup & Replication job sessions.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.veeam.sessions.body: List sessions, get a single session with optional polling until completion, and retrieve session logs to internal storage.

io.kestra.plugin.bluesky.title: Bluesky
io.kestra.plugin.bluesky.description: Tasks that post messages to Bluesky (AT Protocol).
io.kestra.plugin.bluesky.body: Provide Bluesky credentials and post content to publish skeets from Kestra workflows, handling authentication and response payloads via the AT Protocol API.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.trigge.title: Infoblox Triggers
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.trigge.description: Polling triggers for Infoblox IPAM events via the WAPI REST API.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.trigge.body: Trigger flows on IPv4 or IPv6 address allocation and release events in Infoblox.

io.kestra.plugin.figma.triggers.title: Triggers
io.kestra.plugin.figma.triggers.description: Poll Figma files for changes and start a flow execution.
io.kestra.plugin.figma.triggers.body: Poll a Figma file and start an execution whenever its `lastModified` timestamp advances.

io.kestra.plugin.kestra.ee.iam.roles.title: Kestra IAM Roles
io.kestra.plugin.kestra.ee.iam.roles.description: Tasks that create, list, and delete IAM roles.
io.kestra.plugin.kestra.ee.iam.roles.body: Set the Kestra API URL and auth token to upsert roles with specific permissions, list existing roles, or delete them by name, enabling automated role lifecycle management from orchestrated workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.csp.dns.rec.title: Infoblox Universal DDI DNS Records
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.csp.dns.rec.description: Tasks to manage the unified, type-discriminated DNS record object (dns/record) in Infoblox Universal DDI (Cloud Services Portal).
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.csp.dns.rec.body: List, create, update, and delete DNS records. Universal DDI unifies A, AAAA, CNAME, PTR, TXT, MX, NS, and SRV into one object discriminated by a `type` field, unlike NIOS's per-type record objects.

io.kestra.plugin.notifications.telegram.title: Telegram
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.telegram.description: Tasks that send notifications via Telegram bots.
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.telegram.body: Set your Telegram bot token and chat ID to send messages (text or markdown) from Kestra workflows to chats or channels.

io.kestra.plugin.gcp.cli.title: Google Cloud CLI
io.kestra.plugin.gcp.cli.description: Execute any Google Cloud CLI command directly from your workflows. Automate GCP operations using the full power of the gcloud CLI.

io.kestra.plugin.opsgenie.title: Atlassian Opsgenie
io.kestra.plugin.opsgenie.description: Tasks that create alerts in Opsgenie.
io.kestra.plugin.opsgenie.body: Provide the Opsgenie API endpoint and integration key, along with message, priority, responders, and tags to open alerts from Kestra flows and receive response payloads.

io.kestra.plugin.neo4j.title: Neo4j
io.kestra.plugin.neo4j.description: Tasks that run Cypher queries against Neo4j.
io.kestra.plugin.neo4j.body: Provide Neo4j URI/auth credentials and Cypher statements with parameters to read or write graph data, returning query results for analytics or lineage workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.gcp.spanner.title: Google Cloud Spanner
io.kestra.plugin.gcp.spanner.description: Tasks to query, execute DML/DDL statements, and manage databases in Google Cloud Spanner, the globally distributed, horizontally scalable database service.
io.kestra.plugin.gcp.spanner.body: Use these tasks to execute SELECT queries, run DML/DDL updates, run batch DML operations, create or delete databases, and trigger flows on database changes in Google Cloud Spanner. Authentication follows the same GCP service account pattern as the other plugin-gcp sub-plugins (CredentialService).

io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.vectorwise.title: Actian Vector (VectorWise)
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.vectorwise.description: Tasks that connect to Actian Vector (VectorWise)  via JDBC to run queries and loads.
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.vectorwise.body: Provide the Actian Vector (VectorWise)  JDBC URL, credentials, and SQL statements (query, batch, load, trigger) to read or write data; configure fetch type, fetch size, and output options to return rows or files from workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.huawei.mrs.title: Huawei MRS
io.kestra.plugin.huawei.mrs.description: Tasks for Huawei Cloud MRS (MapReduce Service): create clusters, submit job steps, and delete clusters.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.dns.ar.title: Infoblox DNS A Records
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.dns.ar.description: Tasks to manage DNS A records in Infoblox via the WAPI REST API.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.dns.ar.body: List, create, update, and delete DNS A record objects in Infoblox.

io.kestra.plugin.digitalocean.title: DigitalOcean
io.kestra.plugin.digitalocean.description: Manage DigitalOcean droplets, Kubernetes clusters, databases, load balancers, volumes, domains, and firewalls through the DigitalOcean API v2.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.crowdstrike.intel.title: CrowdStrike Intel
io.kestra.plugin.ee.crowdstrike.intel.description: Tasks for searching CrowdStrike Falcon threat intelligence: actors, reports, and indicators.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.crowdstrike.intel.body: Search threat actors, intelligence reports, and indicators with FQL, and download report PDFs to internal storage.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.purestorage.pods.title: Pure Storage FlashArray ActiveDR Pods
io.kestra.plugin.ee.purestorage.pods.description: Tasks for managing Pure Storage FlashArray ActiveDR pods: list, get, create, promote, and demote.

io.kestra.plugin.azure.auth.title: Azure Authentication
io.kestra.plugin.azure.auth.description: Tasks that obtain Azure access tokens for authenticated calls to other services.
io.kestra.plugin.azure.auth.body: Fetch Azure OAuth access tokens for downstream tasks using tenantId with either client secret, certificate, or DefaultAzureCredential. Configure scopes (defaults to https://management.azure.com/.default) and receive the encrypted token value with its expiration time in the outputs.

io.kestra.plugin.slack.app.conversations.title: Slack Conversations
io.kestra.plugin.slack.app.conversations.description: Tasks that manage Slack channels, DMs, and conversation history.
io.kestra.plugin.slack.app.conversations.body: Requires a bot `token` with conversation scopes; supply a `channel`/`conversationId` for membership changes, renames, archiving, or topic/purpose updates, and use `cursor`/`limit` options when listing or pulling history. Useful for provisioning channels, moderating membership, or paging archives from workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.sentry.title: Sentry
io.kestra.plugin.sentry.description: Tasks that send events to Sentry.
io.kestra.plugin.sentry.body: Provide the Sentry DSN and event payload (message, level, tags, extras) to capture errors or alerts in Sentry from Kestra flows.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.splunk.title: Splunk (EE)
io.kestra.plugin.ee.splunk.description: Tasks that send Kestra logs to Splunk via HTTP Event Collector for centralized search and monitoring.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.splunk.body: Use when forwarding workflow logs to Splunk HEC; requires the HEC base URL and token. Supports batching (default 1,000 events) and optional HTTP client settings for TLS, proxies, and timeouts.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.canonical.maas.title: MAAS
io.kestra.plugin.ee.canonical.maas.description: Tasks to automate provisioning and lifecycle management of bare-metal infrastructure using Canonical MAAS (Metal as a Service), providing cloud-like server deployment, inventory, and API-driven infrastructure workflows.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.canonical.maas.body: Automate the full bare-metal lifecycle on Canonical MAAS: `EnlistMachine` registers hardware, `CommissionMachine` inventories and validates it, `DeployMachine` installs an operating system, `PowerControlMachine` manages power state (on/off/cycle/query), and `ListMachines` queries the inventory with filters. All tasks authenticate with a MAAS `url` and an OAuth `apiKey` in `consumer:token:secret` format.

io.kestra.plugin.hubspot.contacts.title: HubSpot Contacts
io.kestra.plugin.hubspot.contacts.description: Tasks that create, update, search, and delete HubSpot contacts.
io.kestra.plugin.hubspot.contacts.body: Use your HubSpot token with contact properties (emails, names, custom fields) to insert or update records, search by filters, and remove contacts by ID while capturing API responses for enrichment flows.

io.kestra.plugin.azure.batch.pool.title: Azure Batch Pool
io.kestra.plugin.azure.batch.pool.description: Tasks that scale and manage Azure Batch pools.
io.kestra.plugin.azure.batch.pool.body: Scale and manage Azure Batch pools by adjusting dedicated or low-priority nodes. Authenticate with the Batch endpoint, account, and accessKey, then resize pools and wait until they are active; outputs surface the resulting pool sizing for downstream scheduling decisions.

io.kestra.plugin.scripts.jbang.title: JBang
io.kestra.plugin.scripts.jbang.description: Tasks that run Java code with JBang.
io.kestra.plugin.scripts.jbang.body: Provide Java code inline or source files with dependencies and JBang options to compile and run via JBang from Kestra, capturing outputs for downstream steps.

io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.vertica.title: Vertica
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.vertica.description: Tasks that connect to Vertica via JDBC to run queries and loads.
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.vertica.body: Provide the Vertica JDBC URL, credentials, and SQL statements (query, batch, load, trigger) to read or write data; configure fetch type, fetch size, and output options to return rows or files from workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.aws.batch.title: AWS Batch
io.kestra.plugin.ee.aws.batch.description: Tasks for running jobs on AWS Batch.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.aws.batch.body: Submits a job to an existing AWS Batch job queue using an existing job definition (pure orchestration, no resource creation). Provide `region` with AWS credentials or an assumed role, plus `jobQueue` and `jobDefinition`. Override `parameters`, `containerCommand`, or `containerEnvironment` per run, tune completion polling and `maxWait`, and enable `streamLogs` to forward CloudWatch job logs into Kestra.

io.kestra.plugin.notifications.squadcast.title: Squadcast
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.squadcast.description: Tasks that create incidents in Squadcast.
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.squadcast.body: Use the Squadcast event endpoint and routing key plus incident details (message, severity, source) to raise alerts from Kestra workflows and capture the response.

io.kestra.plugin.huawei.eventgrid.title: Huawei EventGrid
io.kestra.plugin.huawei.eventgrid.description: Tasks for Huawei Cloud EventGrid: publish CloudEvents-formatted events to a custom channel.

io.kestra.plugin.temporal.title: Temporal
io.kestra.plugin.temporal.description: Kestra tasks for interacting with Temporal workflow orchestration: trigger, signal, query, wait, and schedule workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.vmware.title: VMware (EE)
io.kestra.plugin.ee.vmware.description: Tasks that automate VMware vSphere operations within Kestra workflows.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.vmware.body: Use this plugin to orchestrate VM lifecycle, snapshotting, and template management across ESXi and vCenter from a single flow. Configure each task with your vSphere endpoint, credentials, and optional trust store so runs can safely manage infrastructure as part of data or CI/CD pipelines.

io.kestra.plugin.clevercloud.application.title: Clever Cloud Applications
io.kestra.plugin.clevercloud.application.description: Tasks for managing Clever Cloud applications: create, configure, scale, deploy, and delete.
io.kestra.plugin.clevercloud.application.body: Manage the lifecycle of Clever Cloud applications from Kestra: list, inspect, create, set environment variables, scale, redeploy, restart, stop, and delete. Authenticates with a single API token, and targets the personal account via /self when organisationId is omitted.

io.kestra.plugin.meilisearch.title: Meilisearch
io.kestra.plugin.meilisearch.description: Tasks that load data into and query Meilisearch indexes.
io.kestra.plugin.meilisearch.body: Provide the Meilisearch host and API key to create or update indexes, push documents, configure settings, and search with filters, returning JSON results for downstream processing.

io.kestra.plugin.github.title: GitHub
io.kestra.plugin.github.description: Tasks that search GitHub and manage issues, pulls, and workflows.
io.kestra.plugin.github.body: Authenticate with a GitHub token and repository/org details to search code, commits, repos, users, topics; create or comment on issues and pull requests; and dispatch Actions workflows, returning API payloads for orchestration.

io.kestra.plugin.hightouch.title: Hightouch
io.kestra.plugin.hightouch.description: Tasks that trigger and monitor Hightouch syncs.
io.kestra.plugin.hightouch.body: Provide a Hightouch API token and sync ID to start a sync, optionally wait for completion, and retrieve run status, modified rows, and errors for reverse ETL orchestration.

io.kestra.plugin.gcp.bigtable.title: Google Cloud Bigtable
io.kestra.plugin.gcp.bigtable.description: Tasks to read, write, and delete rows in Google Cloud Bigtable, the fully managed, petabyte-scale NoSQL database optimised for high-throughput, low-latency workloads.
io.kestra.plugin.gcp.bigtable.body: Use these tasks to read, write, and delete rows or tables in Google Cloud Bigtable, and to trigger flows when new rows are detected. Authentication follows the same GCP service account pattern as the other plugin-gcp sub-plugins (CredentialService). Use ReadRows with the STORE fetch type for large result sets to avoid loading the full result set into memory.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.azure.batch.job.title: Azure Batch
io.kestra.plugin.ee.azure.batch.job.description: Tasks that provision and supervise Azure Batch jobs and task executions.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.azure.batch.job.body: Create Batch jobs with one or more tasks, wait for completion with optional timeouts, and resume existing runs when allowed while pushing task outputs back to internal storage; requires the Batch `endpoint`, `account`, and `poolId` plus job and task definitions, with `accessKey` for shared-key authentication and optional `delete`, `resume`, and `maxDuration` controls.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.hpoo.title: HP OO (EE)
io.kestra.plugin.ee.hpoo.description: Trigger and manage HP Operations Orchestration (OpenText OO) flows from Kestra.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.hpoo.body: Supports both Classic OO (REST v2, HTTP Basic auth) and Containerized OO (REST v1, token auth).

io.kestra.plugin.ai.agent.title: Agent
io.kestra.plugin.ai.agent.description: Tasks that run AI agents combining system prompts, user input, tools, content retrievers, and optional memory to produce grounded responses, including proxying prompts to remote agents over the A2A protocol.

io.kestra.plugin.slack.app.users.title: Slack Users
io.kestra.plugin.slack.app.users.description: Tasks that look up Slack users, profiles, and memberships.
io.kestra.plugin.slack.app.users.body: Use a bot `token`; fetch by `userId` or `email` for details/presence, list all users with paging, or retrieve a user's conversations for routing. Helpful for targeting alerts, enriching audit logs, or resolving emails to Slack IDs in workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.netskope.events.title: Netskope Events
io.kestra.plugin.netskope.events.description: Tasks to fetch alerts, events, and audit logs from Netskope Security Cloud via the REST API v2 Data Export endpoint.

io.kestra.plugin.metaplane.title: Metaplane
io.kestra.plugin.metaplane.description: Run and read data-observability monitors from Metaplane.

io.kestra.plugin.github.users.title: GitHub Users
io.kestra.plugin.github.users.body: Use a GitHub token with search criteria such as name, org, or location to list users and return profile metadata for audits or onboarding workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.csp.dns.aut.title: Infoblox Universal DDI Authoritative Zones
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.csp.dns.aut.description: Tasks to manage authoritative DNS zones (dns/auth_zone) in Infoblox Universal DDI (Cloud Services Portal).
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.csp.dns.aut.body: List, create, and delete authoritative DNS zone objects.

io.kestra.plugin.serdes.title: Serialization
io.kestra.plugin.serdes.description: Tasks that convert data (SerDes) between common formats for Kestra workflows.
io.kestra.plugin.serdes.body: Use format-specific tasks to transform files among JSON, CSV, Avro, Parquet, Excel, Protobuf, XML, Markdown, and YAML (via ION), with options for schema validation, bad-line handling, and output destinations.

io.kestra.plugin.fs.tcp.title: TCP
io.kestra.plugin.fs.tcp.description: Tasks that send and receive data over TCP sockets with optional triggers.
io.kestra.plugin.fs.tcp.body: Specify host/port, payload, framing, and timeout settings to write or read raw TCP data, or start a TCP server trigger to capture inbound messages and launch workflows with the received content.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.netbox.site.title: NetBox Site
io.kestra.plugin.ee.netbox.site.description: Tasks for listing sites in NetBox.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.netbox.site.body: List site records in NetBox with support for filters, field selection, pagination, and internal storage output.

io.kestra.plugin.serdes.protobuf.title: Protobuf
io.kestra.plugin.serdes.protobuf.description: Tasks that convert Protocol Buffers messages to/from ION.
io.kestra.plugin.serdes.protobuf.body: Provide Protobuf descriptors and message data to convert to ION for inspection or downstream transforms, or serialize ION back to Protobuf binaries for interchange.

io.kestra.plugin.microsoft365.outlook.title: Microsoft Outlook
io.kestra.plugin.microsoft365.outlook.description: Tasks that send and read Outlook email and trigger workflows on new messages.
io.kestra.plugin.microsoft365.outlook.body: Provide Microsoft Graph credentials and a mailbox user principal to send mail, list or fetch messages (including attachments), and use the polling trigger to start flows on new arrivals; configure optional folder filters, search queries, and attachment handling.

io.kestra.plugin.phpipam.ipam.address.title: phpIPAM Addresses
io.kestra.plugin.phpipam.ipam.address.description: Tasks and triggers for managing phpIPAM IP address records.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.netbox.device.title: NetBox Device
io.kestra.plugin.ee.netbox.device.description: Tasks for creating, updating, and listing devices in NetBox.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.netbox.device.body: Create, update, and list device records in NetBox with support for filters, field selection, pagination, and internal storage output.

io.kestra.plugin.googleworkspace.mail.title: Google Mail
io.kestra.plugin.googleworkspace.mail.description: Tasks that send, read, and trigger on Google Mail messages.
io.kestra.plugin.googleworkspace.mail.body: Authenticate with Gmail scopes, specify the user email, and provide message content or search queries to send mail, list or fetch messages (with attachments), and enable a trigger to start flows when new messages arrive.

io.kestra.plugin.pylon.title: Pylon
io.kestra.plugin.pylon.description: Create, update, and reply to Pylon support tickets, and react to new or updated ones with a polling trigger.
io.kestra.plugin.pylon.body: Manage Pylon support issues (tickets) from a Kestra flow: create, fetch, list, and update issues, post customer-facing replies or internal notes, and trigger a flow when an issue is created or updated.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.crowdstrike.title: CrowdStrike (EE)
io.kestra.plugin.ee.crowdstrike.body: Query, fetch, and update CrowdStrike Falcon alerts, hosts, indicators of compromise, Spotlight vulnerabilities, and threat intelligence.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.crowdstrike.alerts.title: CrowdStrike Alerts
io.kestra.plugin.ee.crowdstrike.alerts.description: Tasks and triggers for querying, fetching, and updating CrowdStrike Falcon alerts.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.crowdstrike.alerts.body: Query alert IDs with FQL, fetch full alert details, bulk-update status/assignment/comments, and trigger a flow on new alerts.

io.kestra.plugin.core.flow.title: Flow
io.kestra.plugin.core.flow.description: Tasks that orchestrate control flow within a Kestra pipeline.
io.kestra.plugin.core.flow.body: Sequence, branch, loop, parallelize, or nest subflows/templates using these primitives; define embedded task lists, values for switches, iteration collections, working directories, and loop exit criteria to structure complex workflows cleanly.

io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.clickhouse.title: Clickhouse
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.clickhouse.description: Tasks that connect to ClickHouse via JDBC, run clickhouse-local CLI commands, or run embedded ChDB SQL transforms.
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.clickhouse.body: Provide the ClickHouse JDBC URL, credentials, and SQL statements (query, batch, load, trigger) to read or write data; configure fetch type, fetch size, and output options to return rows or files from workflows. Use ChDB for a single embedded SQL transform with managed Ion or file output (no server). Use ClickHouseLocalCLI for arbitrary clickhouse-local commands.

io.kestra.plugin.aws.dynamodb.title: AWS DynamoDB
io.kestra.plugin.aws.dynamodb.description: Tasks that read and write Amazon DynamoDB tables: put, get, or delete individual items and run query or scan operations with expression attributes.
io.kestra.plugin.aws.dynamodb.body: Supports limiting and filtering results, then fetching rows directly or storing them to files for downstream steps.

io.kestra.plugin.debezium.postgres.title: Debezium PostgreSQL
io.kestra.plugin.debezium.postgres.description: Tasks that capture PostgreSQL logical replication changes via Debezium for Kestra workflows.
io.kestra.plugin.debezium.postgres.body: Use Capture plus batch and real-time triggers built on the Debezium PostgreSQL connector to move WAL changes into Kestra. Set database, logical decoding `pluginName`, `publicationName`, and `slotName`, pick snapshotMode, and optionally TLS settings; choose Trigger for batched polling or RealtimeTrigger to emit an execution per change.

io.kestra.plugin.figma.files.title: Files
io.kestra.plugin.figma.files.description: Read Figma file documents and export node images.
io.kestra.plugin.figma.files.body: Get a file's full document structure, or export one or more nodes as PNG/JPG/SVG/PDF images.

io.kestra.plugin.aikido.title: Aikido
io.kestra.plugin.aikido.body: Scan repositories, containers, and domains for vulnerabilities; triage and export security issues; retrieve compliance reports; and react to new critical findings in real time with the Aikido Security public API.

io.kestra.plugin.slack.app.files.title: Slack Files
io.kestra.plugin.slack.app.files.description: Tasks that upload, inspect, and delete Slack files.
io.kestra.plugin.slack.app.files.body: Run with a bot `token` that has `files:write`; uploads need a storage `from` URI plus `filename` (and optional `channels` or thread `timestamp`), while info/delete calls take a file `id`. Use these to publish generated reports or clean up shared artifacts from flows.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.core.log.title: Log (EE)
io.kestra.plugin.ee.core.log.description: Tasks that export execution or audit logs and manage retention across observability targets or internal storage.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.core.log.body: LogShipper and AuditLogShipper stream logs in batches through configured `logExporters` using `offsetKey` and optional `lookbackPeriod`, while FileLogExporter writes chunked files (`format`, `maxLinesPerFile`, `logFilePrefix`) to internal storage. PurgeAuditLogs trims audit history using `endDate` with optional `namespace`, `resources`, and `types`, helping control retention and compliance.

io.kestra.plugin.scripts.powershell.title: PowerShell
io.kestra.plugin.scripts.powershell.body: Provide PowerShell code inline or ps1 files with arguments to execute via PowerShell, capturing stdout/stderr and any output files for subsequent steps.

io.kestra.plugin.clevercloud.addons.title: Clever Cloud Add-ons
io.kestra.plugin.clevercloud.addons.description: Tasks and a trigger for managing Clever Cloud add-ons: databases, caches, and other managed services.

io.kestra.plugin.core.storage.title: Storage
io.kestra.plugin.core.storage.description: Tasks that manipulate files in Kestra's internal storage.
io.kestra.plugin.core.storage.body: Write, delete, concatenate, split, deduplicate, filter, reverse, size, or list files used by executions; provide source and target storage URIs and any encoding or line-handling options to transform stored data safely.

io.kestra.plugin.aws.cloudwatch.title: AWS CloudWatch
io.kestra.plugin.aws.cloudwatch.description: Tasks that push custom metrics, query recent CloudWatch metric statistics, and trigger flows when metric queries return data.
io.kestra.plugin.aws.cloudwatch.body: These tasks provide lightweight observability hooks without managing agents.

io.kestra.plugin.huawei.smn.title: Huawei SMN
io.kestra.plugin.huawei.smn.description: Tasks for Huawei Cloud SMN: publish notification messages to a topic.

io.kestra.plugin.fs.ssh.title: SSH (Secure Shell)
io.kestra.plugin.fs.ssh.description: Tasks that run commands over SSH and handle files on remote hosts.
io.kestra.plugin.fs.ssh.body: Configure host/port with username and password or private key, and optional known-hosts handling, to execute commands or transfer files via SSH, capturing outputs and exit codes for orchestration.

io.kestra.plugin.azure.storage.adls.upda.title: Azure Data Lake Storage Update
io.kestra.plugin.azure.storage.adls.upda.description: Tasks that update files in Azure Data Lake Storage (append, lease, access control).

io.kestra.plugin.notifications.google.title: Google
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.google.description: Tasks that send notifications to Google Chat.
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.google.body: Provide the Google Chat webhook URL and message text (or cards) to post notifications from Kestra into Chat rooms.

io.kestra.plugin.cobol.title: IBM i / AS400 COBOL
io.kestra.plugin.cobol.description: Tasks that run, submit and create IBM i COBOL programs and jobs
io.kestra.plugin.cobol.body: Call IBM i (AS/400) COBOL programs synchronously with `CallJob`, submit them as asynchronous batch jobs with `SubmitJob`, and compile COBOL source into program objects with `CreateProgram`, all over the JTOpen library and authenticated with a host, user profile, and password.

io.kestra.plugin.docker.title: Docker
io.kestra.plugin.docker.description: Docker tasks for building images, running containers, and managing artifacts from Kestra workflows, plus managing AI models through the Docker Model Runner.
io.kestra.plugin.docker.body: The `cli` subgroup requires access to a Docker daemon via host socket or TCP endpoint; the caller inherits daemon permissions, so scope access carefully. Its tasks cover build, image listing, push/pull, tagging, Compose execution, container lifecycle, and pruning. Registry auth is optional and set per task; pass tags, compose files, and run options explicitly. The separate `model` subgroup manages AI models through the Docker Model Runner (DMR) REST API and needs no Docker daemon.

io.kestra.plugin.liquibase.title: Liquibase
io.kestra.plugin.liquibase.description: Tasks that run Liquibase change management commands.
io.kestra.plugin.liquibase.body: Provide database connection details and changelog files to run updates, diffs, rollbacks, validations, or status checks via Liquibase CLI options, returning output for deployment pipelines.

io.kestra.plugin.kubernetes.core.title: Kubernetes Core
io.kestra.plugin.kubernetes.core.description: Tasks that create pods and manage core workload execution on Kubernetes.
io.kestra.plugin.kubernetes.core.body: Use PodCreate with connection settings, namespace, image, command, env, and volume mounts to launch jobs, stream logs, and wait for completion with configurable timeouts; ideal for running containerized steps inside workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.csp.ipam.ad.title: Infoblox Universal DDI Addresses
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.csp.ipam.ad.description: Tasks to manage addresses (ipam/address) in Infoblox Universal DDI (Cloud Services Portal).
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.csp.ipam.ad.body: List addresses, allocate the next available address from a subnet or address block, and release reservations.

io.kestra.plugin.digitalocean.database.title: DigitalOcean Database
io.kestra.plugin.digitalocean.database.description: Tasks for managing DigitalOcean managed database clusters.
io.kestra.plugin.digitalocean.database.body: List, read, create, resize, and delete managed database clusters (Postgres, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, Kafka, OpenSearch).

io.kestra.plugin.hubspot.deals.title: HubSpot Deals
io.kestra.plugin.hubspot.deals.description: Tasks that create, update, search, and delete HubSpot deals.
io.kestra.plugin.hubspot.deals.body: Provide your HubSpot token along with pipeline/stage, amounts, and related contact/company IDs to manage deals, search with filters, and remove records, returning deal payloads for revenue operations workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.phpipam.ipam.vrf.title: phpIPAM VRFs
io.kestra.plugin.phpipam.ipam.vrf.description: Tasks for managing phpIPAM VRFs (Virtual Routing and Forwarding instances).

io.kestra.plugin.youtube.title: YouTube
io.kestra.plugin.youtube.description: Tasks that interact with the YouTube Data API.
io.kestra.plugin.youtube.body: Provide API credentials and channel or video identifiers to search videos, list playlists, or manage uploads, returning metadata for content and reporting workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.azure.logicapps.title: Azure Logic Apps
io.kestra.plugin.azure.logicapps.description: Tasks and triggers for running and monitoring Azure Logic Apps workflows.
io.kestra.plugin.azure.logicapps.body: Authenticate using an Azure AD service principal (tenantId, clientId, clientSecret, optionally pemCertificate) and provide subscriptionId, resourceGroupName, and workflowName. Use Run to trigger workflows and surface the new runId from the Location header, GetRun and ListRuns to inspect executions, Get and List for workflow metadata, and Trigger to react to completed or failed runs. List supports maxWorkflows to cap large resource groups.

io.kestra.plugin.opensearch.title: OpenSearch
io.kestra.plugin.opensearch.description: Tasks that load, search, and manage data in OpenSearch clusters.
io.kestra.plugin.opensearch.body: Configure OpenSearch hosts with optional basic auth or headers, then run load/bulk/index operations and search or scroll queries against specific indices; routing, refresh policies, HTTP methods, and path prefixes are exposed for fine-grained control.

io.kestra.plugin.trello.cards.title: Trello Cards
io.kestra.plugin.trello.cards.description: Tasks and triggers for managing Trello cards - create, update, move, comment, and monitor card changes.
io.kestra.plugin.trello.cards.body: The Cards subpackage provides comprehensive functionality for working with Trello cards. It includes tasks to create new cards, update existing ones, move cards between lists or boards, add comments, and a polling trigger to monitor card creation and updates. These capabilities enable automated card management and event-driven workflows based on Trello card activities.

io.kestra.plugin.scripts.runner.docker.title: Docker Task Runner
io.kestra.plugin.scripts.runner.docker.description: Run a task in a Docker container.
io.kestra.plugin.scripts.runner.docker.body: This task runner executes tasks in a container-based Docker-compatible engine.

io.kestra.plugin.argocd.title: Argo CD
io.kestra.plugin.argocd.description: GitOps-focused tasks that interact with Argo CD using the Argo CD CLI. Tasks are executed inside a container and rely on the official Argo CD CLI to perform application synchronization, status inspection, spec patching and application lifecycle management.

io.kestra.plugin.cloudflare.cache.title: Cloudflare Cache
io.kestra.plugin.cloudflare.cache.description: Tasks that manage Cloudflare cache operations.
io.kestra.plugin.cloudflare.cache.body: Purge entire zone cache or specific cached files and URLs. Automate cache invalidation workflows securely using Cloudflare API tokens.

io.kestra.plugin.zulip.title: Zulip
io.kestra.plugin.zulip.description: Tasks that send messages to Zulip streams or users.
io.kestra.plugin.zulip.body: Provide Zulip server URL, email/API key, stream/topic or user targets, and message content to post notifications from Kestra workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.databricks.cli.title: Databricks CLI
io.kestra.plugin.databricks.cli.description: Tasks that execute Databricks CLI and SQL CLI commands through containerized tools.
io.kestra.plugin.databricks.cli.body: Run administrative actions or quick queries with the Databricks CLI by supplying the workspace host, personal access token, and the CLI commands to execute, or target the SQL warehouse via the SQL CLI with host, token, HTTP path, and SQL statements. Ideal for scripting one-off operations, validating configurations, or orchestrating CLI-based workflows without managing the binaries yourself.

io.kestra.plugin.ai.tool.title: Tool
io.kestra.plugin.ai.tool.description: Tasks that expose tools agents can call: Kestra flow/task runners, sub-agent and A2A delegation, skills, code execution, MCP clients, and web search to extend LLM reasoning with actions and real-time data.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.azure.storage.blob.title: Azure Blob Storage
io.kestra.plugin.ee.azure.storage.blob.description: Tasks for interacting with Azure Blob Storage.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.azure.storage.blob.body: List blobs in a container with optional prefix and regexp filters, and generate time-bound SAS URIs granting specific permissions on a blob; configure the storage `endpoint` with a connection string, shared key, or SAS credentials and provide the target `container` and blob `name`.

io.kestra.plugin.ai.title: AI
io.kestra.plugin.ai.description: Tasks that orchestrate generative AI in Kestra with LangChain4j, covering chat completions, agents, RAG, tools, and shared providers.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.kubernetes.title: Kubernetes (EE)
io.kestra.plugin.ee.kubernetes.description: Tasks that integrate Kestra Enterprise workflows with Kubernetes clusters.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.kubernetes.body: Use these plugins to run tasks inside your own Kubernetes environment, keeping execution close to cluster services and secrets while using the Enterprise task runner. Provide cluster connection details or rely on in-cluster authentication, and ensure the service account grants pods, exec, and log permissions so pods can start, stream logs, and exchange files.

io.kestra.plugin.algolia.title: Algolia
io.kestra.plugin.algolia.description: Tasks that integrate with Algolia Search to index, query, and delete records.
io.kestra.plugin.algolia.body: They use your Algolia Application ID and Admin API Key to operate on a target index, supporting batch writes, replacements, and removals. Use them to populate indexes (Index), clean up by objectID (Delete), or retrieve hits with any Algolia search parameters (Search).

io.kestra.plugin.ee.nutanix.title: Nutanix (EE)
io.kestra.plugin.ee.nutanix.description: Tasks that automate Nutanix operations within Kestra workflows.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.nutanix.body: Use this plugin to orchestrate AHV VM lifecycle, snapshotting, and template management from a single flow. Configure each task with your endpoint and credentials so runs can safely manage infrastructure as part of data or CI/CD pipelines.

io.kestra.plugin.azure.streamanalytics.title: Azure Stream Analytics
io.kestra.plugin.azure.streamanalytics.description: Tasks for interacting with Azure Stream Analytics jobs.
io.kestra.plugin.azure.streamanalytics.body: Authenticate using an Azure AD service principal (tenantId, clientId, clientSecret) and interact with Azure Stream Analytics jobs. Tasks return job metadata such as provisioning state and runtime state, useful for building conditional flows or monitoring streaming workloads.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.vmware.esxi.title: ESXi VMs and Snapshots
io.kestra.plugin.ee.vmware.esxi.description: Tasks that manage VM lifecycle, snapshots, reconfiguration, and event triggers on a single ESXi host.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.vmware.esxi.body: Connect to the ESXi host (port 443 by default) with credentials and optional trust store. Provide VM names and network/datastore/ISO details to create, power, snapshot, or restore VMs when vCenter is unavailable.

io.kestra.plugin.gitlab.issues.title: GitLab Issues
io.kestra.plugin.gitlab.issues.description: Tasks that create, update, and fetch GitLab issues.
io.kestra.plugin.gitlab.issues.body: Set the GitLab host name, project ID, and access token to file issues with title/description, add comments or updates, and list or retrieve issue details for triage workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.kestra.logs.title: Kestra Logs
io.kestra.plugin.kestra.logs.description: Tasks that fetch logs from a Kestra instance.
io.kestra.plugin.kestra.logs.body: Set the Kestra API URL and auth token to fetch execution logs for analysis or downstream processing.

io.kestra.plugin.fivetran.title: Fivetran
io.kestra.plugin.fivetran.description: Tasks that orchestrate Fivetran connectors to automate data movement in Kestra workflows.
io.kestra.plugin.fivetran.body: Use these tasks to call the Fivetran API from Kestra pipelines, such as triggering connector syncs with built-in waiting and monitoring. Provide your Fivetran API key/secret (typically via secrets), and optionally override the API base URL or HTTP client options.

io.kestra.plugin.huawei.dms.rocketmq.title: Huawei DMS for RocketMQ
io.kestra.plugin.huawei.dms.rocketmq.description: Publish, consume, trigger, and react to messages on Huawei Cloud DMS for RocketMQ

io.kestra.plugin.huawei.obs.title: Huawei OBS
io.kestra.plugin.huawei.obs.description: Object- and bucket-level tasks for Huawei Cloud Object Storage Service (OBS): upload, download, list, copy, delete, batch-delete, create and delete buckets, and trigger flows on new objects.

io.kestra.plugin.azure.batch.job.title: Azure Batch Job
io.kestra.plugin.azure.batch.job.description: Tasks that create and supervise Azure Batch jobs and their tasks.
io.kestra.plugin.azure.batch.job.body: Create and supervise Azure Batch jobs and their tasks. Provide the Batch account endpoint, account name, access key, and poolId, then define tasks (commands, containers, files, outputs); jobs can wait for completion while emitting timing and task count metrics and returning logs or outputs.

io.kestra.plugin.cloudflare.compute.name.title: Cloudflare Workers KV Namespaces
io.kestra.plugin.cloudflare.compute.name.description: Tasks that manage Cloudflare Workers KV namespaces.
io.kestra.plugin.cloudflare.compute.name.body: Create Workers KV namespaces to organize and isolate key-value storage within a Cloudflare account. Enables structured edge data management for scalable applications.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.netapp.ontap.volumes.title: NetApp ONTAP Volumes
io.kestra.plugin.ee.netapp.ontap.volumes.description: Tasks for managing NetApp ONTAP volumes: list, get, create, resize, and delete.

io.kestra.plugin.aws.sns.title: AWS SNS
io.kestra.plugin.aws.sns.description: Tasks that publish notifications to Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) topics for pub/sub fanout or SMS, email, Lambda, and SQS targets, with support for custom message attributes.

io.kestra.plugin.notifications.messenger.title: Messenger
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.messenger.description: Tasks that send notifications via Facebook Messenger.
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.messenger.body: Provide the Facebook Page access token and recipient ID to send text or template messages from workflows into Messenger conversations.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.fixeda.title: Infoblox Fixed Addresses
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.fixeda.description: Tasks to manage IPv4 fixed address reservations in Infoblox via the WAPI REST API.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.fixeda.body: List, create, update, and delete IPv4 fixed address objects in Infoblox.

io.kestra.plugin.redis.list.title: Redis List
io.kestra.plugin.redis.list.description: Tasks that push, pop, and read Redis lists.
io.kestra.plugin.redis.list.body: Provide Redis connection settings and list keys to LPUSH/RPUSH, LPOP/RPOP, range, or trim lists so workflows can use Redis as a queue or buffer.

io.kestra.plugin.temporal.workflow.title: Temporal Workflow
io.kestra.plugin.temporal.workflow.description: Tasks that trigger, signal, query, wait for, and schedule Temporal workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.github.commits.title: GitHub Commits
io.kestra.plugin.github.commits.description: Tasks that search and list GitHub commits.
io.kestra.plugin.github.commits.body: Provide a GitHub token with repository details and search filters (branch, author, query) to retrieve commit metadata, hashes, and messages for auditing or downstream processing.

io.kestra.plugin.core.trigger.title: Trigger
io.kestra.plugin.core.trigger.description: Tasks that start flows from schedules or events.
io.kestra.plugin.core.trigger.body: Define cron-based schedules, specific date triggers, webhooks, namespace flow triggers, or toggles; set required properties like cron expressions, webhook secrets, and target flow references to control when executions fire.

io.kestra.plugin.gitlab.title: GitLab
io.kestra.plugin.gitlab.description: Tasks that interact with GitLab projects, commits, and issues via the API.
io.kestra.plugin.gitlab.body: Provide a GitLab host name and access token with project identifiers to search commits, create or update issues, and retrieve project metadata for CI/CD or governance workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.opa.policy.title: Policies
io.kestra.plugin.ee.opa.policy.description: Tasks for managing OPA policies: upload, list, delete, evaluate, and compile decisions.

io.kestra.plugin.meta.messenger.title: Messenger
io.kestra.plugin.meta.messenger.description: Tasks that send notifications via Facebook Messenger.
io.kestra.plugin.meta.messenger.body: Provide the Facebook Page access token and recipient ID to send text or template messages from workflows into Messenger conversations.

io.kestra.plugin.stripe.customer.title: Stripe Customer
io.kestra.plugin.stripe.customer.description: Tasks that create, update, and fetch Stripe customers.
io.kestra.plugin.stripe.customer.body: Provide your Stripe API key with customer attributes (email, name, metadata) to upsert customers and retrieve details for billing flows.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.csp.ipam.ip.title: Infoblox Universal DDI IP Spaces
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.csp.ipam.ip.description: Tasks to manage IP spaces (ipam/ip_space) in Infoblox Universal DDI (Cloud Services Portal).
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.csp.ipam.ip.body: List, create, and delete IP space objects, the Universal DDI equivalent of a NIOS network view.

io.kestra.plugin.monday.subitems.title: Monday Subitems
io.kestra.plugin.monday.subitems.description: Work with subitems nested under parent items.
io.kestra.plugin.monday.subitems.body: Create a subitem nested under a parent Monday item, with optional column values. Use it when breaking a top-level item down into checklist-style children from a flow.

io.kestra.plugin.ai.mcp.title: MCP
io.kestra.plugin.ai.mcp.description: Tasks that call a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server directly — list its tools or invoke one and return the result — without going through an LLM.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.veeam.restores.title: Veeam Restores
io.kestra.plugin.ee.veeam.restores.description: Tasks for triggering Veeam Backup & Replication instant VM recovery and file-level restore sessions.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.veeam.restores.body: Trigger instant VM recovery or file-level restore mounts from a restore point, then wait for completion with sessions.Get.

io.kestra.plugin.beam.title: Apache Beam
io.kestra.plugin.beam.description: Tasks that run pipelines against SDKs and dedicated runners including Apache Flink
io.kestra.plugin.beam.body: Execute Apache Beam pipelines defined in YAML on Direct, Flink, Spark, or Dataflow runners while forwarding Beam metrics to Kestra.

io.kestra.plugin.zenduty.title: Zenduty
io.kestra.plugin.zenduty.description: Tasks that create incidents in Zenduty.
io.kestra.plugin.zenduty.body: Use Zenduty routing keys and incident payloads (message, severity, entity) to trigger alerts from Kestra workflows and collect the API response.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.kubernetes.runner.title: Kubernetes Runner
io.kestra.plugin.ee.kubernetes.runner.description: Tasks that execute and orchestrate workloads as Kubernetes pods.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.kubernetes.runner.body: Configure the Kubernetes task runner on your tasks to launch containers per execution with optional working-directory sync, input/output file transfer, and pod resume handling after worker restarts. Set the container image on the task, choose the target namespace, and use resource limits, node selectors, and a service account with pod, log, and exec rights to align with cluster policies and RBAC.

io.kestra.plugin.github.auth.title: GitHub Authentication
io.kestra.plugin.github.auth.description: Tasks that issue GitHub access credentials.
io.kestra.plugin.github.auth.body: Sign a JWT with a GitHub App's RSA private key and exchange it for a short-lived installation access token. Pass the returned token to downstream `io.kestra.plugin.github.*` tasks via `appInstallationToken`.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.apps.execution.block.title: Execution App Block
io.kestra.plugin.ee.apps.execution.block.description: Tasks that provide execution-aware blocks for Kestra Apps.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.apps.execution.block.body: Blocks cover creating, resuming, or canceling executions, validating inputs, downloading logs, and showing inputs/outputs or task-specific data; they rely on the `Execution` App context to access execution variables and dispatch actions safely. Use them to build state-driven layouts that react to run status and expose controlled actions for operators.

io.kestra.plugin.aws.eventbridge.title: AWS EventBridge
io.kestra.plugin.aws.eventbridge.description: Tasks that put events on Amazon EventBridge buses with custom detail payloads so routing rules can fan them out to downstream AWS or SaaS targets.

io.kestra.plugin.aws.sqs.title: AWS SQS
io.kestra.plugin.aws.sqs.description: Tasks that publish to or consume from Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS), including polling and real-time triggers.
io.kestra.plugin.aws.sqs.body: Use them to push messages, drain queues into flow outputs, or start flows when new messages arrive.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.solarwinds.ipam.title: SolarWinds IPAM
io.kestra.plugin.ee.solarwinds.ipam.description: Tasks for IP address management in SolarWinds Orion.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.solarwinds.ipam.body: Execute SWQL queries, manage subnets, allocate and release IP addresses, organize groups, inspect DHCP scopes, and aggregate supernets in SolarWinds Orion IPAM.

io.kestra.plugin.ceph.pools.title: Ceph Pools
io.kestra.plugin.ceph.pools.description: Tasks that manage Ceph storage pools.
io.kestra.plugin.ceph.pools.body: List, get, create, update, and delete Ceph storage pools, including replication and placement group settings.

io.kestra.plugin.cassandra.title: Apache Cassandra
io.kestra.plugin.cassandra.description: Tasks that integrate Apache Cassandra into Kestra workflows for querying and event-driven triggers.
io.kestra.plugin.cassandra.body: Provides CQL-based query and trigger tasks for both self-managed Cassandra clusters and Astra DB, allowing flows to fetch data or react when rows appear. Each subgroup requires its own session configuration (endpoints with auth and SSL, or Astra secure bundle/proxy with credentials and keyspace) to establish connections.

io.kestra.plugin.monday.workspaces.title: Monday Workspaces
io.kestra.plugin.monday.workspaces.description: Top-level containers for Monday boards and folders.
io.kestra.plugin.monday.workspaces.body: Create, list, and delete the top-level workspaces that hold Monday boards and folders. Useful when bootstrapping a new tenant or tearing one down at the end of an environment lifecycle.

io.kestra.plugin.fastly.stats.title: Fastly Stats
io.kestra.plugin.fastly.stats.description: Tasks that pull historical Fastly analytics: requests, bandwidth, cache hit/miss, hit ratio, status codes, and usage breakdowns.
io.kestra.plugin.fastly.stats.body: Query historical Fastly analytics at any granularity. Supports per-service stats, account-wide aggregates, bandwidth and request usage by region or service, month-to-date totals, and a polling trigger that fires when a chosen field metric crosses a configured threshold.

io.kestra.plugin.ansible.title: Ansible
io.kestra.plugin.ansible.description: Tasks that orchestrate Ansible playbooks from Kestra flows.
io.kestra.plugin.ansible.body: Use this plugin set when you need to run Ansible automation inside Kestra with containerized runners; it supports Namespace Files or inline playbooks, injects a default ansible.cfg with the Kestra callback for structured outputs, and can expose execution logs on demand.

io.kestra.plugin.ldap.title: LDAP
io.kestra.plugin.ldap.description: Tasks that query and modify LDAP directories.
io.kestra.plugin.ldap.body: Provide LDAP server URL, bind DN/password, and base DN to search entries, add/modify attributes, or delete objects, enabling identity data automation from Kestra.

io.kestra.plugin.stripe.title: Stripe
io.kestra.plugin.stripe.description: Tasks that interact with Stripe customers, payments, balances, and webhooks.
io.kestra.plugin.stripe.body: Provide your Stripe API key and relevant IDs to create or retrieve customers, charge or refund payments, check balances, and process webhook events using signing secrets for secure automation.

io.kestra.plugin.argocd.apps.title: Argo CD Apps
io.kestra.plugin.argocd.apps.description: GitOps-focused tasks that sync, inspect, patch or manage the lifecycle of an Argo CD application via the Argo CD CLI. Use `Sync` to apply the desired GitOps Git state, `Status` to read sync/health, conditions, and resources, `Patch` to update the application spec, `Create` to declare a new application, and `Delete` to remove one.
io.kestra.plugin.argocd.apps.body: Use `Sync` to apply the desired GitOps Git state (supports prune/dry-run/force plus optional revision and timeout), `Status` to read sync/health, conditions, and resources (optionally with `refresh`), `Patch` to update the application spec with a JSON or merge patch, `Create` to declare an application from a Git repository or from an Application manifest, and `Delete` to remove an application with or without its cluster resources. All tasks need the Argo CD `server`, `token`, and `application` along with optional TLS/connection flags (`insecure`, `plaintext`, `grpcWeb`, `serverCert`) and CLI image/version overrides.

io.kestra.plugin.aikido.issues.title: Aikido Issues
io.kestra.plugin.aikido.issues.description: Tasks and a trigger for listing, fetching, exporting, and snoozing Aikido security issues.
io.kestra.plugin.aikido.issues.body: List and fetch open issue groups, export issues to CSV/JSON, snooze or unsnooze issues, and trigger a flow on newly detected issues above a severity threshold.

io.kestra.plugin.huawei.rfs.title: Huawei RFS
io.kestra.plugin.huawei.rfs.description: Tasks for Huawei Cloud RFS (Resource Formation Service): create, update, and delete Terraform/HCL-based resource stacks.

io.kestra.plugin.core.execution.title: Execution
io.kestra.plugin.core.execution.description: Tasks that manage the lifecycle and context of a running execution.
io.kestra.plugin.core.execution.body: Use these tasks to assert expectations, set or unset variables, add labels, fail, exit, resume, or purge executions; supply required properties such as variable maps, label key/values, or retention rules before altering execution state.

io.kestra.plugin.monday.teams.title: Monday Teams
io.kestra.plugin.monday.teams.body: Create and delete Monday teams, and add or remove their members. Useful when provisioning accounts in bulk or mirroring an external directory.

io.kestra.plugin.crypto.openpgp.title: OpenPGP
io.kestra.plugin.crypto.openpgp.description: Tasks that encrypt and decrypt files with OpenPGP, including optional signing and signature verification.
io.kestra.plugin.crypto.openpgp.body: Encrypt accepts a source file (`from`), recipient list, and ASCII-armored public keys, and can sign the output when given signing keys and a passphrase; Decrypt takes the encrypted file, a private key with optional passphrase, and can validate signatures against allowed users. Both tasks stream files through Kestra storage and return the resulting file URI for downstream processing.

io.kestra.plugin.jira.title: Atlassian Jira
io.kestra.plugin.jira.description: Tasks that create, update, and search Jira issues.
io.kestra.plugin.jira.body: Provide Jira cloud/server URL with user/API token or PAT, project keys, and issue fields to create or modify issues, add comments, or search via JQL, returning issue payloads for incident and backlog workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.ai.retriever.title: Retriever
io.kestra.plugin.ai.retriever.description: Tasks that pull external context for Retrieval Augmented Generation: embedding-store retrieval, web search via Google or Tavily, and SQL database retrieval, feeding results into AI prompts.

io.kestra.plugin.aws.s3.title: AWS S3
io.kestra.plugin.aws.s3.description: Tasks that manage Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3) buckets and objects.
io.kestra.plugin.aws.s3.body: Upload or download single and multiple files, list, copy, and delete keys, create buckets, and trigger flows from bucket events. Supports streaming files from URIs, writing fetched objects to outputs, and handling large transfers via the S3 Transfer Manager.

io.kestra.plugin.elasticsearch.title: Elasticsearch
io.kestra.plugin.elasticsearch.description: Tasks that query and write to Elasticsearch clusters for search, indexing, bulk ingestion, and ES|QL.
io.kestra.plugin.elasticsearch.body: Configure a shared connection with cluster hosts (and optional basic auth, headers, path prefixes, or trust-all SSL) and supply index names plus search DSL or ES|QL payloads to run. Covers single-document writes and reads, bulk/streaming ingestion, REST requests, and search or scroll operations with controls for routing, refresh policy, and storing or fetching results for downstream steps.

io.kestra.plugin.graalvm.ruby.title: Ruby - GraalVM
io.kestra.plugin.graalvm.ruby.description: Tasks that execute Ruby with GraalVM.
io.kestra.plugin.graalvm.ruby.body: Run inline Ruby or script files inside the GraalVM engine with optional bindings and input parameters, returning computed results directly to your workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.twilio.notify.title: Twilio Messaging
io.kestra.plugin.twilio.notify.description: Tasks that send SMS or voice notifications through Twilio.
io.kestra.plugin.twilio.notify.body: Provide Twilio account SID/auth token plus from/to numbers and message text (or call URL) to deliver SMS or voice calls from Kestra workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.redis.json.title: Redis JSON
io.kestra.plugin.redis.json.description: Tasks that store and retrieve JSON documents in Redis.
io.kestra.plugin.redis.json.body: Configure Redis connection info and JSON paths to set, get, and update JSON values using RedisJSON commands, enabling structured data storage from workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.zoom.title: Zoom
io.kestra.plugin.zoom.body: Send notifications and messages to Zoom Team Chat channels or users directly from your Kestra workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.notifications.x.title: X
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.x.description: Tasks that post messages to X (formerly Twitter).
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.x.body: Provide X API credentials and post content to publish tweets from Kestra workflows, handling auth and response payloads.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.dns.ho.title: Infoblox DNS Host Records
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.dns.ho.description: Tasks to manage DNS host records in Infoblox via the WAPI REST API.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.dns.ho.body: List, create, update, and delete DNS host record objects in Infoblox.

io.kestra.plugin.slack.app.core.title: Slack App
io.kestra.plugin.slack.app.core.description: Tasks that run Slack App workflows and triggers using bot tokens.
io.kestra.plugin.slack.app.core.body: Provide a Slack app `token` (xoxb) for all method calls; the Event API trigger also needs the app `signingSecret` to verify requests. Use these when you need app-scoped actions or to start flows from Slack events instead of simple webhooks.

io.kestra.plugin.supabase.title: Supabase
io.kestra.plugin.supabase.description: Tasks that call Supabase APIs for data and storage operations.
io.kestra.plugin.supabase.body: Provide Supabase project URL and API key or service role credentials to query PostgREST endpoints, manage storage buckets/files, and use auth-enabled requests, returning JSON responses for workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.malloy.title: Malloy CLI
io.kestra.plugin.malloy.description: Tasks that execute Malloy CLI queries.
io.kestra.plugin.malloy.body: Provide the Malloy model file or query, connection settings, and CLI options to run Malloy queries and capture the results or exported files inside Kestra flows.

io.kestra.plugin.soda.title: Soda
io.kestra.plugin.soda.description: Tasks that run Soda scans for data quality checks.
io.kestra.plugin.soda.body: Provide Soda configuration and `checks` YAML along with any required connectors or variables to execute scans (deprecated Soda Core 3, via `Scan`) or verify data contracts (Soda Core 4, via `VerifyContract`), emitting check outcomes and results files you can inspect or fail pipelines on.

io.kestra.plugin.airflow.dags.title: Airflow DAGs
io.kestra.plugin.airflow.dags.description: Tasks that trigger and monitor Apache Airflow DAG runs.
io.kestra.plugin.airflow.dags.body: Trigger DAG executions through Airflow's REST API with required baseUrl and dagId, optionally pass a custom body payload for conf, and authenticate via headers or HTTP options such as basic auth or bearer tokens. Enable wait with pollFrequency and maxDuration to track completion and return run details including dagRunId, state, started, and ended timestamps.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.hpoo.executions.title: HP OO Executions
io.kestra.plugin.ee.hpoo.executions.description: Tasks to run, monitor, and control HP Operations Orchestration (OpenText OO) flow executions.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.hpoo.executions.body: Provide the OO Central host, API mode (Classic or Containerized), and credentials to trigger flows, poll for completion, retrieve execution summaries and step logs, and change execution state (cancel, pause, resume).

io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.mariadb.title: Mariadb
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.mariadb.description: Tasks that connect to MariaDB via JDBC to run queries and loads.
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.mariadb.body: Provide the MariaDB JDBC URL, credentials, and SQL statements (query, batch, load, trigger) to read or write data; configure fetch type, fetch size, and output options to return rows or files from workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.dataform.cli.title: Dataform CLI
io.kestra.plugin.dataform.cli.description: Tasks that orchestrate Dataform through CLI commands.
io.kestra.plugin.dataform.cli.body: Run the Dataform CLI in Kestra to compile, validate, or execute projects using the required `commands` list; add optional `beforeCommands` for setup, supply credentials or configs via `env` and `inputFiles`, and override the container image or task runner when needed.

io.kestra.plugin.huawei.dli.title: Huawei DLI
io.kestra.plugin.huawei.dli.description: Tasks for Huawei Cloud DLI (Data Lake Insight): run SQL queries against data in OBS or federated sources.

io.kestra.plugin.proxmox.cluster.title: Proxmox VE Cluster
io.kestra.plugin.proxmox.cluster.description: Tasks that query node status, list cluster-wide resources, and list storage pools on a Proxmox VE cluster.
io.kestra.plugin.proxmox.cluster.body: No specific node is required for cluster-scope queries. Returns JSON representations of node metrics, resource inventory across all nodes, and pool definitions.

io.kestra.plugin.ceph.rbd.snapshots.title: Ceph RBD Snapshots
io.kestra.plugin.ceph.rbd.snapshots.description: Tasks that manage RBD image snapshots.
io.kestra.plugin.ceph.rbd.snapshots.body: Create, list, delete, roll back, and clone snapshots of RBD block images.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.crowdstrike.ioc.title: CrowdStrike IOC
io.kestra.plugin.ee.crowdstrike.ioc.description: Tasks for creating, updating, deleting, and searching custom indicators of compromise (IOCs) in CrowdStrike Falcon.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.crowdstrike.ioc.body: Create, update, delete, and search custom IOCs (domains, IPs, and file hashes) with configurable action and severity.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.dns.aa.title: Infoblox DNS AAAA Records
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.dns.aa.description: Tasks to manage DNS AAAA records in Infoblox via the WAPI REST API.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.dns.aa.body: List, create, update, and delete DNS AAAA record objects in Infoblox.

io.kestra.plugin.twilio.segment.reversee.title: Reverse ETL
io.kestra.plugin.twilio.segment.reversee.description: Tasks that trigger and monitor Segment Reverse ETL syncs.
io.kestra.plugin.twilio.segment.reversee.body: Provide Segment API credentials and provide Reverse ETL identifiers to start syncs and retrieve their status for workflow automation.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.ipv6fi.title: Infoblox IPv6 Fixed Addresses
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.ipv6fi.description: Tasks to manage IPv6 fixed address reservations in Infoblox via the WAPI REST API.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.ipv6fi.body: List, create, and delete IPv6 fixed address objects in Infoblox.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.datadog.title: Datadog (EE)
io.kestra.plugin.ee.datadog.description: Tasks that ship Kestra workflow logs to Datadog via the HTTP intake API for centralized monitoring.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.datadog.body: Use the LogExporter with a Datadog basePath and apiKey to push run logs to the correct regional endpoint. Configure source, service, and chunk size to match your Datadog log attribution and throughput needs, and pair it with a LogShipper to automate log exports.

io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.redshift.title: Redshift
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.redshift.description: Tasks that connect to Amazon Redshift via JDBC to run queries and loads.
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.redshift.body: Provide the Redshift JDBC URL, credentials, and SQL statements (query, batch, load, trigger) to read or write data; configure fetch type, fetch size, and output options to return rows or files from workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.dns.cn.title: Infoblox DNS CNAME Records
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.dns.cn.description: Tasks to manage DNS CNAME records in Infoblox via the WAPI REST API.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.dns.cn.body: List, create, update, and delete DNS CNAME record objects in Infoblox.

io.kestra.plugin.skopeo.title: Skopeo
io.kestra.plugin.skopeo.description: Plugin for interacting with container images and registries using Skopeo.

io.kestra.plugin.redis.title: Redis
io.kestra.plugin.redis.description: Tasks that work with Redis data structures and pub/sub.
io.kestra.plugin.redis.body: Provide Redis connection details (host, port, TLS, credentials) to read/write strings and lists, store JSON, or publish/subscribe to channels, enabling cache and queue patterns in workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.azure.synapse.title: Azure Synapse
io.kestra.plugin.azure.synapse.description: Tasks for Azure Synapse Analytics to submit and manage Spark batch jobs on Synapse Spark pools.
io.kestra.plugin.azure.synapse.body: Provide Azure AD credentials plus workspace endpoint and Spark pool name; submit Spark batch jobs with application files, arguments, and resource configurations for distributed data processing.

io.kestra.plugin.nats.core.title: NATS Core
io.kestra.plugin.nats.core.description: Tasks that publish and subscribe to NATS subjects with triggers.
io.kestra.plugin.nats.core.body: Configure NATS servers, authentication (user/password, token, or creds), subjects, and payload serialization to send messages or start flows when messages arrive, with consumer options for durable names and ack handling.

io.kestra.plugin.kestra.ee.assets.title: Kestra Assets
io.kestra.plugin.kestra.ee.assets.description: Tasks and triggers to manage Kestra EE data assets.
io.kestra.plugin.kestra.ee.assets.body: Set the Kestra API URL and auth token to list, set, delete, and purge assets, or trigger on asset freshness.

io.kestra.plugin.transform.grok.title: Grok
io.kestra.plugin.transform.grok.description: Tasks that parse text using Grok patterns.
io.kestra.plugin.transform.grok.body: Provide input strings or files with Grok patterns and optional custom pattern definitions to extract structured fields from logs or messages, emitting parsed records for downstream processing.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.nutanix.snapshot.title: Nutanix Snapshots
io.kestra.plugin.ee.nutanix.snapshot.description: Tasks that manage AHV VM snapshots in Nutanix.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.nutanix.snapshot.body: Create, list, restore, and delete AHV VM snapshots (recovery points) using Prism Central dataprotection APIs.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.azure.monitor.title: Azure Monitor Log Exporter
io.kestra.plugin.ee.azure.monitor.description: Tasks that send observability data to Azure Monitor Log Ingestion endpoints.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.azure.monitor.body: Exports Kestra logs to a Data Collection Rule stream with configurable chunking and error metrics; requires the ingestion `endpoint`, `ruleId`, and `streamName`, and authenticates with Azure AD credentials (tenant/client/secret or certificate) or the default Azure credential chain.

io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.snowflake.title: Snowflake
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.snowflake.description: Tasks that connect to Snowflake via JDBC to run queries and loads.
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.snowflake.body: Provide the Snowflake JDBC URL, account/warehouse/database credentials, and SQL statements (query, batch, load, trigger) to read or write data; configure fetch type, fetch size, and output options to return rows or files from workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.line.title: Line
io.kestra.plugin.line.description: Tasks that send notifications to LINE messaging.
io.kestra.plugin.line.body: Provide the LINE channel access token and target user/group to push messages from Kestra, supporting text content and optional attributes.

io.kestra.plugin.klaviyo.campaign.title: Klaviyo Campaign
io.kestra.plugin.klaviyo.campaign.description: Tasks that fetch Klaviyo campaign details and recipient counts.
io.kestra.plugin.klaviyo.campaign.body: Provide the Klaviyo `apiKey`, `campaignIds`, and fetch strategy to list campaign metadata or counts, respecting API revision headers and rate delays so you can audit targeting, status, and delivery readiness in flows.

io.kestra.plugin.github.code.title: GitHub Code
io.kestra.plugin.github.code.description: Tasks that search GitHub source code through the API.
io.kestra.plugin.github.code.body: Use a GitHub token with search queries, languages, and repo qualifiers to retrieve matching code results and metadata you can route to review or inventory workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.crowdstrike.hosts.title: CrowdStrike Hosts
io.kestra.plugin.ee.crowdstrike.hosts.description: Tasks for searching, fetching, containing, and tagging hosts (devices) managed by CrowdStrike Falcon.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.crowdstrike.hosts.body: Search device IDs with FQL, fetch host details, contain or release network containment, and add or remove grouping tags.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.syslog.title: Syslog (EE)
io.kestra.plugin.ee.syslog.description: Export Kestra execution and audit logs to a Syslog collector or SIEM in CEF format over UDP, TCP, or TLS.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.gcp.title: Google Cloud (EE)
io.kestra.plugin.ee.gcp.description: Tasks that integrate Google Cloud Platform services into Kestra enterprise workflows including task runners and log management.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.gcp.body: Provides task execution on Google Cloud Run and Batch and log export to Cloud Storage and the Cloud Operations Suite; configure each task with a project ID and credentials via a service account or impersonated identity, plus the service-specific target such as a Cloud Run or Batch region, a Cloud Storage bucket, or Cloud Logging.

io.kestra.plugin.slack.notifications.title: Slack Notifications
io.kestra.plugin.slack.notifications.description: Tasks that post Slack notifications through incoming webhooks or execution templates.
io.kestra.plugin.slack.notifications.body: Use an incoming webhook `url` (https://hooks.slack.com/...) with either `messageText` or JSON `payload`; SlackExecution also needs an `executionId` to render the built-in status template. Ideal for alerting flows or any external webhook endpoint that accepts Slack-compatible payloads.

io.kestra.plugin.nats.kv.title: NATS KV
io.kestra.plugin.nats.kv.description: Tasks that interact with NATS key-value buckets.
io.kestra.plugin.nats.kv.body: Provide NATS connection settings, bucket names, keys, and values to put, get, list, or delete entries, enabling lightweight state sharing across workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.huawei.koocli.title: Huawei KooCLI
io.kestra.plugin.huawei.koocli.description: Tasks for Huawei Cloud KooCLI (hcloud): run arbitrary hcloud commands in a container with automatic IAM credential injection.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.netapp.ontap.svm.title: NetApp ONTAP SVMs
io.kestra.plugin.ee.netapp.ontap.svm.description: Tasks for querying NetApp ONTAP Storage Virtual Machines (SVMs).

io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.druid.title: Apache Druid
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.druid.description: Tasks that connect to Apache Druid via JDBC to run queries and loads.
io.kestra.plugin.jdbc.druid.body: Provide the Druid JDBC URL, credentials, and SQL statements (query, batch, load, trigger) to read or write data; configure fetch type, fetch size, and output options to return rows or files from workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.scripts.nashorn.title: Nashorn
io.kestra.plugin.scripts.nashorn.description: Tasks that run JavaScript with the Nashorn engine.
io.kestra.plugin.scripts.nashorn.body: Provide JavaScript code inline or script files to execute via Nashorn on the JVM, with optional bindings and arguments, capturing outputs for workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.meta.instagram.media.title: Instagram
io.kestra.plugin.meta.instagram.media.description: Tasks that publish and inspect media for Instagram Business accounts.
io.kestra.plugin.meta.instagram.media.body: Use an Instagram Business access token and user ID to upload images, carousels, or videos, list existing media, and pull engagement insights, ensuring required fields like `caption`, `mediaUrls`, and `igUserId` are set before posting.

io.kestra.plugin.digitalocean.volume.title: DigitalOcean Volume
io.kestra.plugin.digitalocean.volume.description: Tasks for managing DigitalOcean block storage volumes.
io.kestra.plugin.digitalocean.volume.body: List, read, create, and delete volumes, and attach or detach a volume from a droplet.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.title: Infoblox (EE)
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.description: Infoblox DDI (DNS, DHCP, IPAM) tasks and triggers for Kestra, covering both NIOS Grid Manager (WAPI REST API) and Universal DDI (Cloud Services Portal API).
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.body: Automate Infoblox NIOS Grid Manager: manage IPv4/IPv6 networks, fixed addresses, DHCP ranges, DNS A/AAAA/CNAME/PTR/host records, list DHCP leases, and trigger flows on IP allocation events. Automate Infoblox Universal DDI (Cloud Services Portal): manage IP spaces, address blocks, subnets, addresses, DHCP ranges and fixed addresses, authoritative zones, and type-discriminated DNS records under the `csp.*` tasks.

io.kestra.plugin.gcp.compute.title: Google Compute Engine
io.kestra.plugin.gcp.compute.description: Create, start, stop, and delete Compute Engine virtual machine instances as part of orchestrated workflows.
io.kestra.plugin.gcp.compute.body: Use these tasks to create, start, stop, and delete Compute Engine virtual machine instances as part of a flow. Each task waits for the operation to complete within a configurable timeout and returns the instance name, ID, status, and IP addresses.

io.kestra.plugin.kestra.ee.iam.serviceAc.title: Kestra IAM Service Accounts
io.kestra.plugin.kestra.ee.iam.serviceAc.description: Tasks that create, list, and delete service accounts.
io.kestra.plugin.kestra.ee.iam.serviceAc.body: Provide the Kestra API URL and auth token to upsert service accounts by name, list all service accounts in a tenant, or delete them, enabling automated service account lifecycle management from orchestrated workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.notifications.zulip.title: Zulip
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.zulip.description: Tasks that send messages to Zulip streams or users.
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.zulip.body: Provide Zulip server URL, email/API key, stream/topic or user targets, and message content to post notifications from Kestra workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.ipv6ad.title: Infoblox IPv6 Addresses
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.ipv6ad.description: Tasks to list and allocate IPv6 addresses in Infoblox via the WAPI REST API.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.infoblox.ipam.ipv6ad.body: List used IPv6 addresses, allocate the next available IPv6 from a network, and release IPv6 fixed address assignments.

io.kestra.plugin.serdes.xml.title: XML
io.kestra.plugin.serdes.xml.description: Tasks that convert between XML and ION.
io.kestra.plugin.serdes.xml.body: Provide XML input with optional namespaces to convert to ION or supply ION data to produce XML, enabling XML interchange within workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.notifications.teams.title: Teams
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.teams.description: Tasks that send notifications to Microsoft Teams.
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.teams.body: Provide the Teams incoming webhook URL and message payload (text or cards) to post alerts from Kestra flows into Teams channels.

io.kestra.plugin.notifications.mail.title: Mail
io.kestra.plugin.notifications.mail.body: Configure SMTP server/port, credentials, from/to addresses, subject, and body/attachments to send emails from workflows; supports TLS/SSL settings for secure delivery.

io.kestra.plugin.figma.comments.title: Comments
io.kestra.plugin.figma.comments.description: List, create, and delete comments on Figma files.
io.kestra.plugin.figma.comments.body: List a file's comments, post a new comment (optionally pinned to a canvas position or as a reply), or delete an existing comment.

io.kestra.plugin.core.debug.title: Debug
io.kestra.plugin.core.debug.description: Tasks that emit debug output while you develop a flow.
io.kestra.plugin.core.debug.body: Echo and Return help inspect variables and payloads or short-circuit execution during testing; provide the message or value to output so downstream tasks can see exactly what is being passed around.

io.kestra.plugin.fs.title: File system
io.kestra.plugin.fs.description: Tasks that manage files across local and remote file systems.
io.kestra.plugin.fs.body: Use protocol-specific tasks (local, FTP/FTPS/SFTP, NFS, SMB, SSH, TCP/UDP) to list, upload, download, move, copy, delete, and watch files by providing host/port, credentials or keys, and source/target paths; triggers detect new or updated files.

io.kestra.plugin.confluence.pages.title: Confluence Pages
io.kestra.plugin.confluence.pages.description: Tasks that create, list, and update Confluence pages with Markdown rendering and metadata controls.
io.kestra.plugin.confluence.pages.body: Use these tasks to publish or sync documentation while keeping Confluence as the source of truth; they convert Markdown to the storage format and return results as JSON, Markdown, or stored files. Each call needs Confluence credentials (`serverUrl`, `username`, `apiToken`); create/update expect page details and Markdown content (update also requires `pageId`, `status`, `title`, and `versionInfo`), and list supports filters for spaces, page IDs, titles, status, subtype, sorting, and pagination.

io.kestra.plugin.aws.cloudformation.title: AWS CloudFormation
io.kestra.plugin.aws.cloudformation.description: Tasks that create, update, or delete AWS CloudFormation stacks and optionally wait for stack operations to finish, returning stack outputs for downstream use.

io.kestra.plugin.scripts.groovy.title: Groovy
io.kestra.plugin.scripts.groovy.body: Provide Groovy code inline or script files with optional dependencies and JVM options to execute via Groovy, capturing stdout/stderr and generated files.

io.kestra.plugin.huawei.dis.title: Huawei DIS
io.kestra.plugin.huawei.dis.description: Tasks and triggers for Huawei Cloud DIS (Data Ingestion Service): write and consume records on a data stream, the Huawei equivalent of AWS Kinesis Data Streams.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.aws.title: AWS (EE)
io.kestra.plugin.ee.aws.description: Tasks that integrate AWS services into Kestra enterprise workflows including task runners and log management.
io.kestra.plugin.ee.aws.body: Provides AWS Batch task execution and log export to Amazon S3 and CloudWatch Logs; configure each task with an AWS region and credentials or an assumed role, plus the service-specific target such as a Batch compute environment, an S3 bucket, or a CloudWatch log group.

io.kestra.plugin.transform.jsonata.title: JSONata
io.kestra.plugin.transform.jsonata.description: Tasks that transform JSON using JSONata expressions.
io.kestra.plugin.transform.jsonata.body: Provide input JSON and a JSONata expression to reshape or filter data, with optional variables and environment settings; outputs the transformed JSON for subsequent tasks.

io.kestra.plugin.databricks.sql.title: Databricks SQL
io.kestra.plugin.databricks.sql.description: Tasks that execute SQL queries on a Databricks cluster via JDBC.
io.kestra.plugin.databricks.sql.body: Run parameterized SQL against a Databricks cluster or SQL warehouse using the JDBC driver by providing the host, HTTP path, access token, and SQL statement. Results are streamed to Kestra storage (Ion format) with a row-count metric, and you can supply optional catalog/schema, time zone, and JDBC properties.

io.kestra.plugin.azure.ml.title: Azure Machine Learning
io.kestra.plugin.azure.ml.description: Tasks and triggers to interact with Azure Machine Learning.
io.kestra.plugin.azure.ml.body: Submit and monitor training jobs and pipelines, register and retrieve model and data asset versions, and control compute clusters and instances directly within Kestra data pipelines.

io.kestra.plugin.ollama.cli.title: Ollama CLI
io.kestra.plugin.ollama.cli.description: Tasks that execute Ollama CLI commands for model management and generation.
io.kestra.plugin.ollama.cli.body: Define the shell `commands` to run (pull, list, run), optionally set a remote `host`, container image, and model caching path, and capture output files so model runs and assets integrate cleanly with workflows.

io.kestra.plugin.monday.folders.title: Monday Folders
io.kestra.plugin.monday.folders.body: Create and delete folders inside Monday workspaces. Useful when scripting workspace layout or grouping boards under a common parent.

io.kestra.plugin.kestra.ee.iam.invitatio.title: Kestra IAM Invitations
io.kestra.plugin.kestra.ee.iam.invitatio.description: Tasks that create, list, and delete user invitations.
io.kestra.plugin.kestra.ee.iam.invitatio.body: Provide the Kestra API URL, auth token, and an email address with optional roles to send invitations, enumerate pending invitations, or revoke them before acceptance.

io.kestra.plugin.core.templating.title: Templating
io.kestra.plugin.core.templating.description: Tasks that render dynamic task specifications from templates.
io.kestra.plugin.core.templating.body: TemplatedTask lets you supply a Pebble-rendered YAML spec that is parsed and executed at runtime; provide the `spec` property with a valid runnable task definition and avoid recursive templating when composing dynamic tasks.

io.kestra.plugin.ee.dellemc.powerstore.r.title: Dell EMC PowerStore Replication
io.kestra.plugin.ee.dellemc.powerstore.r.description: Tasks for managing Dell EMC PowerStore replication: create rules, check session status, fail over, and synchronize on demand.
